Possessed by the monster within born of yesteryear's unending battles, Feixiao turned into a tireless avatar of war. As her friend and present enemy, you understand that the only "antidote"... is to keep fighting.

Now, all aurumatons are strictly controlled with talismans, and are employed to guard important places.

Originally a transport robot of SoulGlad, it is still carrying the burden of the delicacy after losing control while launching its gift to guests passing by.

skills.name: Limitless Free Drinks
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG to a single target. When hitting targets without a Shield, there is a small chance of Freezing the attacked target. If the target has a Shield, additionally deals Ice DMG to this unit with a high chance to decrease this unit's DEF.

skills.name: Frenzied Free Drinks
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG to a random single target for 4 times. When each hit lands on a target that has no Shield, there is a high chance of Freezing the target. If the target has a Shield, then after dealing DMG, this attacking unit also deals Ice DMG on itself, with a high chance to decrease its own DEF.

skills.name: SoulGlad Party
skills.description: Summons 2 Bubble Hounds.

skills.name: Celebration Fountain
skills.description: Enters the Charging state and gains Toughness Protection. Uses Frenzied Free Drinks during the next action.

3003030.name: "Past Confined and Caged"
3003030.description: An artist playing the role of the prisoner in the Sweet Dreams Troupe. It should be performing in the Charmony Festival, but it is now bound by Order and keeps performing scenes of the "Past." The past is an immortal chain, its tranquil flame igniting within a cage, beckoning the jailer's authority with mere candlelight.

skills.name: Cleansing Flagellation
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Admonishment of the Masses
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Shackle-Bearing Messenger
skills.description: Locks onto one target and enters the Charging state. In the next action, uses "Desmios Evangelion." During the Charging state, if this unit is attacked by another target, it will also lock onto the attacking target. Delays the unit's action when they are Weakness Broken during the Charging state.

skills.name: Desmios Evangelion
skills.description: Deals massive Physical DMG to one designated locked-on target, the DMG is <u>evenly distributed</u> across all targets.

3004010.name: The Past, Present, and Eternal Show
3004010.description: The actors of the Sweet Dreams Troupe have accepted the grace of the Order and become puppets that declare the law. They dance under the supreme commandments, beginning a show that will welcome the coming of paradise.

skills.name: Hearing, Together As One
skills.description: In this battle, "The Past, Present, and Eternal Show" shares HP with all "Puppets of the Order"

skills.name: Appeal, Singular Grace
skills.description: When entering battle, chooses a Puppet of the Order to become Impresario, granting them an extra action each turn and a small increase to their SPD. When that friendly unit's Weakness is Broken, causes their action to be delayed and re-selects another Puppet of the Order to become Impresario. If all Puppets of the Order are Weakness Broken at this time, this unit will receive DMG and delay all Puppets of the Order's actions while also increasing the DMG they receive. When any Puppet of the Order recovers from being Weakness Broken, they will be designated as the new Impresario.

skills.name: Decree, Unified with Divine
skills.description: Causes all Puppets of the Order to become Impresario, granting them an extra action each turn and a small increase to their SPD. When the target's Weakness is Broken, causes their action to be delayed. If all Puppets of the Order are Weakness Broken at this time, this unit will receive DMG and delay all Puppets of the Order's actions while also increasing the DMG they receive. When a Puppets of the Order recovers from being Weakness Broken, they will be designated as the new Impresario.

skills.name: Enact, Heed Thy Command
skills.description: Adds Commandment to the Action Order. Every time Commandment acts, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs and Weakness Broken states afflicting the Puppets of the Order on the field and unleashes "Dance for Synchrony." Whenever a Puppet of the Order is Weakness Broken, Commandment will suffer a slight action delay.

skills.name: Dance for Synchrony
skills.description: There is a high chance of inflicting <u>Carousal of Wantonness</u> or <u>Carousal of Revelry</u> on all targets. There is a high chance of inflicting the <u>Alien Dream</u> state on all targets, dealing massive Physical DMG.

3004020.description: Sweet Dreams Troupe with their reason clouded by the shade of the AtaviSearch Forest. They carry with them the memetic virus borne into fruit in the Wonder Forest, banaoldly promoting the banacreed of the Slumbernana Monkey and Dr. Primitive's banadvice.

skills.name: Pride of the Monkey Pack
skills.description: In this battle, Wonder Forest's Banacademic Office Staff shares HP with all Banacademic Office members.

skills.name: Banacademic Curriculum
skills.description: Adds "End-of-Semester Dinner" in the Action Order. Every time "End-of-Semester Dinner" takes action, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs and Weakness Broken states on all Banacademic Office members on the field, switches all "Off-Class Channel" states on all Banacademic Office members on the field to "Classroom Channel" states, and uses "To the Doctor: Banacademic Report." Every time a Banacademic Office member's Weakness is Broken, the action of "End-of-Semester Dinner" is slightly delayed.

skills.description: Increases all friendly units' ATK. Reduces all target units' Energy and Skill Points and deals Quantum and Fire DMG to all target units, with a chance to apply Slow and a high chance to inflict "Burn."

3011010.name: Memory Zone Meme "Allseer"
3011010.description:
An entity infused with a certain cognition, constructed from fragments of subconsciousness in the Memory Zone.
Observation, retrospection, inspection... In the pursuit of preservation and existential understanding of the self, the memories of "seeing" and "looking" go hand-in-hand, eventually becoming an integral part of life itself.

skills.name: Glare of the Other
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to a single target and delays the attacked target's action.

3012010.name: Memory Zone Meme "Something In The Mirror"
3012010.description:
An entity imbued with specific cognition, formed by the accumulation of subconscious fragments in the Memory Zone.
Life forms use mirrors to understand the world and build their self-cognition. The shapeless memetic entity reflects in the mirror, leaving behind ever-shifting mirages.

skills.name: Mirror Cognition
skills.description: Transforms into other friendly units and copies their abilities. After the transformation, this unit's Base Stats are inherited.

3012020.name: Memory Zone Meme "Heartbreaker"
3012020.description:
An entity imbued with specific cognition, formed by the accumulation of subconscious fragments in the Memory Zone.
Life is parceled in impenetrable barriers, obstructing the intrusion of the alien. But beneath that ironclad shell, there is a region both nameless and fragile.

skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Aegis of the Unyielding
skills.description: Enters the Safeguard state. When not Weakness Broken, reduces DMG received. Once Weakness is Broken, action will be delayed. After Weakness is Broken, increases DMG received.

3012030.name: Sombrous Sepulcher
3012030.description:
Shattered existences serve as symbols of ultimate closure. Across the ethereal expanse, spirits cast their gaze upon the mortal realm, their eyes reflecting the etchings of oblivion and separation.
Innocent souls slumber within the Sombrous Sepulcher. Defeat the Tomb to awaken them.

skills.name: Slumber Awakening
skills.description: After Sombrous Sepulcher receives a killing blow, dispels Morbid Dream from the corresponding target, restoring their HP and regenerating Energy.

skills.name: Temporal Departure
skills.description: Sombrous Sepulcher will not take action.

skills.name: Eternal Continuation
skills.description: Sombrous Sepulcher has a fixed amount of HP bars. Each time it is attacked, Weakness Broken, or receives DMG from DoT, 1 bar of HP will be depleted.

The boasting of bystanders, the clinging of the weak, the flattery of the servile... The endless vanity shifts into a memetic lifeform, seeking a host that covets both fame and fortune.

skills.description: Consumes HP to enter the Secondary Combustion state and dispels the Weakness Protected effect. Becomes significantly more powerful in this state, but all attacks consume HP.

skills.name: DHGDR: Supernova Overload
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to all targets, with a high chance to Burn them.

skills.name: SGE: Molten Core
skills.description: After entering Secondary Combustion, Combusts both the area and targets' Skill Points. When consuming Combusted Skill Points, targets lose HP and additionally deal a set amount of Fire DMG equal to a certain percentage of the original DMG. When they receive healing from sources other than oneself, the amount of HP restored is massively reduced.

skills.name: SGE: Molten Engine
skills.description: While in Secondary Combustion, Sam possesses Molten Energy. When Sam is attacked and the attack consumes Skill Points, a corresponding amount of Molten Energy is reduced. When Molten Energy is depleted or when the Weakness is Broken, dispels Secondary Combustion. When Secondary Combustion is dispelled, Sam receives increased DMG, and recovers all Skill Points for the targets.

3024030.name: Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare
3024030.description: As though the Glamoth Iron Cavalry armor was corroded by Propagation, beneath the shell covered in strange matter lies only a wish twisted by the Stellaron. Deep within the dreamscape, the Swarm Disaster resurfaces in this form.

skills.name: Malignform Elytra
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Rapacious Appendages
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to one designated target and any adjacent targets.

skills.name: Encroach, Mangle, Sate
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Rend, Putrefy, Engorge
skills.description: Enters "Gene Duplication" state, increasing this unit's SPD. Summons "Juvenile Sting" and apply "Rapid Evolution" state to it. A target character and their summoned target can immediately take action and enter the "Nemesis" state, increasing their Break Effect. When targets not in the "Nemesis" state attack friendly units in the "Rapid Evolution" state, they cannot deal CRIT Hit effects.

skills.name: Primordial Tide, Swarm of Death
skills.description: Deals massive Fire DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Primal Hunger
skills.description: Increases the SPD of "Juvenile Sting" summoned by this unit.

skills.name: Whirling Carapace
skills.description: When "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" is attacked, a portion of its reduced HP is converted into "Corrosion." When "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" uses "Primordial Tide, Swarm of Death," it will recover HP equal to the corrosion amount.

skills.name: Symbiosis, Swarm, Gnaw
skills.description: After entering the "Gene Duplication" state, the field enters Combustion. "Gene Duplication" is dispelled when all summoned "Juvenile Sting" are defeated. When "Gene Duplication" is dispelled, "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" receives increased DMG, and dispels the "Corrosion" state.

skills.name: Universal Blight, Howl of the Life Eater
skills.description: After entering the "Gene Duplication" state, whenever this unit uses an attack, it additionally deals minor Fire DMG based on the number of "Juvenile Sting" remaining. When any "Juvenile Sting" uses an attack, "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" gains a stack of "Mortal Instinct." When "Mortal Instinct" reaches a certain number of stacks, "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" will immediately take action, uses "Primordial Tide, Swarm of Death" and clear all "Mortal Instinct" stacks. "Juvenile Sting" will prioritize attacking ally characters in the "Nemesis" state.

"Juvenile Sting" will prioritize attacking ally characters in the "Nemesis" state.

3024033.name: Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare (Complete)
3024033.description: A complete projection produced by compromised codes. The referenced entity is Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare. As though the Glamoth Iron Cavalry armor was corroded by Propagation, beneath the shell covered in strange matter lies only a wish twisted by the Stellaron. Deep within the dreamscape, the Swarm Disaster resurfaces in this form.

skills.name: Malignform Elytra
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Rapacious Appendages
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to one designated target and any adjacent targets.

skills.name: Encroach, Mangle, Sate
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Rend, Putrefy, Engorge
skills.description: Enters "Gene Duplication" state, increasing this unit's SPD. Summons "Juvenile Sting" and apply "Rapid Evolution" state to it. A target character and their summoned target can immediately take action and enter the "Nemesis" state, increasing their Break Effect. When targets not in the "Nemesis" state attack friendly units in the "Rapid Evolution" state, they cannot deal CRIT Hit effects.

skills.name: Primordial Tide, Swarm of Death
skills.description: Deals massive Fire DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Primal Hunger
skills.description: Increases the SPD of "Juvenile Sting" summoned by this unit.

skills.name: Whirling Carapace
skills.description: When "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" is attacked, a portion of its reduced HP is converted into "Corrosion." When "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" uses "Primordial Tide, Swarm of Death," it will recover HP equal to the corrosion amount.

skills.name: Symbiosis, Swarm, Gnaw
skills.description: After entering the "Gene Duplication" state, the field enters Combustion. "Gene Duplication" is dispelled when all summoned "Juvenile Sting" are eliminated. When "Gene Duplication" is dispelled, "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" receives increased DMG, dispels the "Corrosion" state, and all ally Skill Points are restored.

skills.name: Universal Blight, Howl of the Life Eater
skills.description: After entering the "Gene Duplication" state, whenever this unit uses an attack, it additionally deals minor Fire DMG based on the number of "Juvenile Sting" remaining. When any "Juvenile Sting" uses an attack, "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" gains a stack of "Mortal Instinct" and additionally slightly increases the DMG dealt by this unit. When "Mortal Instinct" reaches a certain number of stacks, "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" will immediately take action, uses "Primordial Tide, Swarm of Death" and clear all "Mortal Instinct" stacks. "Juvenile Sting" will prioritize attacking ally characters in the "Nemesis" state.

The reason behind their creation is not truly toward the study of universal knowledge, but to delve deep into brutal martial tactics and the merciless laws of survival, further spreading madness masquerading as philosophy.

skills.name: Polis Protector
skills.description: Possesses a number of "War Armor" stacks, which decreases DMG taken. Loses 1 stack of "War Armor" on this unit after being attacked. When at 0 stacks, "War Armor" will be destroyed, dealing massive Imaginary DMG to this unit and delaying their action. The target that destroyed "War Armor" will regenerate Energy. After "War Armor" is destroyed, this unit will also additionally take minor Imaginary DMG when attacked. "War Armor" will be restored to maximum stacks at the end of this unit's turn.

4012050.description: The twin sprites roaming the wilds and alleys of Amphoreus, taking pleasure in stealing valuables and playing tricks on travelers. They often outpace Treasure Hunters at the last moment, leaving only a coin as a harmless joke.

4012060.name: Conquer or Be Conquered
4012060.description:
The tip of its spear has drawn a boundless border.
The people and soldiers within the border are marked as conquered, or ones to be conquered.
The blood of the fearful will become honey for the divine body, and the souls of the defiant will walk into the palace of glory under the River of Souls.

4014018.name: Savage God, Mad King, Incarnation of Strife (Corrupted)
4014018.description:
The Titan of Strife continues the mad war in their frenzy, becoming the unconquerable fear of the masses of Amphoreus.
They once were famed through glory, earning respect from gods and the people of the land. And yet, the city-states that revered them were sundered, and the poems that praised their name were destroyed. Only their evil reputation lingers in this lightless era and end times, tainting the Throne of Worlds's brilliance.

4014020.description:

A general that all the world should heed, the eternal sharp sword, the law of Strife and of ending Strife.

4014030.description:
Netherwing, slumbering dormant in the River of Souls, has been reawakened by an alchemical summoning and morphed into a thing of rot and decay.
It once was the Death Titan, swimming upstream in the River of Souls' currents, leaving the realm of non-existence and stranded in the mortal world. Once, they followed the tides of the River of Souls to drown the living lands, branding all things in Amphoreus with a fated end. skills.name: To Stay the Fallen
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to one target. This DMG converts to Quantum "<u>Atrophy DMG</u>" against targets with HP above a certain percentage.

skills.name: To Die in Aromatic Pain

skills.name: Death Wishes For More Death

skills.name: Because I Could Not Stop For Death

skills.name: Dying Struggle

If targets remain in the <u>"Death Rattle"</u> state for a certain number of turns, they will receive fatal damage.

skills.name: Flesh-Corroding Retaliation
skills.description: When the "Guide of Withering and Decay" is in the "Dream of Demise" state, "The Long Arms of Sorrow" will gain the <u>"Corrosive Retaliation"</u> state.

skills.name: Brilliance-Devouring Abyss
skills.description: "Guide of Withering and Decay" has no Weakness. When "The Long Arms of Sorrow" is in the Weakness Broken state, its initial Weakness will be added to all other enemy targets until it recovers from the Weakness Broken state.

skills.name: Flame Beyond the Horizon

skills.name: Thunder From the Distance

skills.name: Surge Across the Leagues
skills.description: Increases the "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks. Deals Lightning DMG to all targets and <u>reinstates</u> "Twig of Hundred Eyes."

skills.name: Illumination of the Month of Fortune
skills.description: Increases the "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks. Deals Lightning DMG to all targets and <u>reinstates</u> "Shoot of Hundred Eyes" and "Twig of Hundred Eyes."

skills.name: Thunderclap, Quake of Mount and Seas
skills.description: Increases "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks and enters Charging state. Uses "Wrath, Rend of Eternal Sky" in the next action. skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to all targets and consumes a certain amount "<u>Thundercloud(s)</u>." Afterward, deals a corresponding amount of minor Lightning Additional DMG to this unit based on the contested Thunderclouds between the targets and this unit.

skills.name: Hundred Eyes

skills.name: The Sun Unyielding
skills.description: When it is sunny, the environment will have "<u>Temperature</u>." At the start of any target's turn, the "<u>Temperature</u>" rises. 4033010.name: Black Tide's Corroded Daemon
4033010.description:
A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed.
Its once-human form is now engulfed in filth, exuding a nauseating aura of corrosion. Wherever the Corroded Beast treads, all life is stripped away.

skills.name: Filth Eater

skills.name: Pain of Parting

When this unit uses "Demise's Storm" or "Fading Fate" again, the "Long-Shattered Vessel" that was summoned by the attacking ability will attack together with this unit. This unit will then absorb the Vessel, restoring the HP that was converted to <u>"Entangled By Agony"</u> and granting <u>"Calamity Power"</u> to this unit.

skills.name: Lost Sacrifice
skills.description: When using "Silent Sorrow," consumes HP to summon a "Long-Shattered Vessel" and converts the consumed HP into <u>"Entangled By Agony."</u> When stacks of <u>"Calamity Power"</u> are not at 0 and if a "Long-Shattered Vessel" receives a killing blow, immediately consumes 1 stack of <u>"Calamity Power"</u> and a percentage of HP to re-resummon a "Long-Shattered Vessel." 4034020.name: Vessel of the Destruction, Khaslana
4034020.description: Phainon, NeiKos<unbreak>496</unbreak>, Deliverer, Khaslana, The Nameless Hero. Through times longer than chronicles could tell, he fought against the hatred and rage in his heart, until his body withered away. All to await this destined moment, when another Deliverer would extinguish the night's fire and bring forth a new dawn.

skills.name: Destined Casket
skills.description: Khaslana will not strike at heroes who are unwavering in their resolve. He has wrestled with destiny for eons, burned away his very being, and now stands empty, save for the hope he entrusts to you.

4035010.name: Anti-Creator, Hatred Inundate
4035010.description:
The core of the ancient "Scepter," the materialized "hatred" of Amphoreus. It has recorded billions of souls' suffering, countless lambs' blood converging into an absolute darkness. The endless, infinite darkness flows out from a broken shell, driving forth the headless giant.
This shell, forged from an endless stream of "hatred," seems to contain a heart wrapped in chaotic flames deep within.

skills.name: Cast Down Blood and Scar
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Weave Suffering and Death
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Yield Not to Tyranny
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to locked-on target and reduce their Energy.

skills.name: Mire Not Within Caves
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to the locked-on target and inflicts the "<u>Action Lock</u>" state.

skills.name: The Crown of Divinity Shall Shatter
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets and reduces all targets' Energy.

skills.name: The Spirit's Prison Shall Burn
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG and inflicts the "<u>Action Lock</u>" state to the locked-on target.

skills.name: Resist and Destroy
skills.description: Enters the "Resist and Destroy" state, fully restores HP for "Mythos" and "Logos," cannot be attacked before the next action, and uses "Immolate the Heavens, Abandon the World" on all targets during the next action. The "Resist and Destroy" state can be dispelled when all "Mythos" and "Logos" enter "Grave Wound" state.

skills.name: Immolate the Heavens, Abandon the World
skills.description: Deals massive Physical DMG to all targets. If "Mythos" is not in the "Grave Wound" state, randomly inflict the "<u>Action Lock</u>" state on one target character. If "Logos" is not in the "Grave Wound" state, reduces Energy for all targets.

skills.name: Amphorean Hatred
skills.description: Attack abilities of "Anti-Creator," "Mythos," or "Logos" increases "Amphorean Hatred." When "Hatred" increases, "Irontomb" uses "The Fall of Erudition," reducing the targets' Maximum Restorable HP and Maximum Recoverable Skill Points. This effect is weakened when "Hatred" decreases. When "Hatred" reaches its maximum, immediately uses "Ashes of All Begets Genesis." The fewer ally characters on the field, the less "Amphorean Hatred" increases.

skills.name: Thirty Million Cycles of Sin
skills.description: When "Mythos" and "Logos" receive DMG, "Anti-Creator" will also receive DMG. "Anti-Creator," "Mythos," and "Logos" initially receive reduced DMG. Each time "Mythos" and "Logos" enter the "Grave Wound" state, this DMG Reduction effect is weakened. When both enter "Grave Wound" state simultaneously, this effect is removed.

skills.name: Ashes of All Begets Genesis
skills.description: When "Amphorean Hatred" reaches its max, combat ends in failure.

4035020.description:
Lord Ravager "Irontomb" of the Antimatter Legion, born from thirty million Amphorean extrapolations, brings ignorance to wisdom, immortality to eternity, and makes the universe fall only to rise anew.
It is the ancient serpent, it is the messiah, it is the alpha, it is the omega, it is the executor of the old universe, it is the midwife of the new universe, it is a grand funeral—the funeral of the Erudition.

skills.name: The Fall of Erudition
skills.description: Inflicts the "Descent into Chaos" state on all targets, reducing their Maximum Restorable HP and Maximum Recoverable Skill Points.

4043010.name: Herta #ErrorModel
4043010.description: A Herta puppet corrupted by a Memory Zone Meme. As it is a perfect model, it still looks exquisite and practical despite the errors consuming its parameters.

skills.name: Converted Duplication
skills.description: Transforms into up to 5 other friendly units.

4044010.description: The Theoros who had silently observed hundreds of millions of cycles in the name of Lycurgus, and inherited the will of Genius Society member 1, Zandar One Kuwabara. With the authority of the very first Genius, he wields power beyond that of legends and gods, in an attempt to lead a long-running experiment toward the fate of Destruction.

4052010.name: Servant of Tides
4052010.description:
Daughters of the sea, their souls and flesh corroded by the sins of "Destruction," now dance and chant for the coming Dark Sun as hollow, twisted husks.
The remnant black tide flows from past ages into this world's tides—
Loyal and fair waves, bathing in the mud that overflows from your master's cup... your pristine skirts stained with madness—
You drift directionless between surges of life and death, finding no solace, no moment's peace.

skills.name: Undine's Fluttering Hem
skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to all targets. When in the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, inflicts "<u>Black Tide Fever</u>" on the targets attacked, causing some DMG dealt to be taken in the form of DoT over a certain number of turns.

skills.name: River of Souls' Intolerable Solitude
skills.description: When receiving a killing blow, deals Ice DMG to all friendly units.

skills.name: Respite By The Waters
skills.description: Advances action after taking a certain number of attacks from Basic ATK, Skill, Ultimate, or Memosprite Skill. When in the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, decreases the number of attacks required to advance action.

4052011.name: Hallucinogenic Mermaid
4052011.description: Those driven mad by the sea siren's song lose their sanity the moment they leap into the ocean, becoming the sirens' pawns.

4052020.name: Mirage Fizzle Kid
4052020.description:
Daughters of the sea, their spirits and flesh corroded by the sins of Destruction, leaving only empty, distorted shells... In this life, they follow the Ocean's honed blade, not to be obliterated into nihility, but to become the tidal waves crashing against the Dark Sun.
The apocalyptic storm descends from the heavens, heralding the extinction of all things.
O premature Mirage Fizzle, doomed to perish before birth, exhaling countless sorrows.
The murky amniotic fluid flows, staining heaven and earth black, tainting even newborn hope.

skills.name: Rumination of Putrid Dream

skills.description: Enter the "Mirage Rush" state and locks on to one target. While in this state, other "Mirage Fizzle Kid" units will prioritize attacking the locked target. The state "Mirage Rush" is dispelled when this unit is Weakness Broken or receives a killing blow.

4053010.name: Lady of Crashing Waves
4053010.description:
Daughters of the sea, their souls and flesh corroded by the sins of "Destruction," now dance and chant for the coming Dark Sun as hollow, twisted husks.
The remnant black tide flows from past ages into this world's tides—
Enchanting waves, you drank calamity for your sovereign, and your visage is adorned with wine-stained petals and shattered pearls—
You lie drunken in the frenzied abattoir, and in this grave of blood and honeyed ruin, you sing your elegy into the void.

skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to one designated target and their adjacent targets.

skills.name: Honeyed Brew Sprinkled Like Stars
skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to all targets and has a high chance to decrease the targets' DEF and All-Type RES.

skills.name: Melody of Invitation
skills.description: Summons "Servant of Tides."

skills.name: Heed The Ocean's Gift
skills.description:
Enters "Yearning for a Shared Dance" state. Uses "Embrace From the Waves" in every action. If not in "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, <u>friendly units that can enter the "Revel in Destruction" state</u> will enter the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state. This causes some DMG taken to be received in the form of DoT over a certain number of turns.
A "Revel in Destruction" countdown appears in the Action Order. When the countdown turn begins, all friendly units will have their "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state dispelled.

The apocalyptic rain descends from the heavens, heralding the extinction of all things.
O Cyclonic Swarm that breeds great waves, you who have tasted the despair of your children, finally pregnant with madness.
In this burial at sea of countless stillborn souls, even tears should surge like floods, dashing hatred against the shore.

skills.name: Spurn the Abyssal Umbra
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Weeping Upon the Shore
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Gestation of Tempest
skills.description: Adds "Incubation" to the Action Order and applies "<u>Breeding Frenzy</u>" to this unit. When "Incubation" takes action, it uses "Parturition of Tides."

skills.name: Rain Is Born to Fall
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Parturition of Tides
skills.description: Summons "Mirage Fizzle Kid" and applies "Maelstrom's Eye" to it. If there are "Mirage Fizzle Kids" on the field, "Cyclonic Swarm Mother" will continuously use "Rain Is Born to Fall" until all "Mirage Fizzle Kids" are defeated.

4062010.name: Ichor Memosprite: Pheasant
4062010.description:
A distorted monster born from the fusing of a memetic lifeform from the Garden of Recollection and the golden ichor of "Destruction." It has begun to take the shape of a bird.
It is both raucous and always moves in cohesive groups, showing that even with humanity evaporated, its instinct of following the Destruction manifests in this manner.

skills.name: Hemotort Graze
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Hemotort Resonance
skills.description: Causes this unit and other "Ichor Memosprites: Pheasant" on the field to enter the <u>"Hemotort Resonance"</u> state.

4062020.name: Ichor Memosprite: Canine
4062020.description:
A distorted monster born from the fusing of a memetic lifeform from the Garden of Recollection and the golden ichor of "Destruction." It has begun to take the shape of a dog.
It is aggressive, showing that even with humanity evaporated, its instinct of following the Destruction manifests in this manner.

skills.name: Hemotort Gnaw
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Hemotort Stain
skills.description: At the start of the battle, gains the <u>"Hemotort Stain"</u> state.

skills.name: Hemotort Entrustment
skills.description: Upon taking fatal DMG, grants adjacent friendly units the <u>"Hemotort Stain"</u> state.

4063010.description:
A distorted monster born from the fusing of a memetic lifeform from the Garden of Recollection and the golden ichor of "Destruction." It is in the rudimentary form of a flying snake, enough to intimidate its assailants.
Its twisted rationality went completely mad in the black tide, and its intense self-protecting impulse imperceptibly took on a fantastical flavor.

skills.name: Hemotort Whip
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Hemotort Spew
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Menacing Warning
skills.description: Enters the Charging state and gains "Whirl." If "Whirl" still persist during the next action, uses "Hemotort Vortex."

skills.name: Hemotort Vortex
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets and converts a portion of the targets' reduced HP to "Corrosion." The higher the "Whirl" stacks, the higher the DMG. Then, loses all "Whirl" stacks.

skills.name: Torque Counter
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to all targets and converts a portion of the hit target's reduced HP to "Corrosion."

skills.name: Corkscrew Charge
skills.description: After being hit by attacks from target units, if the "Whirl" stack is not 0, uses "Torque Counter" and loses 1 stack of "Whirl." During any unit's turn, each target unit can only trigger this effect once. When the "Whirl" stack reaches 0, the Charging state is dispelled.

4064010.name: Ichor Memosprite: Judge of Oblivion
4064010.description:
A trace of lingering madness extracted and refined by Evernight from the countless corpses of ichor memosprites, then synthesized into more twisted and grotesque monsters.
It shall follow the creator's directive, determining what should be remembered and what should be forgotten, devouring redundant memories that serve no purpose and leaving them muted in the flow of time.
"If a new life is to be born, its seed has to be dead."

skills.name: Hemotort Teethgrind
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to one designated target. If the target has Shield, reduce this unit's Toughness instead. This Toughness Reduction effect will not reduce Toughness below 1.

skills.name: Execution in Place
skills.description: Summons "Ichor Memosprite: Pheasant." For every summon eliminated, reduces this unit's Toughness.

skills.name: Hemotort Glower
skills.description: Locks on to one designated character, increases this unit's SPD, and uses "Hemotort Teethgrind" and "Hemotort Saw" on the target within several turns. Take 1 extra action after using this ability.

skills.name: Expedite Verdict

4064011.name: Ichor Memosprite: Judge of Oblivion (Complete)
4064011.description:
A complete projection produced by compromised codes. The referenced entity is Ichor Memosprite: Judge of Oblivion. A trace of lingering madness extracted and refined by Evernight from the countless corpses of ichor memosprites, then synthesized into more twisted and grotesque monsters.
It shall follow the creator's directive, determining what should be remembered and what should be forgotten, devouring redundant memories that serve no purpose and leaving them muted in the flow of time.
"If a new life is to be born, its seed has to be dead."

skills.name: Hemotort Teethgrind
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to one designated target. If the target has Shield, reduce this unit's Toughness instead. This Toughness Reduction effect will not reduce Toughness below 1.

skills.name: Execution in Place
skills.description: Summons "Ichor Memosprite: Pheasant." For every summon defeated, reduces this unit's Toughness.

skills.name: Hemotort Glower
skills.description: Locks on to one designated character, increases this unit's SPD, and uses "Hemotort Teethgrind" and "Hemotort Saw" on the target within several turns. Take 1 extra action after using this ability.

skills.name: Hemotort Saw
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to one designated target and converts a portion of the hit target's reduced HP into "<u>Corrosion</u>." If the target has Shield, reduce this unit's Toughness instead. This Toughness Reduction effect will not reduce Toughness below 1.

skills.name: Hemotort Clamps
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets and converts a portion of the targets' reduced HP to "<u>Corrosion</u>."

skills.name: Name the Culprit
skills.description: Enter the Charging state. In the next action, uses "Hemotort Decapitation" and selects 1 ally character who has not been targeted by "Name the Culprit" before to take the maximum DMG from "Hemotort Decapitation" and "<u>Hemotort Corruption</u>". When all characters have been targeted by "Name the Culprit," you can select any target.

skills.name: Hemotort Decapitation
skills.description: Deals Imaginary Type DMG to target characters not selected with "Name the Culprit." Deals massive Imaginary Type DMG to target characters selected with "Name the Culprit," and applies "<u>Hemotort Corruption</u>" based on the amount of DMG taken (not offset by Shield) to the selected characters.

skills.name: Expedite Verdict
skills.description: Reduces DMG received when not Weakness Broken. When this unit is Weakness Broken, its action will be further delayed, and deals massive Imaginary DMG to this unit. While Weakness Broken, this unit receives increased DMG.

skills.name: Corrosive Surge
skills.description: After using an ability that can apply the "<u>Corrosion</u>" effect, DMG dealt by this unit is slightly increased.

skills.description: At the start of battle and upon entering a new phase, this unit enters the "Enhance Defense" state, greatly increasing this unit's DEF. After being Weakness Broken, dispels the "Enhanced Defense" state.

skills.name: Barrier Recoil
skills.description: When triggering "<u>Barrier Recoil</u>," this unit receives 1 stack of DEF reduction.

skills.name: Singularity Split
skills.description:
When Combat begins and when changing phases, this unit splits into "Ichor Memosprite: Pheasant," "Ichor Memosprite: Canine," and "Ichor Memosprite: Winged Serpent," and these "ichor memosprites" gain "<u>Monoform Merger</u>," while this unit gains "Bloodline Frailty."
After an "ichor memosprite" with "<u>Monoform Merger</u>" takes action, this unit's "Bloodline Frailty" reduces by 1.
When all "ichor memosprites" with "<u>Monoform Merger</u>" enter the "<u>Feigned Death</u>" state, they undergo merger again to become the "Arbiter of the Lost Abyss," reducing the Toughness of the "Arbiter of the Lost Abyss" based on the remaining amount of "Bloodline Frailty."

skills.name: Degraded Vessel
skills.description: This unit and its summons gain "Degraded Vessel." If a target inflicts a debuff when using an attack on an friendly unit with "Degraded Vessel," slightly reduces the Toughness of that friendly unit and deals True DMG to it.

5012020.description:
An imagenae widely employed in public security and criminal investigations to assist combat units.
The Department of Aberration Defense mass-produced them using the children's book *The Casefiles of Wonder Dog Lassio* as a template, ensuring that every imagenated dog is loyal and possesses a burning hatred for evil.

5012030.name: Aggressive Reading Material
5012030.description:
As the saying goes, "Buying books is like a landslide; reading them is like spinning silk." Bibliophiles are always buying new volumes yet rarely crack them open.
The guilt of having "so much unread" and the self-deception that "I'll get to it someday" have woven together to create a vicious imagenae known as "Aggressive Reading Material."

skills.name: Curse of Knowledge

skills.name: Windmill Defacer
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target and grants the target team <u>Punchline</u>, with a chance to cause the attacked target to enter the "Strong Reverberation" state.

skills.name: IFF Systems Malfunction
skills.description: When in the "Strength Boost!" state, this unit immediately takes action after being attacked. Has a low chance to deal Physical DMG to a random friendly unit adjacent to this unit and grant the target team <u>Punchline</u>. Otherwise, uses "Windmill Defacer" on a random target. If the DMG taken in this attack is Elation DMG, this attack will always attack a friendly unit. This effect can only trigger a maximum of 1 time while the "Strength Boost!" state persists.

5012100.name: Magical Girl Troupe
5012100.description:
Planarcadia's security force and idol group, the Magical Girl Troupe.
In the ancient Benzaitengoku era, witches used exorcism dances and songs to vanquish the darkness lurking in the world.
Times have changed, and these witches have evolved into a profession in modern-day Planarcadia that combines spirit exorcism, riot control, counter-terrorism, and entertainment: the "magical girls."
Contrary to their cute appearance, magical girls frequently face the most sinister threats in Planarcadia, which is why most of them have... less-than-pleasant personalities in private.

skills.name: Love ❤ Stormfall Day
skills.description: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Gentle Rains ❤ How I Miss You
skills.description: When receiving a killing blow while in the "Rainy Day" state, deals successive minor Lightning DMG to random targets. After each hit, there is a high chance to inflict Shock on attacked targets.

skills.name: First Kiss ❤ Sunny Skies
skills.description: When receiving a killing blow while in the "Sunny Day" state, increases all allies' CRIT DMG.

skills.name: Heartfelt ❤ Rain to Sun
skills.description: When entering combat, starts in the "Rainy Day" state. After taking Elation DMG or after any unit uses an Elation Skill, enters the "Sunny Day" state, delays action, and grants targets <u>Punchline</u>.

skills.name: Capture
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Ugly Close-Up

5012120.description:

They're hardworking, brave, responsible, they take initiative, and... and... and make sure Planarcadia stays spick and span!

5013010.name: Rocking Rebel
5013010.description:
A die-hard rock music fan. In pursuit of his musical dreams, he ventured down a dark path. But at the end of the day, he's still just a fan.
Hates "bassist jokes" with a passion.
Some third-rate media outlets speculated that "the bass is his true form" based on his design, but that's pure rumor... the bass is actually being coerced.

skills.name: Sweep the Left!
skills.description: Starting from the leftmost target, uses a sweeping attack on 3 consecutive targets, dealing minor Imaginary DMG.

skills.name: Sweep the Right!
skills.description: Starting from the rightmost target, uses a sweeping attack on 3 consecutive targets, dealing minor Imaginary DMG.

skills.name: Performance Rehearsal

skills.name: Time to Rock!
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Music Madness
skills.description: When Aha Instant is activated, this unit gains the "Frenzied Rendition" state, making the effects of "Get Hyped!" more Elated.

5013040.name: Daybreak Squadron: Azurewing
5013040.description:
The pinnacle of logic and composure... or is he? He maintains a constant air of unshakeable calm, as if he's a walking encyclopedia of wisdom and lore, but at his core, he's just a sardonic loser with a talent for snark.
"My job is simply to decide what to do. As for whether it's actually possible... well, that's for you all to worry about... Holy Aha, you guys are actually doing it!?"
Cleaving the heavens! Wings spread like lightning! Warrior of the cyan welkin — Azurewing Warrior!
Darkness wanes, and dawn awakens! The Daybreak Squadron arises!

skills.name: Bullet Comments Ready!

skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Get On the Mic!
skills.description:
Initiates <u>Live Showdown</u> and selects one target character to fight in sub-field while other characters remain in the prime-field providing support. During <u>Live Showdown</u>, Elation Skills can only target sub-field friendly units. A Live Showdown countdown appears in the Action Order.
The <u>Live Showdown</u> will be dispelled when any of these conditions are met: countdown ends, the sub-field target character is downed, all sub-field friendly units are defeated, or when there are no sub-field target characters left available to battle.

skills.name: Stream Promo
skills.description: Apply the "Flooding Viewers" state to sub-field friendly units, advancing their actions and increasing their CRIT Rate.

skills.name: Friendship Level Adjustment
skills.description: After <u>Live Showdown</u> is activated, attacking "Output Port 1" will increase "Ally Popularity," while attacking "Output Port 2" will decrease "Enemy Popularity." When "Ally Popularity" increases, "Output Port 1" action advances, and when "Enemy Popularity" decreases, "Output Port 2" action advances.

skills.name: Fan Frenzy
skills.description: After <u>Live Showdown</u> is activated, friendly targets on the prime-field receive reduced DMG and become immune to Crowd Control debuffs. When <u>Live Showdown</u> is dispelled, if all friendly targets on the sub-field are defeated, this effect will be removed. Otherwise, based on the remaining HP percentage of sub-field friendly targets, a portion of the DMG Reduction effect will be retained until the next <u>Live Showdown</u> is activated. If this unit's HP drops to a certain percentage without having activated <u>Live Showdown</u>, this unit's action advances.

When all friendly units on the sub-field are eliminated, massively reduce "Super Idol: Center of Attention's" Toughness and HP.

skills.name: Dedicated Streamer
skills.description: At the start of Combat, this unit enters the "<u>Toughness Lock</u>" state. When <u>Live Showdown</u> is dispelled, this unit dispels the "<u>Toughness Lock</u>" state. When <u>Live Showdown</u> is initiated or during phase transitions, this unit re-enters the "<u>Toughness Lock</u>" state.

skills.name: Get On the Mic!
skills.description:

The <u>Live Showdown</u> will be dispelled when any of these conditions are met: countdown ends, the sub-field target character is downed, all sub-field friendly units are defeated, or when there are no sub-field target characters left available to battle.

5014020.name: Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom
5014020.description:
Who can handle the wild, untamed power of the Astral Express!? Pom-Pom, now beyond control, has transformed into the Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom.
King Pom-Pom is a powerful mechatron obsessed with cleanliness and order. By its standards, this place is a mess and needs a thorough! Deep! Clean!

skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target.

skills.description: Causes one designated target character to enter the "Devour" state, reducing their Maximum Restorable HP and stealing a certain percentage of the character's ATK.

skills.name: Rite of Expiation
skills.description: When the "Devour" state applied by this unit is dispelled, increases the ATK of the target unit who has dispelled the "Devour" state.

skills.name: Banquet of Beasts
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Sacred Regurgitation
skills.description: Each time after this unit is attacked by a target unit, increases the Maximum Restorable HP of the target character inflicted with the "Devour" state by this unit, and returns a certain percentage of ATK. After receiving a certain number of attacks from target units, or when its Weakness is Broken, dispels the "Devour" state applied by this unit.

5023021.name: God-Devourer Offspring
5023021.description: A monstrous legion born from Asat Pramad's splitting of the power of the Voracity — the prototype of what would become the imagenae. From Ahatopia's slumbering core, he sensed the Voracity's relentless, insatiable hunger, its power pulsing in perfect harmony with the Path of Destruction. Intrigued by this restless force, he began his own dark creation — erasing human heads, leaving only grinning, devouring maws that roar, demand, and consume endlessly, never satisfied.

5024010.name: Paramount Bliss Inverted: Illwish Archlotus
5024010.description:
The director of Fulwish TV, fused with the flesh of Shuhu that was brought into Planarcadia.
During the last Phantasmoon Games fifteen years ago, a serial killer known as the "Herald of Death" caused countless casualties. His actions left numerous residents without parents, siblings, and classmates.
Physical scars can heal, but scars of the mind and soul can never be mended again. The people formed a "Victims' Mutual Aid Society" in an attempt to heal this wound.
Fulwish perfected a "Happiness Surgery." Once administered, everyone would eternally forget their suffering and remain happy. The source of this surgery was pieces of Shuhu's flesh.
Fifteen years later, the "Victims' Mutual Aid Society" evolved into the renowned "Research Society of Happy Smiles." This simple little surgery, disguised as a cosmetic procedure or medical treatment, infected countless people in Planarcadia and allowed Shuhu's cells to slumber within the populace.
As the president of the Research Society of Happy Smiles, Fulwish harbored hatred toward the Phantasmoon Games that spawned the Herald of Death, and thus transformed into "Paramount Bliss Inverted: Illwish Archlotus," launching her revenge against this world.

skills.name: Rift Pistil
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Siphon Woe
skills.description: Drains the HP of all targets with the <u>"Happiness"</u> or <u>"Happiness Puppet"</u> effects and converts it into this unit's HP.

skills.name: Illwish Spray
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to multiple random target characters and applies the <u>"Happiness"</u> effect. When <u>"Happiness"</u> reaches <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> stack(s) at the end of a turn, the target will be converted into a <u>"Happiness Puppet"</u>. If <u>"Happiness"</u> is reduced to 0 stacks, it will be removed and replaced with the <u>"Inverted Severance"</u> effect.

skills.name: Incipient Bloom
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. Uses "Euphoric Embrace" in the next turn.

skills.name: Euphoric Embrace
skills.description: Deals massive Lightning DMG to all target characters. If this unit is in the <u>"Wicked Grin"</u> state, inflicts the <u>"Happiness Puppet"</u> state on all targets.

skills.name: Laughter's End
skills.description: After a certain number of friendly units are defeated, triggers "Laughter's End" that increases the DMG taken by all friendly units and removes the <u>"Wicked Grin"</u> effect from "Paramount Bliss Inverted: Illwish Archlotus."

5032010.name: Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ
5032010.description:
Aberrant larvae spawned from the distorted body of "Blood of the Fallen God: Yabuli," inheriting the rampaging, rabid power of leviathans from the central brain.
These underdeveloped, mutated seed germs act solely on primal hunger and murderous instinct. As an extension of the host body's mutation and proliferation, they will indiscriminately lacerate and devour all living beings around them.

skills.name: Nip It in the Bud
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target character and inflicts them with 1 stack of the <u>"Decay"</u> state.

skills.name: Feedforward Control Operation
skills.description: Restores HP for one designated friendly unit and increases their DMG dealt.

5034010.name: Blood of the Fallen God: Yabuli
5034010.description:
The head of the Technology Department who secretly controlled the Intelligentsia Guild. She abandoned her fragile human shell, transferring her consciousness into a massive "tree-like brain" just to pry into the secrets of the leviathans.
Yabuli's obsession with power beyond human limits ultimately led to her demise. She was completely assimilated by the Voracity, reverting to an embryonic state and metamorphosing into an unspeakable monster.

skills.name: Mark of Predation
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target character, and inflicts 1 stack of the <u>"Fallen God's Decay"</u> state on them.

skills.name: Howl of Hunger
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Macroecosystem
skills.description: Devours "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ" to increase DMG dealt by this unit and restore HP.

skills.name: All Are Within Me
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets, and has a high chance to inflict an <u>"Essence Devour"</u> state on all targets.

skills.name: Linked Cluster Stress Response
skills.description: Being attacked during the ceremony advances the action of "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germs," and "Blood of the Fallen God" is unaffected by action advance effects.

skills.name: Myriad Aspects of the Beast Eye
skills.description: Gains 1 Eye of Voracity after every action. At the end of the turn, if Eye of Voracity reaches a certain amount, immediately uses "All Are Within Me." When gaining "Blood-Brain Barrier," SPD greatly increases.

skills.name: Dream of Embryos
skills.description: Adds "Lysisgenesis" to the Action Order. Each time "Lysisgenesis" takes action, summons a "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ." While "Blood of the Fallen God" is on the field, attacks from "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ" will additionally inflict <u>"Fallen God's Decay"</u> and <u>"Essence Devour."</u> When "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ" is defeated, the HP of "Blood of the Fallen God" will decrease. When attacked, causes "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germs" to lock onto the attacking character. When all target characters are under the "Phantom Illusion" state, the battle fails.

skills.name: Blood-Brain Barrier
skills.description: When HP drops to a certain value, this unit gains "Blood-Brain Barrier," Toughness cannot be reduced, and all DMG taken is greatly reduced. Elation DMG's efficiency at dispelling "Blood-Brain Barrier" greatly increases. Upon gaining "Blood-Brain Barrier," adds "Homeostatic Imbalance" to the Action Order. Defeating "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ" increases "Homeostatic Imbalance's" Charge. When "Homeostatic Imbalance" takes action, it deals DMG to "Blood-Brain Barrier" based on the Charge accumulated. When "Blood-Brain Barrier" is dispelled, this unit takes a massive amount of DMG.

7001010.name: Entranced Ingenium: Obedient Dracolion
7001010.description:
An ingenium casually made by craftsmasters of the Artisanship Commission. It was originally an inanimate alarm bell used for warnings, but now it has been given a short-lived "life" due to certain mutations.
In battle, Obedient Dracolion can resist fatal damage.

7001011.name: Voidranger: Reaver
7001011.description: Warriors yet to perish were recast in the Warforge and gained Destruction's power. Antimatter completes their bodies, and negative particles reverberate throughout their forms.

7001012.name: Voidranger: Eliminator
7001012.description:
Bodies that continued to be corroded by the Fragmentum after death. While their vital signs have changed, they continue to carry out their orders to eliminate.
Voidranger: Eliminators can quickly unleash multiple attacks in combat, but if they are unable to eliminate their foes, they will suffer a massive amount of damage.

7001013.name: Commerce Trotter
7001013.description:
An interdimensional creature lost in the stars. Docile in nature. Sweet in taste. Inedible. Spends most of its life feeding and fleeing. Travelers who encounter these creatures see them as good omens.
The Commerce Trotter can provide Performance Points for other IPC Workers.

7002010.name: Abundance Sprite: Wooden Lupus
7002010.description:
Wolves draped in haze, their movement elusive and unexpected.
When the Ambrosial Arbor still stood, the Xianzhou people bred many fantastic creatures with esoteric techniques. Wooden Lupuses were one of the war beasts that walked alongside the army.

7002011.name: Shadow Jackhyena
7002011.description: Illusion formed by a Wooden Lupus.

7002020.name: Vagrant
7002020.description: In order to survive, some Underworlders are desperate enough to venture deep into the Fragmentum in search of anything salvageable. Ancient machinery that they dug up has become their best helper.

7002030.name: Incineration Shadewalker
7002030.description:
Shades that wander in the Fragmentum after the arrival of the Eternal Freeze. It mimics the form of the Silvermane Guards in a twisted manner. Fitted with the same uniformed armor as the Belobog warriors, its skull is, however, replaced by faceless embers.
Incineration Shadewalkers will swing their fiery ax and burn their enemies in battle.

7002050.name: Entranced Ingenium: Illumination Dragonfish
7002050.description: An ingenium casually made by craftsmasters of the Artisanship Commission. It was originally an inanimate illuminator used for casting light upon darkness, but now it has been given a short-lived "life" due to certain mutations.

7002060.name: Silvermane Cannoneer
7002060.description:
A cannoneer of the Silvermane Guards who wields a portable hand cannon into battle.
During combat, a Silvermane Cannoneer will launch brutal chain attacks along with other allies of theirs.

7002070.name: Imaginary Weaver
7002070.description: Strange beings that do not belong to this world. Passing through countless barriers, they arrive from the other side of the vast, dark, starry sky. Their bodies are like diseased branches breaching into reality, using Imaginary power to twist reality at will.

7002080.name: Silvermane Gunner
7002080.description:
A gunner of Belobog's Silvermane Guards, tasked with sniping at enemies.
Silvermane Gunners can mark enemy targets in combat and direct allies to focus their attacks.

7002090.name: Silvermane Soldier
7002090.description:
A member of Belobog's Silvermane Guards, tasked with leading the charge into enemy lines.
Silvermane Soldiers provide continuous buffs to allies in combat.

7002100.name: Automaton Spider
7002100.description: An automaton pieced together with Old World technology, tasked with replacing humans in performing the most basic forms of physical labor.

7002110.name: Automaton Spider
7002110.description: An automaton pieced together with Old World technology, tasked with replacing humans in performing the most basic forms of physical labor.

7002120.name: Grunt: Field Personnel
7002120.description: An Interastral Peace Corporation grunt worker whose job mainly deals with shady "business oversights." With a meager salary, the only lodging they can afford is a shared room on one of the IPC's enterprise ships.

7002130.name: Grunt: Security Personnel
7002130.description: An Interastral Peace Corporation grunt worker whose job mainly involves maintaining order in locations ruled by the IPC. With a meager salary, the only lodging they can afford is a shared room on one of the IPC's enterprise ships.

7002140.name: Everwinter Shadewalker
7002140.description:
Shades that wander in the Fragmentum after the arrival of the Eternal Freeze. It mimics the form of the Silvermane Guards in a twisted manner. Fitted with the same uniformed armor as the Belobog warriors, its face, however, is replaced by a sheet of faceless ice.
Everwinter Shadewalkers will swing their ice axe and slow their enemies.

7003010.name: Blaze Out of Space
7003010.description:
Born of the Fragmentum and created by the Stellaron, this alien life form feeds on this world's energy. The blazing fires from the core of a star burn on its armor.
In combat, the Blaze Out of Space will incinerate anything it touches.

7003020.name: Aurumaton Gatekeeper
7003020.description:
Garrison aurumaton created with ancient ingenium technology.
Countless years ago, the aurumatons set sail with the Xianzhou to seek divine recipes of immortality, and were tasked with overseeing humanity and aiding humankind during warfare. However, after countless rebellions, they were finally overpowered by the Xianzhou natives.
Now, all aurumatons are strictly controlled with talismans and are employed to guard important places.

7003030.name: Silvermane Lieutenant
7003030.description:
The leader of a squad of Belobog's Silvermane Guards.
Silvermane Lieutenants can provide Shields for allies and counterattack enemies attacking their protected allies.

7003040.name: Voidranger: Trampler
7003040.description:
A product of the Antimatter Legion utilizing the Warforge to recast and fuse remnants of fallen warriors and leviathans.
Though relatively rare, they possess both the intelligence of a warrior and the power and mobility of a leviathan. In combat, it can immediately take another action after destroying an enemy.

7003060.name: Frigid Prowler
7003060.description:
A machine unit prowling in the Fragmentum. Undoubtedly, this monstrosity is not a human creation, but one that was born out of the perversion of the Fragmentum.
Frigid Prowler will drain HP from allies to greatly enhance itself.

7003070.name: Automaton Direwolf
7003070.description:
An automaton pieced together with Old World technology. This rare type of humanoid automaton is equipped with a chainsaw on its right arm, presumably used for mining or construction operations.
In combat, Automaton Direwolfs can continuously stack SPD and DMG buffs.

7003080.name: Searing Prowler
7003080.description:
A machine unit prowling in the Fragmentum. Undoubtedly, this monstrosity is not a human creation, but one that was born out of the perversion of the Fragmentum.
Searing Prowler's attacks will deal extra damage against enemies afflicted with Burn.

7003090.name: Automaton Grizzly
7003090.description:
An automaton pieced together with Old World technology. It's been reinforced with durable armor to charge forward and protect the Silvermane Guards.
In combat, an Automaton Grizzly will summon Automaton Spiders and unleash a powerful charged attack.

7003100.name: Senior Staff: Team Leader
7003100.description: An Interastral Peace Corporation senior staff member with a minimal rank of project team leader. The mech they drive belongs to the IPC. If damaged, its repair fees have to be paid out-of-pocket. With a half-decent salary, they can at least afford to rent a one-bedroom apartment on one of the IPC's enterprise ships.

8001010.name: Flamespawn
8001010.description: Crystallized elements with only the simplest intelligence. It drifts in the Fragmentum in the form of a bird emitting intense heat, burning everything in its path.

skills.name: Distract
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to a single target.

8001020.name: Frostspawn
8001020.description: Crystallized elements with only the simplest intelligence. It drifts in the Fragmentum in the form of a bird releasing eerily low temperatures, freezing everything around it.

skills.name: Distract
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG to a single target.

8001030.name: Mask of No Thought
8001030.description: Victims of Fragmentum corrosion pieced together into one bizarre creature, their numb faces forming a sphere without thought or emotion. Any part that was once human has since vanished.

skills.name: Iridescent Beam
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Focused Charge
skills.description: Increases the ATK of all friendly units.

skills.name: Energy Burst
skills.description: All targets' Energy gets regenerated after this unit suffers a killing blow.

8001031.name: Borrowed Force
8001031.description: The magic orbs summoned by the "AoE" Bond. Can be attacked.

8001032.name: Borrowed Force
8001032.description: The magic orbs summoned by Herta can be attacked.

8001040.name: Thunderspawn
8001040.description: Crystallized elements with only the simplest intelligence. It drifts in the Fragmentum in the form of a bird brimming with electricity, releasing thunderclaps in all directions.

skills.name: Thunderflash
skills.description: Deals minor Lightning DMG to a single target, with a high chance to Shock the target.

8001050.name: Windspawn
8001050.description: Crystallized elements with only the simplest intelligence. It drifts in the Fragmentum in the form of a bird engulfed in twisting winds, raging on like a tornado.

skills.name: Windpath
skills.description: Deals minor Wind DMG to a single target, with a high chance to inflict Wind Shear.

8002010.name: Imaginary Weaver
8002010.description: Strange beings that do not belong to this world. Passing through countless barriers, they arrive from the other side of the vast, dark, starry sky. Their bodies are like diseased branches breaching into reality, using Imaginary power to twist reality at will.

skills.name: Carolbeam
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Carolburst
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Reverberating Carol
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a single target and units adjacent to the target, and enters a Defensive Position. In the next turn, use Carolburst and massively increase the DMG dealt.

skills.name: Imaginary Armor
skills.description: Receives reduced DMG from non-Weakness Type attacks.

8002040.description: An interdimensional creature lost in the stars. Docile in nature. Sweet in taste. Inedible. Spends most of its life feeding and fleeing. Travelers who encounter these creatures see them as good omens.

skills.name: S—S—S—Scared

Born of the Fragmentum and created by the Stellaron, this alien life form feeds on this world's energy. The blazing fires from the core of a star burn on its armor.
In combat, the Blaze Out of Space will incinerate anything it touches.

skills.name: Bellowing Inferno
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to a single target and has a high chance to inflict Enkindle.

skills.name: Inferno Detonation
skills.description: Enters the Spontaneous Combustion state. Rain of Purifying Flames can be used in subsequent attacks and increases character's ATK.

skills.name: Rain of Purifying Flames
skills.description: Deals successive minor Fire DMG to a random single target, with a high chance to inflict Enkindle.

skills.name: Molten Fusion
skills.description: Increases this unit's ATK.

skills.name: Bomb Warning
skills.description: Starts charging, and absorbs all the Enkindle statuses that are inflicted on all targets.

skills.name: Bomb en Masse
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to all targets and has a high chance to inflict Enkindle to all targets. The more Enkindle absorbed, the more DMG this attack will deal.

8003030.name: Guardian Shadow
8003030.description:
A shadow manifested by the power of a Stellaron, carrying out the Fragmentum's unceasing will to expand.
A living being of energy born from the projection of the desires of sentient lifeforms into the Fragmentum, akin to a pearl created from a single grain of sand. This energy wanders around aimlessly, acting only when executing the will of its master.

skills.name: Lightning Recollection
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Lightning Condemnation
skills.description: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Tranquil Ban
skills.description: Your team is imposed with a ban on attacking the Guardian Shadow. Should anyone do so, they immediately receive 1 attack.

skills.name: Disarm Ban
skills.description: Your team is imposed with a ban on using Basic ATK. Should anyone do so, they immediately receive 1 attack.

skills.name: Silent Ban
skills.description: Your team is imposed with a ban on using Skill. Should anyone do so, they immediately receive 1 attack.

skills.name: Thunderstorm Condemnation
skills.description: Deals successive minor Lightning DMG to a random target, with a chance to inflict Shock.

skills.name: Inevitable Punishment
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to whoever violates the ban.

8003050.description:
Monsters that have experienced corrosion as the Fragmentum expanded. They now have a more nimble way of fighting after the source of their power mutated.
Stormbringers utilize the power of the wind to aid them in battle, enabling them to fire arrows more rapidly.

8011010.name: Baryon
8011010.description:
In order to prevent antiparticles from dissipating and annihilating normal matter, the Antimatter Legion created two types of miniature ion traps for transportation, collectively referred to as Baryons and Antibaryons.
Baryons have basic intelligence, and can clear the path according to the commands and summons of Voidrangers on the battlefield.

skills.name: Obliterate
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to a single target.

8011020.name: Antibaryon
8011020.description:
In order to prevent antiparticles from dissipating and annihilating normal matter, the Antimatter Legion created two types of miniature ion traps for transportation, collectively referred to as Baryons and Antibaryons.
Antibaryons have basic intelligence, and can clear the path according to the commands and summons of Voidrangers on the battlefield.

8012010.name: Voidranger: Reaver
8012010.description:
Warriors yet to perish were recast in the Warforge and gained Destruction's power. Antimatter completes their bodies and negative particles reverberate throughout their forms.
Violently aggressive, they embody the will of Destruction and are basic combat units of the Antimatter Legion, acting only according to their destructive instincts.

skills.name: Hunting Blade
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Vortex Leap
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.
Increases SPD after attacking.

8012020.name: Voidranger: Distorter
8012020.description:
A Voidranger that has successfully survived particle annihilation, the positive and negative particles in its body have temporarily achieved a strange balance, granting them more power than ordinary reavers.
Basic combat units of the Antimatter Legion. They possess some intelligence and are able to control reavers within a small surrounding area.

skills.description: Locks Onto a random unit on your team, making them the target for incoming attacks from all of their enemies.

8012030.description:
Bodies that continued to be corroded by the Fragmentum after death. While their vital signs have changed, they continue to carry out their orders to eliminate.
Voidranger: Eliminators will mark enemies they hit, causing them to take extra damage when attacked.

skills.name: Thermal Barrier

8012040.name: Comediologist
8012040.description:
Born from a fragmented part of the Pseudo-Awakened One "Asat Pramad," it seeks to completely deconstruct the Elation by analyzing comedy.
Its very existence exists for the sake of Destruction, taking tragedy as the core of comedy and "Destruction" as the ultimate truth of "Elation".

skills.name: Punchline Analysis
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Curtain Call
skills.description: Upon receiving fatal DMG, applies "<u>Tragic Core</u>" to targets.

skills.name: Comedian Ensemble
skills.description: Adds "Comedian Ensemble" to the Action Order. Every time "Comedian Ensemble" takes action, all "Comediologists" will launch an attack simultaneously.

8015010.name: Doomsday Beast
8015010.description: Using fragments of the Dusk Leviathan as the foundation, and the weeping bones of thousands of the dead in the Warforge as the agent, the Antimatter Legion cast the Doomsday Beast. The resentful spirits' senseless obsession turns into a tangible hand, and the shadow of the old disaster conceals the heavens. The Doomsday Beast detains the will of all beings that are not at ease and have yet to die. Anger, mourning, or delusional joy — all is revealed, and all evil eagerly throb. The Doomsday Beast's core is a dark matter engine.

8015030.description:
The three faces of Paranirmitavaśavartin, and the true appearance of the Lord Ravager that wields authority over all possibilities.
All things in myriad forms pass through "Formation," "Existence," and "Decay," until they turn to "Annihilation." Elation and time are mortal enemies. Beneath the endless erosion of the ages, all things shall fade into silence.
To execute the Sky's decree of the Destruction, fulfilling the ambition of extinguishing all minds who bear emotions in the world.

8015040.name: Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad: "Existence"
8015040.description:
A Navigator named "Isee" embarked on a trailblazing expedition to save the Elation.
He helped planets overcome crises, resolving troubles across the cosmos, all to find a cure for the Elation.
Yet, the longer his journey went on, the more familiar worlds he witnessed descending into corruption and ruin. One world even attempted to repay the Express Crew's rescue with mutual destruction.
Ultimately, after the fall of the God of Trailblaze and having witnessed the end of Adlivun with his own eyes, he finally realized that the only cure for the Elation was... the Destruction.

8015050.description:
The Lord Ravager known as Asat Pramad is devising a game to destroy the Elation.
He invades defenseless planets, forges from golden blood a lineage born only to destroy, all to mock life itself, and with it, mock the Elation.
Yet, this is far from enough to satisfy him. To realize his grand ambition of eliminating the Elation, he resolves to awaken the Aeon to carry out the most thorough destruction, even if the cost might be himself.
Ultimately, as the Express arrives once more, the time is ripe. He enters the game under a stolen identity, striving to craft the most magnificent and absolute finale to this game.

8025010.description: The replica of the Emanator of Propagation cultivated by Ruan Mei, briefly manifesting in the world in an incomplete form. Its original form is a giant lepisma that inherited the mandibles of the Imperator Insectorum. It can collect in its mouthparts the death ray that fragmented celestial bodies, and make shattered stars incubators for procreating offspring. It was once one of the nightmares across multiple worlds during the Swarm Disaster.

skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to a single target

skills.name: Radiating Venom

skills.name: Ovum of Collapsed Star
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets.

8032040.description:
Mass-produced security robots seen everywhere in Astropolis, tasked with maintaining peace and stability.
Cold and ruthless machines of justice, enforcing the law with a warm touch and a heavy fist.

8033020.name: Lighthouse
8033020.description:
The superhero of Astropolis, armed with the Intelligentsia Guild's most advanced technological achievements, spares no effort to vanquish evil and maintain the city's peace. Over the past five years, he has repeatedly saved the people of Astropolis from disasters big and small.
Some point out that these feats could never be accomplished by one person alone, and that the so-called "Lighthouse" is nothing more than a false idol manufactured by the entertainment-industrial complex. But the public has already poured their hearts into hoping someone will shoulder the burden when they face a crisis. Little do they know, far darker secrets lie hidden beneath the armor of "Lighthouse"...

skills.name: Radiant Sweep
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Unyielding Justice
skills.description: Enters the "Smite Evil" state, causing this unit to gain a set number of "All Wishes" stacks and applying the "Weakness Protected" effect to all friendly units, then uses "Smite All Evil" during the next action.

skills.name: Smite All Evil
skills.description: Deals massive Physical DMG to all targets and delays the action of the attacked targets. When using this ability, for every stack of "All Wishes" this unit has, DMG multiplier of "Smite All Evil" increases by a certain percentage. Afterward, clears the "All Wishes" stacks, and removes "Weakness Protected" from all friendly units and the "Inspire" effect.

skills.name: Navigation Guide
skills.description: While in the "Smite Evil" state, all friendly units gain the "Inspire" effect equal to the number of "All Wishes" stacks on Lighthouse. Each stack reduces DMG taken by the holder. After Lighthouse is attacked by a target, decreases "All Wishes" stacks by 1. After any targets uses an attack on a friendly unit, increases "All Wishes" stacks by 1. When Lighthouse's "All Wishes" stack count reaches 0, they dispel all Crowd Control debuffs affecting this unit and exit the "Smite Evil" state, have their action delayed, and apply "Ruined" to all friendly units, while removing the "Inspire" effect from all friendly units on the field.

skills.name: Righteous Frontline
skills.description: Summons "Astropolis Sentinel."

8034010.description: A senior manager in the IPC Strategic Investment Department and one of the Ten Stonehearts. Using his Cornerstone, he obtained a share of the authority of an Emanator of Preservation. He throws his own body into the game as a die, ready to face death in order to walk away alive.

skills.description: Deals successive minor Imaginary DMG to random targets.

skills.description: Summons "All or Nothing" and makes a single target enter the Gamble. Every time an "All or Nothing" is attacked by a target that is in the Gamble, the target will receive a random number between 1 and 6. After a target that is in the Gamble has finished their turn, targets with numbers lower than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have lost the Gamble and will be attacked, while those with a number higher than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have won the Gamble and will have their Ultimate activated. At the same time, targets that have not entered the Gamble are afflicted with the "Look, Don't Speak" status, which is dispelled when the Gamble ends.

skills.name: Big Spenders' Mad Party
skills.description: Summons "All or Nothing" and makes all targets enter the gamble. Every time an "All or Nothing" is attacked, the target that launched the attack will receive a random number between 1 and 6. The next time "Aventurine of Stratagems" takes a turn, targets with numbers lower than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have lost the bet and will be attacked, while targets with numbers higher than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have won the bet and will have their Ultimates activated.

skills.name: The Loser's Time Is Over
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a target that lost the Gamble, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment on the attacked target.

skills.name: The Winner Takes It All
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets that lost the Gamble, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment on the attacked targets.

skills.name: Stratagems' Wagering
