Each time the first "All or Nothing" is attacked, doubles the odds of the Gamble. The next time "Aventurine of Stratagems" takes a turn, targets with numbers lower than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have lost the bet and will be attacked, while targets with numbers higher than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have won the bet and will have their Ultimates activated.

skills.name: The Mad Abyss
skills.description: Summons "All or Nothing," multiplies the numbers received, and makes all targets enter the gamble. Every time an "All or Nothing" is attacked, the target that launched the attack will receive a random number between 1 and 6. When HP is reduced to 1, gains <u>Influx of Fortuity</u>. Each time the first "All or Nothing" is attacked, doubles the odds of the Gamble. The next time "Aventurine of Stratagems" takes a turn, if the sum of all targets' numbers is lower than that of "Aventurine of Stratagems," they are considered to have lost the bet and will be attacked. If the sum of all targets' numbers is higher than that of "Aventurine of Stratagems," they are considered to have won the bet and will have their Ultimates activated.

skills.name: The Loser's Time Is Over
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a target that lost the Gamble, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment on the attacked target.

skills.name: The Winner Takes It All
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets that lost the Gamble, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment on the attacked targets.

skills.name: Eyes Once Closed for Lies
skills.description: The initial odds for the gamble is 1, up to a maximum of 4. Every time a target wins the gamble, they receive a number of <u>Fenge's Gift</u> stacks equal to the odds. Every time a target loses the gamble, they receive a number of <u>Fenge's Curse</u> stacks equal to the odds.

skills.name: Eyes Twice Closed for Trickery
skills.description: The initial odds for the gamble is 1, up to a maximum of 8. Every time a target wins the gamble, they receive a number of <u>Fenge's Gift</u> stacks equal to the odds. Every time a target loses the gamble, they receive a number of <u>Fenge's Curse</u> stacks equal to the odds.

skills.name: Eyes Thrice Closed for Schemes
skills.description: The initial odds for the gamble is 1, up to a maximum of <unbreak>16</unbreak>. Every time a target wins the gamble, all targets receive a number of <u>Fenge's Gift</u> stacks equal to the odds. Every time a target loses the gamble, all targets receive a number of <u>Fenge's Curse</u> stacks equal to the odds.

skills.name: Deep in Debt
skills.description: Aventurine of Stratagems' DMG increases every time the gamble is initiated.

8034012.name: Daring Diceroller
8034012.description: A senior manager in the IPC Strategic Investment Department and one of the Ten Stonehearts. Using his Cornerstone, he obtained a share of the authority of an Emanator of Preservation. He throws his own body into the game as a die, ready to face death in order to walk away alive.

skills.name: Heavy Stakes
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Distributed Investment
skills.description: Deals successive minor Imaginary DMG to random targets.

skills.name: Profit Cut
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to all targets and reduce all targets' Energy. In Phase 2 of the battle, additionally reduces targets' Points.

skills.name: Time For A Bet
skills.description: Summons "All or Nothing" and makes a single target enter the Gamble. Every time an "All or Nothing" is attacked by a target that is in the Gamble, the target will receive a random number between 1 and 6. After a target that is in the Gamble has finished their turn, targets with numbers lower than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have lost the Gamble and will be attacked, while those with a number higher than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have won the Gamble and will have their Ultimate activated. At the same time, targets that have not entered the Gamble are afflicted with the "Look, Don't Speak" status, which is dispelled when the Gamble ends.

skills.name: Big Spenders' Mad Party
skills.description: Summons "All or Nothing" and makes all targets enter the gamble. Every time an "All or Nothing" is attacked, the target that launched the attack will receive a random number between 1 and 6. The next time "Aventurine of Stratagems" takes a turn, targets with numbers lower than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have lost the bet and will be attacked, while targets with numbers higher than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have won the bet and will have their Ultimates activated.

skills.name: The Loser's Time Is Over
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a target that lost the Gamble, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment on the attacked target.

skills.name: The Winner Takes It All
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets that lost the Gamble, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment on the attacked targets.

skills.name: Stratagems' Wagering
skills.description: Every time a target wins the Gamble, they receive the "Favored by Fortune" effect that increases their DMG dealt. Every time a target loses the Gamble, they receive the "Down on Your Luck" effect that increases DMG taken.3

skills.name: Betting the Flop
skills.description: Activate two "All or Nothing," locks on to a single target, and uses Daring Wager on the locked-on target in the next turn. Defeat all activated "All or Nothing" monsters to prevent the use of Daring Wager and to activate a single target's Ultimate.

skills.name: Go All In
skills.description: Activates all "All or Nothing" and uses Doomed to Lose in the next action. Defeat all activated "All or Nothing" to prevent the use of Doomed to Lose and to activate all targets' Ultimate.

skills.name: Daring Wager
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a single locked-on target and has a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment.

skills.name: Doomed to Lose
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets and has a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment.

skills.name: Points
skills.description: In the battle, all units gain a set number of Points that resets between Phases. When targets' Points are lower than friendly units', DMG received by friendly units is greatly reduced, and gains Toughness Protection. When targets' Points are equal to friendly units or more, DMG received by friendly units is increased.

skills.name: Call
skills.description: At the start of the Phase or when summons are defeated, summons up to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> "All or Nothing."

skills.name: Blind Bet
skills.description: At the start of the Phase or when summons are defeated, summons up to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> "All or Nothing" or "All or Nothing: Double Fortune."

100401001.name: Cocolia
100401001.description:
The Guardian of Belobog, and the indisputable ruler of the Towering Citadel, Belobog.
Cocolia possesses the divine authority passed down through the generations of Guardians, giving her command over ice and snow to freeze her enemies in battle.

phases.name: Phase I — Annihilator of Desolation Mistral
phases.description: Boss Mirage will use abilities to Freeze and deal DMG to targets. Gepard can Shield his team.
phases.answer: Strategy: Defeat the summons first. If Gepard uses a Collective Shield, quickly break the shield and defeat Gepard.

texts.description: Increase Effect RES or use abilities to dispel Freeze. Defeat summons to reduce the frequency of Boss Mirage Crowd controlling allies.

skills.name: Counters Boss Mirage's Weakness Type removal

texts.description: Defeating summons will cause the Weakness Type to be transferred back to Boss Mirage and inflict additional Toughness Reduction on it.
Gepard's Weakness can be broken to directly dispel his Shield. Quickly defeat Gepard to prevent him from using Collective Shield multiple times.

phases.name: Phase II — Annihilator of Desolation Mistral: Mother of Deception
phases.description: Boss Mirage will keep using Last Choir of Genesis to deal massive DMG to everyone, as well as abilities that will restrict the team's actions.
phases.answer: Strategy: After defeating the summons, quickly break Boss Mirage's Weakness.

texts.description: Increase Effect RES or use abilities to dispel Crowd Control statuses. Defeat summons to reduce the frequency of Boss Mirage Crowd controlling allies.

skills.name: Counters Boss Mirage's constant Last Choir of Genesis usage

texts.description: Quickly break Boss Mirage's Weakness to prevent it from using Last Choir of Genesis.

guides.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
When there is a summon present in the battle, Boss Mirage will <color=#f29e38ff>transfer its own Weakness Type to the summon</color>.

texts.description: After <color=#f29e38ff>Breaking</color> Boss Mirage, the DMG it receives is greatly increased, Skill Points are recovered for the team, and the team's action is Advanced Forward.
Defeat or break <color=#f29e38ff>summons</color> first to effectively weaken Boss Mirage.

100402201.name: Gepard (Complete)
100402201.description:
A complete projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is the leader of the Silvermane Guards.
Gepard (Complete) can command his soldiers to focus their attacks and offer soldiers a shield to block attacks.

skills.name: Fist of Conviction
skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Smite of Frost
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Garrison Aura Field
skills.description: Unleashes the Collective Shield and absorbs DMG taken by all friendly units, as well as preventing all friendly units from receiving damage to their Toughness.

skills.name: Frigid Waterfall
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG to all targets and slightly increases the DMG dealt. This DMG boosting effect is stackable.

skills.name: Besiege
skills.description: Gepard Locks On a single target, causing all friendly units to immediately launch coordinated attacks on the target.

skills.name: Tit for Tat
skills.description: Goes into the Counter state for 1 turn. If attacked by a target while in this state, immediately use "Smite of Frost" on the attacker. This effect can only be triggered 1 time.

skills.name: Support
skills.description: When the phase starts, immediately summons Silvermane Soldiers or Silvermane Cannoneers.

skills.name: Support
skills.description: When the phase starts, immediately summons Silvermane Cannoneers.

skills.name: Support
skills.description: When the phase starts, immediately summons Silvermane Lieutenant (Complete).

100501401.name: Annihilator of Desolation Mistral: Mother of Deception
100501401.description: After being assimilated by the overflowing Fragmentum energy of the Stellaron, the Supreme Guardian transforms into a chantress able to control Imaginary Energy and the mouthpiece of the Stellaron's promised "new world."

skills.name: Bone-Shattering Cold
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Harbinger of Annihilation
skills.description: Locks Onto a single target. The next action uses "Soulrend Coldstream."

skills.name: Soulrend Coldstream
skills.description: Deals massive Ice DMG to a single target, with a high chance to Freeze the attacked target.

skills.name: Heartless Annihilator Call
skills.description: Summons "Lance of the Eternal Freeze".

skills.name: Creator's Resolve
skills.description: Converts to Imaginary DMG. Increases this unit's SPD and the DMG dealt.

skills.name: Genesis Chord
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a single target, with a high chance of causing Imprisonment.

skills.name: The Creation's Prelude
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. The next action uses "Last Choir of Genesis" on all targets.

skills.name: Last Choir of Genesis
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Blizzardous Crisis
skills.description: This unit and all its summoned objects gain increased DMG for each Frozen or Imprisoned target on the opposing team.

skills.name: Unstoppable Momentum
skills.description: Damage received by Annihilator of Desolation Mistral: Mother of Deception is greatly reduced. However, after being Weakness Broken, its action is additionally delayed, and it receives more DMG, as well as recovering allies' Skill Points and activating all allies' Ultimates.

skills.name: Desolation Mistral
skills.description: The Annihilator of Desolation Mistral: Mother of Deception's will <u>transfer</u> their Weakness Type to Lance of the Eternal Freeze.

skills.name: Nowhere to Escape
skills.description: When Annihilator of Desolation Mistral: Mother of Deception uses Soulrend Coldstream or Genesis Chord, these abilities will be <u>unleashed additional times</u> against targets locked on by Lance of the Eternal Freeze.

skills.name: Tenacious Resolve
skills.description: Reduces DMG received by all friendly units, but every Weakness-Type they have increases DMG received.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Battlefield Transfer
tags.description: Gepard will join the battle and provide protection for Boss Mirage. Boss Mirage will <color=#f29e38ff><u>Transfer</u></color> its own Weakness Type to summons, but when those summons are defeated, Boss Mirage's Toughness will be additionally reduced.

tags.name: Nowhere to Escape
tags.description: Boss Mirage's summon will mark 1 target. After Boss Mirage uses a single-target ability, it will deliver a <color=#f29e38ff><u>Follow-Up Usage</u></color> on the marked target.

tags.name: Tenacious Resolve
tags.description: Reduces DMG received by all enemies, but every <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness-Type</color> they have increases DMG received.

phases.name: Phase I — Annihilator of Desolation Mistral
phases.description: Boss Mirage will use abilities to Freeze and deal DMG to targets. Gepard can Shield his team.
phases.answer: Strategy: Defeat the summons first. If Gepard uses a Collective Shield, quickly break the shield and defeat Gepard.

texts.description: Increase Effect RES or use abilities to dispel Freeze. Defeat summons to reduce the frequency of Boss Mirage Crowd controlling allies.

skills.name: Counters Boss Mirage's Weakness Type removal

texts.description: Defeating summons will cause the Weakness Type to be transferred back to Boss Mirage and inflict additional Toughness Reduction on it.
Gepard's Weakness can be broken to directly dispel his Shield. Quickly defeat Gepard to prevent him from using Collective Shield multiple times.

phases.name: Phase II — Annihilator of Desolation Mistral: Mother of Deception
phases.description: Boss Mirage will keep using Last Choir of Genesis to deal massive DMG to everyone, as well as abilities that will restrict the team's actions.
phases.answer: Strategy: After defeating the summons, quickly break Boss Mirage's Weakness.

texts.description: Increase Effect RES or use abilities to dispel Crowd Control statuses. Defeat summons to reduce the frequency of Boss Mirage Crowd controlling allies.

skills.name: Counters Boss Mirage's constant Last Choir of Genesis usage

texts.description: Quickly break Boss Mirage's Weakness to prevent it from using Last Choir of Genesis.

guides.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
When there is a summon present in the battle, Boss Mirage will <color=#f29e38ff>transfer its own Weakness Type to the summon</color>.

texts.description: After <color=#f29e38ff>Breaking</color> Boss Mirage, the DMG it receives is greatly increased, Skill Points are recovered for the team, and the team's action is Advanced Forward.
Defeat or break <color=#f29e38ff>summons</color> first to effectively weaken Boss Mirage.

101202001.name: Rookie Buster: Silo
101202001.description:
An automaton pieced together with Old World technology, tasked with replacing humans in performing the most basic forms of physical labor.
In combat, Automaton Spiders are highly unstable, capable of exploding when damaged.

skills.name: Ram
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Timed Module
skills.description: The next action uses Self-Exploding Module.

skills.name: Self-Exploding Module
skills.description: Self-destructs, dealing Fire DMG to a single target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Chains of Destruction
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to adjacent units when suffering a killing blow.

101203001.name: Automaton Beetle
101203001.description:
An automaton pieced together with Old World technology. A signal light is placed on its legs, and the unit may have been used for mining or construction operations.
In combat, Automaton Beetles can create forcefields to shield themselves.

skills.name: Unstable Forcefield
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to a single target, and grants a Barrier to another friendly unit. The Barrier nullifies all DMG received except for DoT until after the friendly unit is attacked.

In combat, Automaton Direwolfs will use their chainsaw to Bleed enemies, dealing DoT.

skills.name: Felling Order
skills.description: Deals massive Physical DMG to a single target, with a chance to Bleed the hit target. If the hit target is not Shielded, then a random ally of theirs suffers "Dismantle" for 1 time.

skills.name: Lock On Target
skills.description: Locks Onto a single target. The next action on the target will cast "Felling Order."

skills.name: Disintegration Order
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to a single target, with a high chance to inflict 1 stack of Bleed.

skills.name: Dismantle
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to a single target, with a high chance to inflict 1 stack of Bleed.

101302036.name: Chainsaw Skott
101302036.description: Skott, who gathered all the filming resources to become the greatest protagonist of all protagonists. With his consciousness and soul scattered by a Servant, he seeks revenge from the Trailblazer in a thousand different appearances.

skills.name: Felling Order
skills.description: Deals massive Physical DMG to a single target, with a chance to Bleed the hit target. If the hit target is not Shielded, then a random ally of theirs suffers "Dismantle" for 1 time.

skills.name: Lock On Target
skills.description: Locks Onto a single target. The next action on the target will cast "Felling Order."

skills.name: Disintegration Order
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to a single target, with a high chance to inflict 1 stack of Bleed.

skills.name: Dismantle
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to a single target, with a high chance to inflict 1 stack of Bleed.

101302037.name: Automaton Direwolf
101302037.description:
An automaton pieced together with Old World technology. This rare type of humanoid automaton is equipped with a chainsaw on its right arm, presumably used for mining or construction operations.
In combat, Automaton Direwolfs will use their chainsaw to Bleed enemies, dealing DoT.

101401001.name: Svarog
101401001.description:
An ancient relic from the Old World, that was originally used as an automated control unit by the Geomarrow Development Group. Unlike the vast majority of machines that lack intellect and can only act on command, Svarog is capable of much more complex thinking.
In battle, Svarog summons mechanical arms to grab and control his enemies, delivering devastating attacks.

skills.name: Banishing Punch
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Burning Beam
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to a single target and delays their action.

skills.name: Oppressive Embrace
skills.description: Restrains a single target, preventing them from taking action or being targeted. The Restraint is dispelled if the Auxiliary Robot Arm Unit suffers Weakness Break.

skills.name: Shrewd Bombing
skills.description: Deals massive Physical DMG to all targets, with a high chance to reduce their DEF.

skills.name: Controlled Blasting
skills.description: The Auxiliary Robot Arm Unit explodes, dealing massive Physical DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Overload Warning
skills.description: Auxiliary Robot Arm Unit enters Overload Countdown, causing the next action to cast Controlled Blasting.

skills.name: Boost Deployment
skills.description: Summons Auxiliary Robot Arm Unit.

101401302.name: Svarog
101401302.description:
An ancient relic from the Old World, that was originally used as an automated control unit by the Geomarrow Development Group. Unlike the vast majority of machines that lack intellect and can only act on command, Svarog is capable of much more complex thinking.
In battle, Svarog summons mechanical arms to grab and control his enemies, delivering devastating attacks.

200203001.name: Wraith Warden
200203001.description:
A somber warrior that accompanies the Judges of the Ten-Lords Commission to execute missions.
Adorned with the black and white mask that symbolizes the netherworld envoy, they wield a guillotine blade, their strikes echoing the weighty and unyielding duty of the Ten-Lords Commission.

skills.name: Sawing Evil
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to a single target and has a chance to inflict Reverberation to the target. 200401001.name: Stellaron Hunter: Kafka
200401001.description: One of the Stellaron Hunters. A beautiful assassin wearing an enigmatic smile, she excels in manipulation and various weaponry. It was by her design that the Astral Express was led here, all of which was simply part of a certain plan...

skills.name: Midnight Tumult
skills.description: Deals minor Lightning DMG to a single target, with a high chance to Shock the target.

skills.name: Caressing Moonlight
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to a single target and units adjacent to the target. If the primary target is Shocked, inflicts Shock on the secondary units as well.

skills.name: Silent and Sharp Mockery
skills.description: Deals minor Lightning DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Spirit Whisper
skills.description: Has a high chance of Dominating a single target and Advancing their action forward to immediately attack a random ally of theirs.

skills.name: Tremble
skills.description: If the target is currently Shocked, directly causes Shock DMG 1 time.

skills.name: Cruelty
skills.description: When friendly units (apart from Kafka) or Dominated targets attack the Shocked primary target, unleash an extra Lightning attack. This can only be triggered 1 time per turn.

skills.name: Caressing Moonlight
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to a single target and units adjacent to the target. If the primary target is Shocked, inflicts Shock on the secondary units as well.

skills.name: Silent and Sharp Mockery
skills.description: Deals minor Lightning DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Spirit Whisper
skills.description: Has a high chance of Dominating a single target and Advancing their action forward to immediately attack a random ally of theirs.

skills.name: Tremble
skills.description: If the target is currently Shocked, directly causes Shock DMG 1 time.

skills.name: Cruelty
skills.description: When friendly units (apart from Kafka) or Dominated targets attack the Shocked primary target, unleash an extra Lightning attack. This can only be triggered 1 time per turn.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Battlefield Transfer
tags.description: Boss Mirage summons 2 Elite Enemies to assist in battle. Boss Mirage will <color=#f29e38ff><u>transmit</u></color> its own Weakness Type to summons, but when those summons are defeated, Boss Mirage's Toughness will be additionally reduced.

tags.name: Stellar Aegis
tags.description: For <color=#f29e38ff>every unit</color> on the enemy's side of the field aside from Boss Mirage, all enemies receive less DMG.

tags.name: Turn Back the Tide
tags.description: When the Boss Mirage uses "Puppet Understudy" in its second phase, it will apply Enhancement effects to <color=#f29e38ff>all summons</color>.

phases.name: Phase I: Cryopyre Duet
phases.description: Boss Mirage will summon Blaze Out of Space and Ice Out of Space to assist it in battle, and transmit its own Weakness Type to the summons.
phases.answer: Strategy: Prioritize defeating the summons. Defeating all summons will make the Weakness Type transmit back to the Boss Mirage.

skills.name: Counters the Dominated control effect applied by Boss Mirage

texts.description: Increase Effect RES or use abilities to dispel the Dominated control effect applied by Boss Mirage.
After defeating any summon, the remaining summons' SPD increases, but they receive more DMG as well. Utilize this mechanism to swiftly eliminate the remaining summons.

skills.name: Counters Boss Mirage that has no Weakness Type

texts.description: Defeating summons will deal additional Toughness Reduction to the Boss Mirage. Defeating all Summons will cause the Weakness Type to transmit back to the Boss Mirage.

phases.name: Phase II: The Game Is On
phases.description: Boss Mirage will summon Dreamjolt Troupe's Beyond Overcooked and Memory Zone Meme "Shell of Faded Rage" to assist it in battle, and transmit its own Weakness Type to the summons.
phases.answer: Strategy: Prioritize defeating the summons. Defeating all summons will make the Weakness Type transmit back to the Boss Mirage.

skills.name: Counters the Psychological Suggestion ability of Boss Mirage

texts.description: Increase Effect RES or use abilities to remove the Psychological Suggestion effect imposed by Boss Mirage on player units.

skills.name: Counters the summon, Dreamjolt Troupe's Beyond Overcooked

texts.description: During the Charging phase of the Dreamjolt Troupe's Beyond Overcooked, quickly stack Stove Heating to 6 stacks to dispel its Charging state, and inflict DMG and Weaken effect on all enemies. Attacks or DoT can stack the Stove Heating stacks.

skills.name: Counters Memory Zone Meme "Shell of Faded Rage"

texts.description: Break Memory Zone Meme Shell of Faded Rage's Weakness to dispel its Charging state and Safeguard effect, increasing the DMG received by it.

guides.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

Boss Mirage will <color=#f29e38ff>transmit its own Weakness Type to the summon</color>. After any one of its summons is defeated, the summon's Weakness Type will be <color=#f29e38ff>added</color> to the remaining summons.

Attacking summons reduces Boss Mirage's HP by an <color=#f29e38ff>equal amount</color>. After any summon is eliminated, the remaining summons' SPD increases, and <color=#f29e38ff>the DMG they take increases</color>.

texts.description: Prioritize <color=#f29e38ff>defeating summons</color>. Doing so will <color=#f29e38ff>transmit</color> their Weakness Type back to the Boss Mirage.
After defeating any summon, increases DMG received by other summons. Take advantage of this mechanism to quickly defeat other summons.
Increase Effect RES or use abilities to remove the <color=#f29e38ff>Dominated</color> status applied by Boss Mirage.

After any summon is defeated, its Weakness Type is transferred to the other summon still in the battle, and applies <u>Sanguine Gaze</u> to it.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Battlefield Transfer
tags.description: Boss Mirage summons 2 Elite Enemies to assist in battle. Boss Mirage will <color=#f29e38ff><u>transmit</u></color> its own Weakness Type to summons, but when those summons are defeated, Boss Mirage's Toughness will be additionally reduced.

tags.name: Stellar Aegis
tags.description: For <color=#f29e38ff>every unit</color> on the enemy's side of the field aside from Boss Mirage, all enemies receive less DMG.

tags.name: Turn Back the Tide
tags.description: When the Boss Mirage uses "Puppet Understudy" in its second phase, it will apply Enhancement effects to <color=#f29e38ff>all summons</color>.

phases.name: Phase I: Cryopyre Duet
phases.description: Boss Mirage will summon Blaze Out of Space and Ice Out of Space to assist it in battle, and transmit its own Weakness Type to the summons.
phases.answer: Strategy: Prioritize defeating the summons. Defeating all summons will make the Weakness Type transmit back to the Boss Mirage.

skills.name: Counters the Dominated control effect applied by Boss Mirage

texts.description: Increase Effect RES or use abilities to dispel the Dominated control effect applied by Boss Mirage.
After defeating any summon, the remaining summons' SPD increases, but they receive more DMG as well. Utilize this mechanism to swiftly eliminate the remaining summons.

skills.name: Counters Boss Mirage that has no Weakness Type

texts.description: Defeating summons will deal additional Toughness Reduction to the Boss Mirage. Defeating all Summons will cause the Weakness Type to transmit back to the Boss Mirage.

phases.name: Phase II: The Game Is On
phases.description: Boss Mirage will summon Dreamjolt Troupe's Beyond Overcooked and Memory Zone Meme "Shell of Faded Rage" to assist it in battle, and transmit its own Weakness Type to the summons.
phases.answer: Strategy: Prioritize defeating the summons. Defeating all summons will make the Weakness Type transmit back to the Boss Mirage.

skills.name: Counters the Psychological Suggestion ability of Boss Mirage

texts.description: Increase Effect RES or use abilities to remove the Psychological Suggestion effect imposed by Boss Mirage on player units.

skills.name: Counters the summon, Dreamjolt Troupe's Beyond Overcooked

texts.description: During the Charging phase of the Dreamjolt Troupe's Beyond Overcooked, quickly stack Stove Heating to 6 stacks to dispel its Charging state, and inflict DMG and Weaken effect on all enemies. Attacks or DoT can stack the Stove Heating stacks.

skills.name: Counters Memory Zone Meme "Shell of Faded Rage"

texts.description: Break Memory Zone Meme Shell of Faded Rage's Weakness to dispel its Charging state and Safeguard effect, increasing the DMG received by it.

guides.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

skills.name: Farewell Etiquette
skills.description: The Sanction Rate level increases when your team uses Skills or Ultimates to attack. When the Sanction Rate reaches its level cap, enters Sanction mode and summons Entranced Ingenium: Illumination Dragonfish.

skills.name: Dread
skills.description: Increases Sanction Rate level and deals minor Imaginary DMG to all targets. Has a high chance to inflict Weaken on the targets.

skills.name: Restraint
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Enchainment
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to a single target, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment.

201301002.name: Aurumaton Gatekeeper
201301002.description:
Garrison aurumaton created with ancient ingenium technology.
Countless years ago, the aurumatons set sail with the Xianzhou to seek divine recipes of immortality, and were tasked to oversee humanity and to aid humankind during warfare. However, after countless rebellions, they were finally overpowered by the Xianzhou natives.
Now, all aurumatons are strictly controlled with talismans, and are employed to guard important places.

201302001.name: Aurumaton Spectral Envoy
201302001.description:
A law-enforcing aurumaton engraved with the Ten-Lords Martial Scriptures and taking orders from the Ten-Lords Commission.
Living beings are susceptible to the corporeal and mental existence of the self, but gold and metal will never be swayed and will unwaveringly follow the Ten-Lords' edicts.
These aurumaton law enforcers use their strength to subdue evils that have strayed from the natural order of life, and bring them to the Netherworld to meet their sentence. Its authority is sometimes even greater than that of a judge.

skills.name: Adjudicate
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Subdue
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to a single target and has a high chance to inflict Reverberation on the target. After targets afflicted with Reverberation receive an attack, they enter the Strong Reverberation state and then have the Reverberation state dispelled. Targets with Strong Reverberation cannot take action.

skills.name: Revert Yin and Yang
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to all targets and has a chance to inflict Reverberation.

skills.name: Heaven's Fall
skills.description: Deals massive Physical DMG to a single target. If the target is afflicted with Strong Reverberation, they additionally take Physical DMG, and Strong Reverberation is then dispelled.

skills.name: Soul Warrant
skills.description: When there are targets afflicted with Strong Reverberation on the field, lock on to those targets and during the next action, use Heaven's Fall on them.

skills.name: Heaven's Fall
skills.description: Deals massive Physical DMG to a single target. If the target is afflicted with Strong Reverberation, they additionally take Physical DMG, and Strong Reverberation is then dispelled.

201302004.name: Aurumaton Spectral Envoy
201302004.description:
A law-enforcing aurumaton engraved with the Ten-Lords Martial Scriptures and taking orders from the Ten-Lords Commission.
Living beings are susceptible to the corporeal and mental existence of the self, but gold and metal will never be swayed and will unwaveringly follow the Ten-Lords' edicts.
These aurumaton law enforcers use their strength to subdue evils that have strayed from the natural order of life, and bring them to the Netherworld to meet their sentence. Its authority is sometimes even greater than that of a judge.

202303001.description:
The form that the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus crave. A true appearance that cast off the burdens of humanity and has been reforged using the way of immortality.
In ancient times, those who sought immortality received wisdom from the Ambrosial Arbor and called themselves Celestials. They lived without restraints and molded the flesh of themselves and others at will. They have long forgotten their original appearances after countless metamorphoses.

202401001.name: Abundant Ebon Deer
202401001.description:
An auspicious spiritual beast wrought into being by the Ambrosial Arbor and protects its roots. Its arrival brings along exuberant vegetation and promises good fortune.
Once destroyed during ancient wars, the Ambrosial Arbor is mended by the Stellaron and finally revives. Rare creatures and legendary beasts made by celestials of the past all return to this world, like an old dream coming alive again.

skills.name: Pedicel: Wintry Wind
skills.description: Summons Ambrosial Arbor branch "Twig of Wintry Wind"

skills.name: Pedicel: Marple Leaf
skills.description: Summons Ambrosial Arbor branch "Twig of Marple Leaf"

skills.name: Pedicel: Glorious Blooms
skills.description: Summons Ambrosial Arbor branch "Twig of Glorious Blooms"

skills.name: Pedicel: Lavish Fruits
skills.description: Summons Ambrosial Arbor branch "Twig of Lavish Fruits"

skills.name: Wavering Bleat
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Caress of Wind
skills.description: Deals minor Wind DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Hardy Leaf Sheath
skills.description: Increases DEF. Toughness cannot be reduced.

skills.name: Flamboyant Gore
skills.description: Uses this ability immediately when there are 2 Lavish Fruits on the field. Deals Lightning DMG to all targets. Deals more damage for every "Ambrosial Arbor Branches" on the field. After the ability is used, remove all "Ambrosial Arbor Branches" on the field.

skills.name: Back to Life
skills.description: Absorbs Ambrosial Arbor energy and restores all HP.

skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Caress of Wind
skills.description: Deals minor Wind DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Hardy Leaf Sheath
skills.description: Increases DEF. This unit's Toughness cannot be reduced.

skills.name: Flamboyant Gore
skills.description: After "Twig of Lavish Fruits" uses an ability, "Unwaning Ageless Immortal" gains 1 Charge. When Charge reaches its limit, immediately uses this ability, dealing Lightning DMG to all targets. The more "<u>Ambrosial Arbor branches</u>" on the field, the higher the DMG dealt.

skills.name: Back to Life
skills.description: All summons restore HP equal to a set percentage of "Unwaning Ageless Immortal"'s Max HP.

skills.name: Pedicel: Wintry Wind
skills.description: Summons Ambrosial Arbor branch "Twig of Wintry Wind."

skills.name: Pedicel: Marple Leaf
skills.description: Summons Ambrosial Arbor branch "Twig of Marple Leaf."

skills.name: Pedicel: Glorious Blooms
skills.description: Summons Ambrosial Arbor branch "Twig of Glorious Blooms."

skills.name: Pedicel: Lavish Fruits
skills.description: Summons Ambrosial Arbor branch "Twig of Lavish Fruits."

skills.name: Heavenbound One And All
skills.description:
When combat begins, summons "<u>Abominations of Abundance</u>" and "<u>Ambrosial Arbor branch</u>."
When a summon is defeated, deals minor True DMG to this unit, slightly reduces this unit's Toughness, then immediately summons new "<u>Abominations of Abundance</u>" or "<u>Ambrosial Arbor branch</u>."

skills.name: Heavenbound One And All: Enhanced
skills.description:
Upon phase change, summons "Celestial Cherub," "Celestial Maiden," and "<u>Ambrosial Arbor branch</u>," and applies "Right-Hand Man" to "Celestial Cherub" and "Celestial Maiden." While the "Right-Hand Men" are on the field, DMG taken by the "Unwaning Ageless Immortal" is greatly reduced.
When summons are defeated, deals minor True DMG to this unit and reduces this unit's Toughness by a minor amount. If the defeated unit is a "Right-Hand Man," instead deals massive True DMG to this unit and reduces this unit's Toughness by a massive amount, then immediately summons a new "<u>Ambrosial Arbor branch</u>."

skills.name: Power of Ascension
skills.description:
When "Twig of Wintry Wind," "Twig of Marple Leaf," and "Twig of Glorious Blooms" are on the field, they produce unique <u>Halo</u> effects on other units respectively.
"Twig of Wintry Wind": DMG dealt by ally units inflicted with the "Outrage" state to all enemy units other than "Twig of Wintry Wind" is greatly reduced.
"Twig of Marple Leaf": All enemy units other than "Twig of Marple Leaf" have their actions Advanced Forward slightly after being attacked.
"Twig of Glorious Blooms": At the start of their turn, all enemy units other than "Twig of Glorious Blooms" and "Unwaning Ageless Immortal" recover a minor amount of HP.

skills.name: Power of Sustenance
skills.description: After a target unit defeats an "<u>Ambrosial Arbor branch</u>", they gain 1 stack of "Power of Sustenance," increasing DMG dealt.

skills.name: Power Leak
skills.description: "Unwaning Ageless Immortal" will Transfer its Weakness Type to "Right-Hand Men." When a "Right-Hand Man" is defeated, it Transfers its Weakness Type to "Unwaning Ageless Immortal" and other "Right-Hand Man" units.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is Broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Bountiful Prosperity
tags.description: When the Boss Mirage's summons are defeated, it deals minor True DMG to this unit and slightly reduces its Toughness. If the defeated target is an <color=#f29e38ff>Elite Enemy</color>, it instead deals massive True DMG to this unit and massively reduces its Toughness. Then, it <color=#f29e38ff>immediately summons</color> new summons.

tags.name: Like a Deer With Wings
tags.description: The initial action value of the summons summoned via "Heavenbound One And All" and "Heavenbound One And All: Enhanced" is greatly advanced.

tags.name: Dazzling Halo
tags.description: While any type of "<u>Halo</u>" effect is active, all enemy targets that are not Weakness Broken take reduced DMG and deal increased DMG.

phases.name: Phase I: Army of Abundance
phases.description: When combat begins, the Boss Mirage summons "Abominations of Abundance" and "Ambrosial Arbor branch." When the summons are defeated, the Boss Mirage takes minor True DMG and has its Toughness reduced by a minor amount, then immediately summons new summons.
phases.answer: Strategy: Actively defeat summons to reduce the Boss Mirage's Toughness, and prioritize defeating the "Ambrosial Arbor branch" to stack "Power of Sustenance."

skills.name: How to efficiently reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness

texts.description: Defeating "Abominations of Abundance" or "Ambrosial Arbor branches" deals True DMG to the Boss Mirage and reduces its Toughness.

skills.name: How to counter the "Ambrosial Arbor branches'" "Halo" effect

texts.description: Prioritize defeating the "Ambrosial Arbor branch" to dispel the "Halo" effect and grant allies the "Power of Sustenance," increasing DMG dealt.

phases.name: Phase II: Left and Right Lieutenants
phases.description: When changing phases, the Boss Mirage summons "Celestial Cherub" and "Celestial Maiden," and applies "Right-Hand Man" to them. While "Right-Hand Man" is on the field, DMG taken by the Boss Mirage is greatly reduced.
phases.answer: Strategy: Prioritize defeating the "Right-Hand Man" to weaken the Boss Mirage's DMG reduction effect, while also greatly reducing the Boss Mirage's Toughness.

skills.name: How to counter Boss Mirage's "Flamboyant Gore"

texts.description: Every time "Twig of Lavish Fruits" uses an ability, it charges the Boss Mirage's "Flamboyant Gore." Defeat "Twig of Lavish Fruits" as soon as possible to stop it from continuously charging "Flamboyant Gore."

guides.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is Broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

When the Boss Mirage's summons are defeated, it deals minor True DMG to this unit and slightly reduces its Toughness. If the defeated target is an <color=#f29e38ff>Elite Enemy</color>, it instead deals massive True DMG to this unit and massively reduces its Toughness. Then, it <color=#f29e38ff>immediately summons</color> new summons.

While "Twig of Wintry Wind," "Twig of Marple Leaf," and "Twig of Glorious Blooms" are on the field, they apply different <color=#f29e38ff>Halo</color> effects respectively to other units. After an ally unit <color=#f29e38ff>defeats an "Ambrosial Arbor branch,"</color> they gain 1 stack of "Power of Sustenance," increasing DMG dealt.

texts.description: Proactively defeating the Boss Mirage's summons can effectively reduce the Boss Mirage's Toughness.
Prioritize defeating the "Ambrosial Arbor branch" on the field to gain "Power of Sustenance" and increase the DMG dealt by damage-dealing ally characters.
Defeat the "Twig of Lavish Fruits" as quickly as possible before it takes action to prevent it from continuously charging the Boss Mirage's "Flamboyant Gore."

guides.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is Broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

When the Boss Mirage's summons are defeated, it deals minor True DMG to this unit and slightly reduces its Toughness. If the defeated target is an <color=#f29e38ff>Elite Enemy</color>, it instead deals massive True DMG to this unit and massively reduces its Toughness. Then, it <color=#f29e38ff>immediately summons</color> new summons.

While "Twig of Wintry Wind," "Twig of Marple Leaf," and "Twig of Glorious Blooms" are on the field, they apply different <color=#f29e38ff>Halo</color> effects respectively to other units. After an ally unit <color=#f29e38ff>defeats an "Ambrosial Arbor branch,"</color> they gain 1 stack of "Power of Sustenance," increasing DMG dealt.

texts.description: Proactively defeating the Boss Mirage's summons can effectively reduce the Boss Mirage's Toughness.
Prioritize defeating the "Ambrosial Arbor branch" on the field to gain "Power of Sustenance" and increase the DMG dealt by damage-dealing ally characters.
Defeat the "Twig of Lavish Fruits" as quickly as possible before it takes action to prevent it from continuously charging the Boss Mirage's "Flamboyant Gore."

202401603.name: Unwaning Ageless Immortal
202401603.description:
An auspicious spiritual beast wrought into being by the Ambrosial Arbor and protects its roots. Its arrival brings along exuberant vegetation and promises good fortune.
Once destroyed during ancient wars, the Ambrosial Arbor is mended by the Stellaron and finally revives. Rare creatures and legendary beasts made by celestials of the past all return to this world, like an old dream coming alive again.

skills.name: Wavering Bleat
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Caress of Wind
skills.description: Deals minor Wind DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Hardy Leaf Sheath
skills.description: Increases DEF. This unit's Toughness cannot be reduced.

skills.name: Flamboyant Gore
skills.description: After "Twig of Lavish Fruits" uses an ability, "Unwaning Ageless Immortal" gains 1 Charge. When Charge reaches its limit, immediately uses this ability, dealing Lightning DMG to all targets. The more "<u>Ambrosial Arbor branches</u>" on the field, the higher the DMG dealt.

skills.name: Back to Life
skills.description: All summons restore HP equal to a set percentage of "Unwaning Ageless Immortal"'s Max HP.

skills.name: Pedicel: Wintry Wind
skills.description: Summons Ambrosial Arbor branch "Twig of Wintry Wind."

skills.name: Pedicel: Marple Leaf
skills.description: Summons Ambrosial Arbor branch "Twig of Marple Leaf."

skills.name: Pedicel: Glorious Blooms
skills.description: Summons Ambrosial Arbor branch "Twig of Glorious Blooms."

skills.name: Pedicel: Lavish Fruits
skills.description: Summons Ambrosial Arbor branch "Twig of Lavish Fruits."

skills.name: Heavenbound One And All
skills.description:
When combat begins, summons "<u>Abominations of Abundance</u>" and "<u>Ambrosial Arbor branch</u>."
When a summon is defeated, deals minor True DMG to this unit, slightly reduces this unit's Toughness, then immediately summons new "<u>Abominations of Abundance</u>" or "<u>Ambrosial Arbor branch</u>."

skills.name: Heavenbound One And All: Enhanced
skills.description:
Upon phase change, summons "Celestial Cherub," "Celestial Maiden," and "<u>Ambrosial Arbor branch</u>," and applies "Right-Hand Man" to "Celestial Cherub" and "Celestial Maiden." While the "Right-Hand Men" are on the field, DMG taken by the "Unwaning Ageless Immortal" is greatly reduced.
When summons are defeated, deals minor True DMG to this unit and reduces this unit's Toughness by a minor amount. If the defeated unit is a "Right-Hand Man," instead deals massive True DMG to this unit and reduces this unit's Toughness by a massive amount, then immediately summons a new "<u>Ambrosial Arbor branch</u>."

skills.name: Power of Ascension
skills.description:
When "Twig of Wintry Wind," "Twig of Marple Leaf," and "Twig of Glorious Blooms" are on the field, they produce unique <u>Halo</u> effects on other units respectively.
"Twig of Wintry Wind": DMG dealt by ally units inflicted with the "Outrage" state to all enemy units other than "Twig of Wintry Wind" is greatly reduced.
"Twig of Marple Leaf": All enemy units other than "Twig of Marple Leaf" have their actions Advanced Forward slightly after being attacked.
"Twig of Glorious Blooms": At the start of their turn, all enemy units other than "Twig of Glorious Blooms" and "Unwaning Ageless Immortal" recover a minor amount of HP.

skills.name: Power of Sustenance
skills.description: After a target unit defeats an "<u>Ambrosial Arbor branch</u>", they gain 1 stack of "Power of Sustenance," increasing DMG dealt.

skills.name: Power Leak
skills.description: "Unwaning Ageless Immortal" will Transfer its Weakness Type to "Right-Hand Men." When a "Right-Hand Man" is defeated, it Transfers its Weakness Type to "Unwaning Ageless Immortal" and other "Right-Hand Man" units.

skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to a single target and its adjacent units. If this unit is under the <u>Moon Rage</u> state, there is a high chance to inflict Bleed on the target.

203302201.name: Sanerot Hearteater
203302201.description:
Provoking their temptations within, usurping their powerful spirit, transforming into their appearance... The Crimson Moon will conduct a targeted hunt based on its host's weakness.
Is Feixiao the hunter or the prey in this endless pursuit?

skills.name: Seance
skills.description: "Nebula Devourer," "Planeshred Claws," and "Worldpurge Tail" share their HP with "Hellcharred Shadow General."

skills.name: Synchronization
skills.description: When "Nebula Devourer," "Planeshred Claws," "Worldpurge Tail," and "Hellcharred Shadow General" have their Weakness Broken, "Sanerot Hearteater's" Toughness is reduced.

phases.name: Phase 1: Unyielding Winds
phases.description: The Boss Mirage will use "Soul-Shattering Malediction" to inflict the "Malediction" effect on allies.
phases.answer: Strategy: When "Soul-Shattering Malediction" is used, prioritize selecting non-DMG dealing ally characters as the target of the ability.

skills.name: How to control "Bloodstained Lupine" in battle

texts.description: Prioritize using "Bloodstained Lupine's" Skill to reduce the enemy target's Toughness. When all allies' HP are low, prioritize using "Bloodstained Lupine's" Basic ATK to quickly restore HP for allies.

When "Bloodstained Lupine" uses Basic ATK or Skill, gains 1 stack of "Bloodthirst." When "Bloodthirst" stacks are maxed, dispels the "Malediction" effect. Causing Boss Mirage to enter the Weakness Broken state also dispels the "Malediction" effect.

phases.name: Phase 2: Sweep the Heavens
phases.description: The Boss Mirage will use "Sweep the Heavens, Swallow the Earth" to deal high DMG and debuffs.
phases.answer: Strategy: Do what you can to break all parts before "Sweep the Heavens, Swallow the Earth" is used.

skills.name: How to face the DMG and debuffs dealt by "Sweep the Heavens, Swallow the Earth"

texts.description: Use "Bloodstained Lupine's" Skill to hit multiple Boss Mirage parts to greatly reduce the Toughness of those parts. Alternatively, Break the Weakness of all parts to prevent the Boss from using "Sweep the Heavens, Swallow the Earth."

guides.description: Boss Mirage and all other parts take <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
When the Boss Mirage's parts get <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness Broken</color>, the Toughness of the Boss Mirage will be reduced.

When the Boss Mirage uses "Soul-Shattering Malediction," causes ally characters to <color=#f29e38ff>enter the "Malediction" state</color>. Ally characters and summons in the "Malediction" state will Depart the field. At the same time, summons Bloodstained Lupine to replace the Departed character and continue the battle, and the "Bloodstained Lupine"'s attacks can cause <color=#f29e38ff>heavy Toughness Reduction</color>.

texts.description: Weakness Break Boss Mirage's <color=#f29e38ff>parts</color> multiple times to effectively reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness. <color=#f29e38ff>Break</color> Boss Mirage to greatly increase the DMG taken by itself and all its parts, while recovering Skill Points and activating Ultimates for all allies.

When <color=#f29e38ff>"Bloodstained Lupine"</color> replaces an ally character in battle, it will additionally <color=#f29e38ff>reduce Toughness irrespective of Weakness Types</color> based on the <color=#f29e38ff>number of DoT debuffs</color> inflicted on the enemy target attacked. "Bloodstained Lupine's" <color=#f29e38ff>Basic ATK</color> can restore HP for all ally targets, and its <color=#f29e38ff>Skill</color> can hit multiple enemy targets while greatly reducing their Toughness. This <color=#f29e38ff>does not consume Skill Points</color>.

phases.name: Phase 1: Unyielding Winds
phases.description: The Boss Mirage will use "Soul-Shattering Malediction" to inflict the "Malediction" effect on allies.
phases.answer: Strategy: When "Soul-Shattering Malediction" is used, prioritize selecting non-DMG dealing ally characters as the target of the ability.

skills.name: How to control "Bloodstained Lupine" in battle

texts.description: Prioritize using "Bloodstained Lupine's" Skill to reduce the enemy target's Toughness. When all allies' HP are low, prioritize using "Bloodstained Lupine's" Basic ATK to quickly restore HP for allies.

When "Bloodstained Lupine" uses Basic ATK or Skill, gains 1 stack of "Bloodthirst." When "Bloodthirst" stacks are maxed, dispels the "Malediction" effect. Causing Boss Mirage to enter the Weakness Broken state also dispels the "Malediction" effect.

phases.name: Phase 2: Sweep the Heavens
phases.description: The Boss Mirage will use "Sweep the Heavens, Swallow the Earth" to deal high DMG and debuffs.
phases.answer: Strategy: Do what you can to break all parts before "Sweep the Heavens, Swallow the Earth" is used.

skills.name: How to face the DMG and debuffs dealt by "Sweep the Heavens, Swallow the Earth"

texts.description: Use "Bloodstained Lupine's" Skill to hit multiple Boss Mirage parts to greatly reduce the Toughness of those parts. Alternatively, Break the Weakness of all parts to prevent the Boss from using "Sweep the Heavens, Swallow the Earth."

guides.description: Boss Mirage and all other parts take <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
When the Boss Mirage's parts get <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness Broken</color>, the Toughness of the Boss Mirage will be reduced.

When the Boss Mirage uses "Soul-Shattering Malediction," causes ally characters to <color=#f29e38ff>enter the "Malediction" state</color>. Ally characters and summons in the "Malediction" state will Depart the field. At the same time, summons Bloodstained Lupine to replace the Departed character and continue the battle, and the "Bloodstained Lupine"'s attacks can cause <color=#f29e38ff>heavy Toughness Reduction</color>.

texts.description: Weakness Break Boss Mirage's <color=#f29e38ff>parts</color> multiple times to effectively reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness. <color=#f29e38ff>Break</color> Boss Mirage to greatly increase the DMG taken by itself and all its parts, while recovering Skill Points and activating Ultimates for all allies.

When <color=#f29e38ff>"Bloodstained Lupine"</color> replaces an ally character in battle, it will additionally <color=#f29e38ff>reduce Toughness irrespective of Weakness Types</color> based on the <color=#f29e38ff>number of DoT debuffs</color> inflicted on the enemy target attacked. "Bloodstained Lupine's" <color=#f29e38ff>Basic ATK</color> can restore HP for all ally targets, and its <color=#f29e38ff>Skill</color> can hit multiple enemy targets while greatly reducing their Toughness. This <color=#f29e38ff>does not consume Skill Points</color>.

203302204.name: Sanerot Hearteater
203302204.description:
Provoking their temptations within, usurping their powerful spirit, transforming into their appearance... The Crimson Moon will conduct a targeted hunt based on its host's weakness.
Is Feixiao the hunter or the prey in this endless pursuit?

203401001.name: Borisin Warhead: Hoolay
203401001.description:
A borisin leader who committed the Ten Unpardonable Sins, eternally imprisoned at the bottom of The Shackling Prison.
Bearing the hatred of seven centuries of bitter confinement, the Lord of Wolves challenges the entire Xianzhou Luofu upon breaking free from his cage. Yet, there seems to be another objective hidden behind his maddened actions...

skills.name: Broken Blades as Fang
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Severed Iron as Claws
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to a single target and adjacent units.

skills.name: Barrenness of Earth Gouged
skills.description: Causes all targets (except this unit) to have their action delayed and deals minor Lightning DMG.

skills.name: Decimation of Roaring Storms
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Lupine Chase Calls Bloody Gleam
skills.description: Deals massive Lightning DMG to a designated single target, with a high chance of inflicting <u>Terror Grip</u>.

skills.name: Warhead Moon Rage
skills.description:
After a friendly unit launches an attack, apply 1 stack of "<u>Bloodlust</u>" to <u>friendly units who can enter the "Moon Rage" state</u>. When "<u>Bloodlust</u>" reaches a certain number of stacks, the friendly unit enters the "<u>Moon Rage</u>" state.
A "Moon Rage" countdown icon appears in the Action Order. When the countdown's turn begins, "<u>Moon Rage</u>" is dispelled across all friendly units.

skills.name: Moonhowl Lupus
skills.description: While Hoolay is in the <u>Moon Rage</u> state, applies 1 stack of Irate to Hoolay after every attack launched by friendly units. If Hoolay uses an attack, additionally applies 1 stack of Irate. After every attack used by target units, reduce 1 stack of Irate. Irate will have an initial set of stacks. When a certain number of Irate stacks is reached, Hoolay will release Lupine Chase Calls Bloody Gleam and remove all Irate stacks. Whenever Irate stacks are reduced to 0 due to attacks from player characters, Hoolay's Toughness will be reduced and reset Irate to a set number of stacks.

skills.name: To My Howls the Pack Obeys
skills.description: Adds Summon the Pack to the Action Order. Whenever Summon the Pack takes action, summons Sableclaw Wolftrooper or Eclipse Wolftrooper. When any enemy enters the <u>Moon Rage</u> state, Summon the Pack's action is delayed.

skills.description: Enters the "Going Solo" state. Increases Hoolay's DMG dealt. Targets can select one character and their summon to enter the "Going Solo" state. After the target enters the "Going Solo" state, causes the target's team to recover Skill Points, and increases this unit's Max HP and ATK based on the total Max HP and ATK of all target characters, as well as activating "<u>Blood Surge</u>." This unit also gains "<u>Rising War Spirits</u>" based on the number of "<u>Blood Surge</u>" stacks. The "<u>Blood Surge</u>" stacks of all target characters will be removed after the "Going Solo" state ends.

phases.name: Phase I: Clash of Wind and Lightning
phases.description: When Boss Mirage enters "Lunar Devourer" state, the strongest ally character must be selected to engage in "Going Solo" against Boss Mirage.
phases.answer: Strategy: Before Boss Mirage enters "Lunar Devourer" state, defeat as many Wolftroopers as possible to gain enhancements.

skills.name: How to gain "Blood Surge" and quickly enter "Lunar Devourer" state

texts.description: Defeating Wolftroopers will grant "Blood Surge" to all allies and apply "Bloodlust" to Boss Mirage, accelerating its progression toward "Lunar Devourer" state
Reserve more strength before entering "Going Solo" and try to select an ally character with a summon for an advantage in action count.

phases.name: Phase II: Devourer of Heaven and Moon
phases.description: Boss Mirage's abilities deal DMG to Wolftroopers. This is additionally enhanced when Boss Mirage enters "Lunar Devourer" state.
phases.answer: Strategy: Defeat Wolftroopers before Boss Mirage acts to prevent Wolftroopers from being eliminated by Boss Mirage.

skills.name: Avoid missing out on gaining "Blood Surge"

texts.description: Wolftroopers eliminated by Boss Mirage cannot grant "Blood Surge" to allies. Try to defeat as many Wolftroopers as possible before Boss Mirage acts.

guides.description: Decreases DMG taken by Boss Mirage by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and increases its DMG taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

When Boss Mirage enters the "Lunar Devourer" state, Weakness Protection will be removed, and the strongest ally character must be selected to engage in "Going Solo" against Boss Mirage. During "Going Solo," apart from the selected character and their summoned unit, all other ally targets will enter the Departed state.
When an ally defeats an enemy Wolftrooper, gain "Blood Surge." The character entering "Going Solo" and their summoned unit will be enhanced based on "Blood Surge" stacks.

texts.description: Prioritize defeating Wolftroopers before Boss Mirage enters "Lunar Devourer" state to grant "Blood Surge" to allies and accelerate Boss Mirage's progression toward "Lunar Devourer" state.
Reserve strength as Boss Mirage is about to enter "Lunar Devourer" state to better handle "Going Solo."
During "Going Solo," if the selected ally character has a summon, the summoned unit will enter "Going Solo" alongside the character.

skills.name: Severed Iron as Claws
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Barrenness of Earth Gouged
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to all targets except this unit.

skills.name: Decimation of Roaring Storms
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Lupine Chase Calls Bloody Gleam
skills.description: Deals massive Lightning DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Sanguine Hunger Howls
skills.description: Hoolay's Toughness cannot be reduced before entering the "Lunar Devourer" state. After a friendly unit launches an attack, applies 1 stack of "<u>Bloodlust</u>" to <u>friendly units that can enter the "Lunar Devourer" state</u>. When "<u>Bloodlust</u>" reaches a certain stack, Hoolay will enter the "<u>Lunar Devourer</u>" state and use "Going Solo."

skills.name: Surrounded by Lupine Shrieks
skills.description: When Hoolay enters the "<u>Lunar Devourer</u>" state, DMG taken decreases, their Toughness can be reduced, and they apply "Irate" to themselves. "Irate" has a starting stack number that decreases by 1 after every target's turn ends. This unit will exit the "Lunar Devourer" state whenever "Irate" reduces to 0 stacks.

skills.name: Pack's Edict, Followed by Lightning
skills.description: Whenever a target deals a killing blow to other friendly units, deals DMG and reduces Hoolay's Toughness and adds "<u>Blood Surge</u>" to all target characters. Also, applies 1 stack of "<u>Bloodlust</u>" to <u>all friendly units that can enter the "Lunar Devourer" state</u> and summon "Sableclaw Wolftrooper" or "Eclipse Wolftrooper."

skills.name: Going Solo
skills.description: Enters the "Going Solo" state. Increases Hoolay's DMG dealt. Targets can select one character and their summon to enter the "Going Solo" state. After the selection, deals Lightning DMG to one designated target, and all targets and friendly units will become <u>Departed</u> until "Irate" is completely expended. After the target enters the "Going Solo" state, causes the target's team to recover Skill Points, and increases this unit's Max HP and ATK based on the total Max HP and ATK of all target characters, as well as activating "<u>Blood Surge</u>." This unit also gains "<u>Rising War Spirits</u>" based on the number of "<u>Blood Surge</u>" stacks. The "<u>Blood Surge</u>" stacks of all target characters will be removed after the "Going Solo" state ends.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Decreases DMG taken by Boss Mirage by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and increases its DMG taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Better Safe Than Sorry
tags.description: When the Boss Mirage uses "Barrenness of Earth Gouged," all other Wolftroopers will be eliminated.

tags.name: Apex Predator
tags.description: After Boss Mirage enters Phase II, it gains extra action per turn during "Going Solo."

tags.name: Till Death
tags.description: After Boss Mirage enters "Going Solo," reduces its DMG taken by an additional <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>.

phases.name: Phase I: Clash of Wind and Lightning
phases.description: When Boss Mirage enters "Lunar Devourer" state, the strongest ally character must be selected to engage in "Going Solo" against Boss Mirage.
phases.answer: Strategy: Before Boss Mirage enters "Lunar Devourer" state, defeat as many Wolftroopers as possible to gain enhancements.

skills.name: How to gain "Blood Surge" and quickly enter "Lunar Devourer" state

texts.description: Defeating Wolftroopers will grant "Blood Surge" to all allies and apply "Bloodlust" to Boss Mirage, accelerating its progression toward "Lunar Devourer" state
Reserve more strength before entering "Going Solo" and try to select an ally character with a summon for an advantage in action count.

phases.name: Phase II: Devourer of Heaven and Moon
phases.description: Boss Mirage's abilities deal DMG to Wolftroopers. This is additionally enhanced when Boss Mirage enters "Lunar Devourer" state.
phases.answer: Strategy: Defeat Wolftroopers before Boss Mirage acts to prevent Wolftroopers from being eliminated by Boss Mirage.

skills.name: Avoid missing out on gaining "Blood Surge"

texts.description: Wolftroopers eliminated by Boss Mirage cannot grant "Blood Surge" to allies. Try to defeat as many Wolftroopers as possible before Boss Mirage acts.

guides.description: Decreases DMG taken by Boss Mirage by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and increases its DMG taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

When Boss Mirage enters the "Lunar Devourer" state, Weakness Protection will be removed, and the strongest ally character must be selected to engage in "Going Solo" against Boss Mirage. During "Going Solo," apart from the selected character and their summoned unit, all other ally targets will enter the Departed state.
When an ally defeats an enemy Wolftrooper, gain "Blood Surge." The character entering "Going Solo" and their summoned unit will be enhanced based on "Blood Surge" stacks.

texts.description: Prioritize defeating Wolftroopers before Boss Mirage enters "Lunar Devourer" state to grant "Blood Surge" to allies and accelerate Boss Mirage's progression toward "Lunar Devourer" state.
Reserve strength as Boss Mirage is about to enter "Lunar Devourer" state to better handle "Going Solo."
During "Going Solo," if the selected ally character has a summon, the summoned unit will enter "Going Solo" alongside the character.

Bearing the hatred of seven centuries of bitter confinement, the Lord of Wolves challenges the entire Xianzhou Luofu upon breaking free from his cage. Yet, there seems to be another objective hidden behind his maddened actions...

203501201.name: Hellcharred Shadow General
203501201.description: Under the influence of Crimson Moon, Feixiao commands the giant beast like a goddess, emanating terrifying power with her every move.

skills.name: Gunblade: Swordfang
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Great Ax: Irontalon
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG to one designated target, with a high chance to inflict <u>Weaken</u>.

skills.name: Heaven's Binds
skills.description: Enhances self to gain additional action.

skills.name: Wreathed in Storm
skills.description: Resonates with all parts of the Ecliptic Inner Beast and dispels their Weakness Broken state. This unit cannot be attacked before its next action. In the next action, this unit will use "Sweep the Heavens, Swallow the Earth" on all targets.

skills.name: Sweep the Heavens, Swallow the Earth
skills.description: Deals massive Wind DMG to all targets and Enhances this unit based on the parts that have yet to be Weakness Broken. Every part that has yet to be Broken will increase the DMG dealt by this ability, and this ability will enhance the parts that are not Weakness Broken.

skills.name: Soul-Shattering Malediction
skills.description: Target can select one character. Then, deals Wind DMG to the selected character and causes them to enter the "Malediction" state. In the "Malediction" state, the target and their summon are <u>Departed</u>. At the same time, summons "Bloodstained Lupine" to replace the Departed character in battle, and "Bloodstained Lupine" is considered as a target character.

skills.name: Union of Minds
skills.description: "Hellcharred Shadow General's" extra turn will Resonate with "Sanerot Hearteater's" parts. The Resonance will dispel the Weakness Broken state on "Sanerot Hearteater's" parts, and their next action becomes an enhanced action. "Nebula Devourer's" Resonance has a high chance of causing all targets to enter <u>Outrage</u> state. "Planeshred Claws's" Resonance greatly increases DMG. "Worldpurge Tail's" Resonance has a high chance of causing all targets to enter <u>Weaken</u> state.

300202001.name: Dreamjolt Troupe's Fortune Seller
300202001.description:
Penacony's service machinery that got out of control due to the emotional interference in the Dreamscape.
Originally a prize-drawing robot made to bring surprise to guests, it still bears all kinds of gifts even after losing control, and longs to prove the good luck of the guest by sacrificing itself.

skills.name: Lottery Warmup
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Dreamjolt Prizepool
skills.description: When receiving a killing blow from the designated attack type, triggers different effects based on the attack type. When simultaneously receiving attacks of multiple types, the effects will be triggered in the following order of priority: Lost the <unbreak>50</unbreak>/<unbreak>50</unbreak>!, Hit the Guarantee!, and Jackpot!

skills.name: Lost the <unbreak>50</unbreak>/<unbreak>50</unbreak>!
skills.description: After suffering a killing blow from a Basic ATK or DoT, recovers Skill Points for targets.

skills.name: Hit the Guarantee!
skills.description: After suffering a killing blow from a Skill, Memosprite Skill, or a Follow-Up ATK, regenerates Energy for all targets.

skills.name: Jackpot!
skills.description: After suffering a killing blow from an Ultimate, regenerates Energy and Skill Points for all targets.

300301001.name: Dreamjolt Troupe's Beyond Overcooked
300301001.description:
Penacony's service machinery that got out of control due to the emotional interference in the Dreamscape.
Originally a culinary robot, it is still breathing fire for grilling ingredients after losing control, intending to burn the diners to crisps.

skills.name: Ladle Swirl
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Tornado Toss
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to a single target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Ignite Stove
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. In the next action, uses Flaming Stir-Fry if Stove Heating has not reached a certain number of stacks, then clears all Stove Heating stacks.

skills.name: Flaming Stir-Fry
skills.description: Deals massive Fire DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Kitchen Mishap
skills.description: After entering the Charging state, deals massive Fire DMG to all friendly units and decreases this unit's DEF once Stove Heating has a certain number of stacks. Then, clears all Stove Heating stacks.

skills.name: Flame-Forged Feast
skills.description: While not under the Charging state, upon reaching a certain number of Stove Heating stacks, immediately takes action and uses Ignite Stove.

skills.name: Inferno Stove
skills.description: When attacking, this unit has a chance to Slow the target. When this unit is attacked or takes DoT, gains 1 stack of Stove Heating.

Originally a culinary robot, it is still breathing fire for grilling ingredients after losing control, intending to burn the diners to crisps.

skills.name: Ladle Swirl
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Tornado Toss
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to a single target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Ignite Stove
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. In the next action, uses Flaming Stir-Fry if Stove Heating has not reached a certain number of stacks, then clears all Stove Heating stacks.

skills.name: Flaming Stir-Fry
skills.description: Deals massive Fire DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Kitchen Mishap
skills.description: After entering the Charging state, deals massive Fire DMG to all friendly units and decreases this unit's DEF once Stove Heating has a certain number of stacks. Then, clears all Stove Heating stacks.

skills.name: Flame-Forged Feast
skills.description: While not under the Charging state, upon reaching a certain number of Stove Heating stacks, immediately takes action and uses Ignite Stove.

skills.name: Inferno Stove
skills.description: When attacking, this unit has a chance to Slow the target. When this unit is attacked or takes DoT, gains 1 stack of Stove Heating.

skills.description: Increases all targets' ATK. This ability can only be used while under the "Off-Class Channel" state.

skills.name: Disrupt Banasyllabus
skills.description: After being attacked, switches the "Classroom Channel" state to the "Off-Class Channel" state. When in "Off-Class Channel" state, will not switch channels after being attacked.

skills.name: Teach Monkeys a Banalesson
skills.description: When attacking, this unit has a chance to apply the Slow state on the target.

skills.description: Deals Ice DMG to a single target. When hitting targets without a Shield, there is a small chance of Freezing the attacked target. If the target has a Shield, additionally deals Ice DMG to this unit with a high chance to decrease this unit's DEF.

skills.description: Deals Ice DMG to a random single target for 4 times. When each hit lands on a target that has no Shield, there is a high chance of Freezing the target. 300303001.name: "Past Confined and Caged"
300303001.description: An artist playing the role of the prisoner in the Sweet Dreams Troupe. It should be performing in the Charmony Festival, but it is now bound by Order and keeps performing scenes of the "Past." The past is an immortal chain, its tranquil flame igniting within a cage, beckoning the jailer's authority with mere candlelight.

skills.name: Cleansing Flagellation
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Admonishment of the Masses
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Shackle-Bearing Messenger
skills.description: Locks onto one target and enters the Charging state. In the next action, uses "Desmios Evangelion." During the Charging state, if this unit is attacked by another target, it will also lock onto the attacking target. Delays the unit's action when they are Weakness Broken during the Charging state.

skills.name: Desmios Evangelion
skills.description: Deals massive Physical DMG to one designated locked-on target, the DMG is <u>evenly distributed</u> across all targets.

phases.description: Attacking units in the "Classroom Channel" state multiple times can switch it to the "Off-Class Channel" state and immediately obtain that unit's "Off-Class Channel" reward 1 time.

skills.name: How to switch enemy units from "Classroom Channel" to "Off-Class Channel"

texts.description: Attack enemy units in "Classroom Channel" multiple times to accumulate the Switch Tally. Once the tally is full, enemy units will change to "Off-Class Channel." Breaking enemy units in "Classroom Channel" can also switch it to "Off-Class Channel."

skills.name: How to reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness

texts.description: Breaking enemy weakness can significantly reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness. When all enemies are Weakness Broken, attacking any enemy will also reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness. Can break enemy target's weakness via either Switch Tally or Toughness Reduction.

guides.description: All enemy units take <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. At the moment Boss Mirage's <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is Broken</color>, Weakness Breaks all enemy units and causes its action to be additionally delayed and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

Breaking enemy weakness can <color=#f29e38ff>significantly reduce</color> Boss Mirage's Toughness. When all enemies are Weakness Broken, attacking any enemy will also <color=#f29e38ff>reduce</color> Boss Mirage's Toughness.
After the enemy gets <color=#f29e38ff>attacked a certain number of times</color> or has their Toughness reduced, they will be inflicted with Weakness Break, granting a chance for "Off-Class Channel."

texts.description: Using abilities that do <color=#f29e38ff>AoE ATKs</color> can simultaneously accumulate the Switch Tallies for multiple enemy targets.
Using abilities with <color=#f29e38ff>high Toughness Reduction</color> can rapidly Break the Weakness of units in the "Classroom Channel" state and cause them to switch channels.
