skills.name: How to switch enemy units from "Classroom Channel" to "Off-Class Channel"

texts.description: Attack enemy units in "Classroom Channel" multiple times to accumulate the Switch Tally. Once the tally is full, enemy units will change to "Off-Class Channel." Breaking enemy units in "Classroom Channel" can also switch it to "Off-Class Channel."

skills.name: How to reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness

texts.description: Breaking enemy weakness can significantly reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness. When all enemies are Weakness Broken, attacking any enemy will also reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness. Can break enemy target's weakness via either Switch Tally or Toughness Reduction.

guides.description: All enemy units take <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. At the moment Boss Mirage's <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is Broken</color>, Weakness Breaks all enemy units and causes its action to be additionally delayed and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

Breaking enemy weakness can <color=#f29e38ff>significantly reduce</color> Boss Mirage's Toughness. When all enemies are Weakness Broken, attacking any enemy will also <color=#f29e38ff>reduce</color> Boss Mirage's Toughness.
After the enemy gets <color=#f29e38ff>attacked a certain number of times</color> or has their Toughness reduced, they will be inflicted with Weakness Break, granting a chance for "Off-Class Channel."

texts.description: Using abilities that do <color=#f29e38ff>AoE ATKs</color> can simultaneously accumulate the Switch Tallies for multiple enemy targets.
Using abilities with <color=#f29e38ff>high Toughness Reduction</color> can rapidly Break the Weakness of units in the "Classroom Channel" state and cause them to switch channels.

An entity imbued with specific cognition, formed by the accumulation of subconscious fragments in the Memory Zone.

Memories of anguish burn like flames, scorching the heart. When the suffering fades away, the life born from resentment will rise from the ashes, accumulating boundless fury.

skills.name: Grudging Courtesy
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to a single target and gains 1 stack of Obscure Blaze.

skills.name: Sobs of the Tempest
skills.description: Enters the Charging state, gains 3 stacks of Obscure Blaze and 1 stack of Terrathorn. Deals Bonepiercing Odium with each action, and loses the Charging state after being Weakness Broken.

skills.name: Tide of Enduring Grudges
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to all targets and gains 1 stack of Obscure Blaze.

skills.name: Bonepiercing Odium
skills.description: Deals minor successive Quantum DMG to a random target. Each stack of Obscure Blaze additionally deals DMG 1 time.

skills.name: Disembodied Shell
skills.description: Enters the Safeguard state. When not Weakness Broken, reduces DMG received. Once Weakness is Broken, action will be delayed. After Weakness is Broken, increases DMG received.

301402001.name: Memory Zone Meme "Something Unto Death"
301402001.description:
An entity imbued with specific cognition, formed by the accumulation of subconscious fragments in the Memory Zone.
A mysterious and dangerous Memory Zone Meme, seen as the "death" that shouldn't exist in dreams. Its sinister shadow wanders within the Twelve Hours, bringing unforeseen calamity wherever it goes. It spreads misfortune like a sharp blade, casting a shadow of death over beautiful dreams.

skills.name: Funereal Kiss
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Sunken Rain
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Biting Obituary
skills.description: Greatly increases DMG dealt for 1 turn. This effect is removed when this unit becomes Weakness Broken.

skills.name: Fading Radiance
skills.description: Enters the Sunset state. Gains 1 stack each time a character uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate. When Sunset reaches 3 stacks, immediately use Losing Eventide Light on the last-acting target. This effect is removed after using Losing Eventide Light once or after becoming Weakness Broken.

skills.name: Losing Eventide Light
skills.description: Immediately launches a killing blow on the last-acting target who used Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, and inflicts Morbid Dream on them.

skills.name: Go Into That Good Night
skills.description: Enters the Nightfall state, regenerates energy for all targets, and locks onto the 2 targets who are due to act next. Uses Watery Dissolution in the next action.

skills.name: Watery Dissolution
skills.description: Immediately launches a killing blow on all locked-on targets and inflicts Morbid Dream on them. If there are no locked-on targets, launches a killing blow on 2 random targets and inflicts Morbid Dream on them.

skills.name: Sad True Lover Never Find My Grave
skills.description: Whenever a target gets inflicted with Morbid Dream, summons a corresponding Sombrous Sepulcher. When all targets get inflicted with Morbid Dream or are knocked down, this battle will be considered a defeat.

phases.name: Phase I — Power of Offense and Defense
phases.description: Boss Mirage will summon 2 types of units: Speartip and Shield.
phases.answer: Strategy: Defeat the enhanced summons first to weaken Boss Mirage.

texts.description: Defeat enhanced Speartip summons to enhance allies and weaken Boss Mirage.

skills.name: Counters Boss Mirage's AoE DMG dealt when Shield summons are present

texts.description: Defeat Shield summons to gain a Shield and effectively increase survivability.

phases.name: Phase II — Battle for Glory
phases.description: Boss Mirage will additionally summon The Honored units.
phases.answer: Strategy: Defeat the enhanced summons first to weaken Boss Mirage.

skills.name: Counters Boss Mirage being unselectable when The Honored summons are present

texts.description: When The Honored summons are present, Boss Mirage cannot be selected. It can only be targeted in the next action or after all The Honored summons are defeated.

skills.name: Counters the massive DMG dealt by Boss Mirage using Undeniable Fate

texts.description: Defeat or break The Honored summons to reduce the DMG dealt by Boss Mirage's Undeniable Fate.

guides.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.
"Soulfreed" <color=#f29e38ff>summons</color> will be greatly enhanced.

texts.description: After <color=#f29e38ff>Breaking</color> Boss Mirage, the DMG it receives is greatly increased, Skill Points are recovered for the team, and the team's action is Advanced Forward.
Defeat or break <color=#f29e38ff>summons</color> first to effectively weaken Boss Mirage.

302402001.name: Stellaron Hunter: Sam
302402001.description: One of the Stellaron Hunters, a mysterious warrior donning formidable armor. The mech suit wields the power to unleash fiery onslaughts, engulfing the battlefield in flames.

skills.name: BHF: Fiery Advance
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to a single target.

skills.name: BHF: Heavenly Fire
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to one designated target and any adjacent targets.

skills.name: BBHF: Scorched Earth
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to all targets.

skills.name: DHGDR: Secondary Combustion
skills.description: Consumes HP to enter the Secondary Combustion state and dispels the Weakness Protected effect. Becomes significantly more powerful in this state, but all attacks consume HP.

skills.name: DHGDR: Supernova Overload
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to all targets, with a high chance to Burn them.

skills.name: SGE: Molten Core
skills.description: After entering Secondary Combustion, Combusts both the area and targets' Skill Points. When consuming Combusted Skill Points, targets lose HP and additionally deal a set amount of Fire DMG equal to a certain percentage of the original DMG. When they receive healing from sources other than oneself, the amount of HP restored is massively reduced.

skills.name: SGE: Molten Engine
skills.description: While in Secondary Combustion, Sam possesses Molten Energy. When Sam is attacked and the attack consumes Skill Points, a corresponding amount of Molten Energy is reduced. When Molten Energy is depleted or when the Weakness is Broken, dispels Secondary Combustion. When Secondary Combustion is dispelled, Sam receives increased DMG, and recovers all Skill Points for the targets.

skills.name: DHGDR: Fire and Cinders
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to a single target. When using the ability, the more Molten Energy stacks there are, the higher the damage dealt.

skills.name: SEG: Thermocumulative Upgrade
skills.description: Whenever Sam loses HP due to the Secondary Combustion effect while attacking, increase the DMG they deal.

skills.name: SEG: Thermobaric Field
skills.description: When a target uses Combusted Skill Points or receives Burn DMG, inflict <u>Immolation</u> on the target. When Sam dispels the Secondary Combustion, the <u>Immolation</u> effect is removed.

302403001.name: Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare
302403001.description: As though the Glamoth Iron Cavalry armor was corroded by Propagation, beneath the shell covered in strange matter lies only a wish twisted by the Stellaron. Deep within the dreamscape, the Swarm Disaster resurfaces in this form.

skills.name: Rend, Putrefy, Engorge
skills.description: Enters "Gene Duplication" state, increasing this unit's SPD. Summons "Juvenile Sting" and apply "Rapid Evolution" state to it. A target character and their summoned target can immediately take action and enter the "Nemesis" state, increasing their Break Effect. When targets not in the "Nemesis" state attack friendly units in the "Rapid Evolution" state, they cannot deal CRIT Hit effects.

skills.name: Primordial Tide, Swarm of Death
skills.description: Deals massive Fire DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Malignform Elytra
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Rapacious Appendages
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to one designated target and any adjacent targets.

skills.name: Encroach, Mangle, Sate
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Primal Hunger
skills.description: Increases the SPD of "Juvenile Sting" summoned by this unit.

skills.name: Whirling Carapace
skills.description: When "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" is attacked, a portion of its reduced HP is converted into "Corrosion." When "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" uses "Primordial Tide, Swarm of Death," it will recover HP equal to the corrosion amount.

skills.name: Symbiosis, Swarm, Gnaw
skills.description: After entering the "Gene Duplication" state, the field enters Combustion. "Gene Duplication" is dispelled when all summoned "Juvenile Sting" are defeated. When "Gene Duplication" is dispelled, "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" receives increased DMG, and dispels the "Corrosion" state.

skills.name: Universal Blight, Howl of the Life Eater
skills.description: After entering the "Gene Duplication" state, whenever this unit uses an attack, it additionally deals minor Fire DMG based on the number of "Juvenile Sting" remaining. When any "Juvenile Sting" uses an attack, "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" gains a stack of "Mortal Instinct." When "Mortal Instinct" reaches a certain number of stacks, "Harbinger of Death: Swarm Nightmare" will immediately take action, uses "Primordial Tide, Swarm of Death" and clear all "Mortal Instinct" stacks. "Juvenile Sting" will prioritize attacking ally characters in the "Nemesis" state.

302501001.name: "Embryo of Philosophy" Sunday
302501001.description: Using the Harmonious Choir as a foundation, the power of Order and Harmony intertwine to form the shell of an egg, within which the newborn god slumbers. The metaphysical embryo mumbles the olden dreams of childhood as the fetal movement of Paths throbs in the long night, futilely resisting the rising dawn.

skills.name: Grazioso
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Maestoso
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Vaneggiando
skills.description: Makes a single target have a high chance of entering <u>Alien Dream</u>.

skills.name: Accelerando
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. Uses "Volteggiando" in the next turn.

skills.name: Accrescendo
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. Uses "Tempestoso" in the next turn.

skills.name: Volteggiando
skills.description: Makes all Echoes of Faded Dreams that can take action deal Imaginary DMG to a single target. If there are no Echoes of Faded Dreams that can take action, then this ability will fail to launch. After using this ability, restore Toughness for Echoes of Faded Dreams.

skills.name: Volteggiando
skills.description: Makes all Echoes of Faded Dreams that can take action deal Imaginary DMG to a single target. If there are no Echoes of Faded Dreams that can take action, then this ability will fail to launch. After using this ability, restore Toughness for Echoes of Faded Dreams.

skills.name: Tempestoso
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets, and makes all Echoes of Faded Dreams that can take action deal Imaginary DMG to all targets. After using this ability, restores Toughness for Echoes of Faded Dreams.

skills.name: Allargando
skills.description: Enters the "If We Live In the Light" state, gains a Shield, increases the DMG dealt, decreases the DMG taken, and makes Toughness immune to reduction.

skills.name: Im Anfang war das Wort
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. After 7 turns, uses "Im Anfang war die Tat."

skills.name: Im Anfang war die Tat
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets. This DMG application ignores the targets' DEF.

skills.name: Work of Creation
skills.description: "Embryo of Philosophy" Sunday has weaknesses of all Types. While "Embryo of Philosophy" Sunday is in the "Im Anfang war die Kraft" state, it will immediately take action after every action taken by targets and becomes immune to action delay effects caused by targets. When it becomes Weakness Broken, its action is additionally delayed. Moreover, after one stack of its Toughness is Broken, it applies <u>Walk in the Light</u> to targets.

skills.name: Come Un Sogno
skills.description: "Harmonious Choir" The Great Septimus summons 4 "Echoes of Faded Dreams." The DMG dealt to the Echoes of Faded Dreams is completely redistributed to "Harmonious Choir" The Great Septimus instead. When this unit and Echoes of Faded Dreams become Weakness Broken, additionally delays action. For every stack of this unit's Toughness that is broken, apply the <u>Walk in the Light</u> state to targets.

302501201.name: "Harmonious Choir" The Great Septimus
302501201.description: Dominicus, the wisher of the Harmonious Choir, is one of the many embodiments of Xipe the Harmony. Due to the interferences from the Order, his appearance is different from before. Materialized as the Hive Mind's response to wishes, the hymns he conducts can reshape the world and create new laws per the wishes, and all who made this wish will become the source of his power.

skills.name: Im Anfang war die Tat
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets. This DMG application ignores the targets' DEF.

skills.name: Work of Creation
skills.description: "Embryo of Philosophy" Sunday has weaknesses of all Types. While "Embryo of Philosophy" Sunday is in the "Im Anfang war die Kraft" state, it will immediately take action after every action taken by targets and becomes immune to action delay effects caused by targets. When it becomes Weakness Broken, its action is additionally delayed. Moreover, after one stack of its Toughness is Broken, it applies <u>Walk in the Light</u> to targets.

skills.name: Come Un Sogno
skills.description: "Harmonious Choir" The Great Septimus summons 4 "Echoes of Faded Dreams." The DMG dealt to the Echoes of Faded Dreams is completely redistributed to "Harmonious Choir" The Great Septimus instead. When this unit and Echoes of Faded Dreams become Weakness Broken, additionally delays action. For every stack of this unit's Toughness that is broken, apply the <u>Walk in the Light</u> state to targets.

302501301.name: Cacophonic Conductor
302501301.description: Dominicus, the wisher of the Harmonious Choir, is one of the many embodiments of Xipe the Harmony. Due to the interferences from the Order, his appearance is different from before. Materialized as the Hive Mind's response to wishes, the hymns he conducts can reshape the world and create new laws per the wishes, and all who made this wish will become the source of his power.

skills.name: Grazioso
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Maestoso
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Vaneggiando
skills.description: Makes one designated target have a high chance of entering "<u>Alien Dream</u>."

skills.name: Variation
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. Uses "Dancing in Dreams" in the next turn.

skills.name: Melisma
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. Uses "Singing in Rain" in the next turn, while also restoring all "Echoes of Faded Dreams"' Toughness.

skills.name: Dancing in Dreams
skills.description: Makes all Echoes of Faded Dreams that can take action deal Imaginary DMG to one designated target. If there are no Echoes of Faded Dreams that can take action, then this ability fails to launch and reduces a massive amount of Toughness.

skills.name: Dancing in Dreams
skills.description: Makes all Echoes of Faded Dreams that can take action deal Imaginary DMG to one designated target. If there are no Echoes of Faded Dreams that can take action, then this ability fails to launch and reduces a massive amount of Toughness.

skills.name: Singing in Rain
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets, and makes all Echoes of Faded Dreams that can take action deal Imaginary DMG to all targets. If there are no Echoes of Faded Dreams that can take action, then this ability fails to launch and reduces a massive amount of Toughness.

skills.name: Phonation Unbound
skills.description: Enters the "One With the Light" state, gains a Shield, and increases the DMG dealt.

skills.name: Im Anfang war das Wort
skills.description: Enters the Charge state. After 7 turns, uses "Im Anfang war die Tat."

skills.name: Im Anfang war die Tat
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets. This DMG application ignores the targets' DEF.

skills.name: Resonant Projection
skills.description: While in the "Im Anfang war die Kraft" state, after every action taken by opposing targets, "Cacophonic Conductor" immediately takes action, and becomes immune to action delay effects caused by opposing targets. At the same time, the "Im Anfang war die Tat" tally will not be interrupted when this unit becomes Weakness Broken.

skills.name: Grand Dream's Awakening
skills.description: Cacophonic Conductor summons 4 Echoes of Faded Dreams. The DMG taken by the Echoes of Faded Dreams is completely redistributed to Cacophonic Conductor. At the same time, any currently Weakness Broken Echoes of Faded Dreams recover Toughness after turn taken by this unit. After each stack of this unit Toughness is depleted, applies "<u>Walk in the Light</u>" to the target team.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Rhythm Without End
tags.description: Summons take <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After Boss Mirage's <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is Broken</color>, the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Grief and Joy Shared
tags.description: Boss Mirage <color=#f29e38ff><u>shares</u></color> its own Weakness Type to summons, and at the same time, increases RES that does not correspond to Weakness Type by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Great One's Benediction
tags.description: Summons' Max Toughness increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color>.

phases.name: Phase I: Chorus of the Crowd
phases.description: Boss Mirage will use "Dancing in Dreams" and "Singing in Rain" to deal massive DMG.
phases.answer: Strategy: Break the summons' Weaknesses before "Dancing in Dreams" and "Singing in Rain" are used.

skills.name: How to charge and use "Horizon's Echo From Afar"

texts.description: After summons are Weakness Broken, "Horizon's Echo From Afar" charges up. "Horizon's Echo From Afar" can reduce all enemy units' Toughness. Hit as many enemy units not yet Weakness Broken as possible to maximize the benefits of Toughness reduction.

skills.name: Counters the DMG dealt by Boss Mirage's "Dancing in Dreams" and "Singing in Rain"

texts.description: Inflict Weakness Break on as many summons as possible to weaken the DMG of "Dancing in Dreams" and "Singing in Rain." The more summons not Weakness Broken, the higher the DMG from Boss Mirage's "Dancing in Dreams" and "Singing in Rain." When all summons are under the Weakness Broken state, Boss Mirage will have its Toughness reduced when it uses "Dancing in Dreams" and "Singing in Rain."

skills.name: Counters the control effect of "Alien Dream"

texts.description: Increases Effect RES or use abilities to dispel the "Alien Dream" state.

phases.name: Phase II: Final Movement
phases.description: "Echo of Faded Dreams" will not leave the battlefield, and "Im Anfang war die Tat" will not be interrupted.
phases.answer: Strategy: Break enemy Weakness to Charge the "Horizon's Echo From Afar" and grant Shields to the team.

skills.name: Counters the DMG dealt by Boss Mirage's "Im Anfang war die Tat"

texts.description: Break summons or reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness to gain Shield and withstand "Im Anfang war die Tat."

guides.description: Boss Mirage and its summons take <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

When summons are <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness Broken</color>, Boss Mirage will lose a certain amount of Toughness. After summons are <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness Broken</color>, "Horizon's Echo From Afar" charges up. Use "Horizon's Echo From Afar" to deal massive DMG to all enemies and reduce their Toughness.

texts.description: <color=#f29e38ff>Break</color> Boss Mirage to greatly increase the DMG taken by Boss Mirage and their summons, as well as recovering Skill Points and activating all allies' Ultimate.
Break <color=#f29e38ff>summons</color> multiple times to Charge "Horizon's Echo From Afar" effectively. Use "Horizon's Echo From Afar" to deal Toughness Reduction to all enemies.

guides.description: Boss Mirage and its summons take <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

When summons are <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness Broken</color>, Boss Mirage will lose a certain amount of Toughness. After summons are <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness Broken</color>, "Horizon's Echo From Afar" charges up. Use "Horizon's Echo From Afar" to deal massive DMG to all enemies and reduce their Toughness.

Boss Mirage will <color=#f29e38ff>share its own Weakness Type to the summon</color>. After any one of its summons is <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness Broken</color>, the summon's Weakness Type will be <color=#f29e38ff>added</color> to all enemy targets.

texts.description: <color=#f29e38ff>Break</color> Boss Mirage to greatly increase the DMG taken by Boss Mirage and their summons, as well as recovering Skill Points and activating all allies' Ultimate.
Break <color=#f29e38ff>summons</color> multiple times to Charge "Horizon's Echo From Afar" effectively. Use "Horizon's Echo From Afar" to deal Toughness Reduction to all enemies.

Prioritize Breaking <color=#f29e38ff>summons</color> with Weakness Type advantageous to ally character's DMG Type and causes its Weakness Type to be <color=#f29e38ff>shared</color> to all enemy targets.

401201004.name: Furiae Warrior
401201004.description: A Titankin sculpted by "Strife." They are infused with Nikador's golden ichor. Their robust bodies are the shields of the army, and they use their stony corpus to cut off their foes, while their powerful limbs carry rations across the battlefield. They are also used as sparring partners by the soldiers of Kremnos.

skills.name: Collision of the Third Orbit
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target. When "War Armor" stacks are not 0 on this unit, there is a chance to inflict "Reverberation" on the target. When this unit has 0 "War Armor" stacks, inflict "Reverberation" on this unit.

skills.name: Polis Protector
skills.description: Possesses a number of "War Armor" stacks, which decreases DMG taken. Loses 1 stack of "War Armor" on this unit after being attacked. When at 0 stacks, "War Armor" will be destroyed, dealing massive Imaginary DMG to this unit and delaying their action. The target that destroyed "War Armor" will regenerate Energy. After "War Armor" is destroyed, this unit will also additionally take minor Imaginary DMG when attacked. "War Armor" will be restored to maximum stacks at the end of this unit's turn.

401206001.name: Conquer or Be Conquered
401206001.description:
The tip of its spear has drawn a boundless border.

401209001.description: Theos Synthetos's wandering monocular eye. It lacks imaging capability and primarily functions to assist the main eye in polarizing the weather.

401301001.name: Furiae Praetor
401301001.description:
A Titankin sculpted by "Strife." They are infused with Nikador's golden ichor. They are mighty constructs capable of housing a Titan's soul. With their greatswords, they stand ready to repel the rush of the black tide or turn their blade in a countering onslaught in times of war.
Furiae Praetor will sacrifice their weaker kin, exchanging atrocity for divine punishments from the Titan.

skills.name: From Skyveil to Dawn
skills.description: Starting from the leftmost target, uses a sweeping attack on 3 consecutive targets, dealing minor Imaginary DMG.

skills.name: From Dawn to Skyveil
skills.description: Starting from the rightmost target, uses a sweeping attack on 3 consecutive targets, dealing minor Imaginary DMG.

skills.name: Resembling Furious Lion
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. Uses "Drowned in the Crimson Sea" in the next turn.

skills.name: Drowned in the Crimson Sea
skills.description: Absorbs "Furiae Warrior," then deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets and inflicts Vulnerability on them. The DMG and Vulnerability states are <u>distributed evenly</u> among the targets. The more "Furiae Warriors" absorbed, the higher the DMG dealt.

skills.name: Rise from the Grave
skills.description: Summons "Furiae Warrior."

skills.name: Polis Protector
skills.description: Possesses a number of "War Armor" stacks, which decreases DMG taken. Loses 1 stack of "War Armor" on this unit after being attacked. When at 0 stacks, "War Armor" will be destroyed, dealing massive Imaginary DMG to this unit and delaying their action. The target that destroyed "War Armor" will regenerate Energy. After "War Armor" is destroyed, this unit will also additionally take minor Imaginary DMG when attacked. "War Armor" will be restored to maximum stacks at the end of this unit's turn.

skills.name: Resembling Furious Lion
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. Uses "Drowned in the Crimson Sea" in the next turn.

skills.name: Drowned in the Crimson Sea
skills.description: Absorbs "Furiae Warrior," then deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets and inflicts Vulnerability on them. The DMG and Vulnerability states are <u>distributed evenly</u> among the targets. The more "Furiae Warriors" absorbed, the higher the DMG dealt.

skills.name: Rise from the Grave
skills.description: Summons "Furiae Warrior."

skills.name: Polis Protector
skills.description: Possesses a number of "War Armor" stacks, which decreases DMG taken. Loses 1 stack of "War Armor" on this unit after being attacked. When at 0 stacks, "War Armor" will be destroyed, dealing massive Imaginary DMG to this unit and delaying their action. The target that destroyed "War Armor" will regenerate Energy. After "War Armor" is destroyed, this unit will also additionally take minor Imaginary DMG when attacked. "War Armor" will be restored to maximum stacks at the end of this unit's turn.

Furiae Praetor will sacrifice their weaker kin, exchanging atrocity for divine punishments from the Titan.

401301601.description: The legendary Dolos Bandit Twins, unmatched in combat prowess and flawless teamwork. Even the mightiest heroes fell before their four fists. After all, two fists rarely triumph against four.

skills.description: In each phase, when this unit is knocked down, its action is delayed, and it enters the "Repose" state. During its next action, uses "Indomitable Battle," recovers a certain amount of HP, and gets up.

401401001.name: Savage God, Mad King, Incarnation of Strife
401401001.description:
The Titan of Strife continues the mad war in their frenzy, becoming the unconquerable fear of the masses of Amphoreus.
They once were famed through glory, earning respect from gods and from the people of the land. And yet, the city that revered them was sundered, and the poems that praised their name were destroyed. Only their evil reputation lingers in this lightless era and end times, tainting the Throne of Worlds' brilliance.

skills.name: Lightning Spear of the Firmament
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Worldsplitting Spine
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Hewing of the River of Souls
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Survivors Unto Dead Waters
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Unceasing Flames of War
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Pyre of High Graves
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Sky-Piercing Lance
skills.description: Deals successive minor Imaginary DMG to random single targets.

skills.name: Ruination of Night and Light
skills.description: Deals successive minor Imaginary DMG to random single targets.

skills.name: Calamity Eternal
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets and apply <u>"Glory"</u>. At the same time, this unit obtains "Titanic Corpus." When "Titanic Corpus" stacks are reduced to 0, this unit's action is delayed, takes massive Imaginary DMG, and regenerates Energy for all targets. Possessing "Titanic Corpus" will greatly increase the DMG dealt by the next attack, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment on all attacked targets.

skills.name: All Realms Leveled, All Legions to Dust
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets. The DMG is <u>distributed evenly</u> among the targets.

skills.name: Polis Protector
skills.description: Possesses a number of "War Armor" stacks, which decreases DMG taken. Loses 1 stack of "War Armor" on this unit after being attacked. When at 0 stacks, "War Armor" will be destroyed, dealing massive Imaginary DMG to this unit and delaying their action. The target that destroyed "War Armor" will regenerate Energy. After "War Armor" is destroyed, this unit will also additionally take minor Imaginary DMG when attacked. "War Armor" will be restored to maximum stacks at the end of this unit's turn.

skills.name: Valorous Death Before Glorious Return
skills.description: When using "Calamity Eternal," apply <u>"Glory"</u> to all targets. Every stack of <u>"Glory"</u> increases DMG dealt and Energy Regeneration Rate. When the affected target uses Skill or Ultimate, <u>"Glory"</u> can be stacked. After the next action by "Savage God, Mad King, Incarnation of Strife," dispel <u>"Glory"</u> from all targets.

The Titan of Strife continues the mad war in their frenzy, becoming the unconquerable fear of the masses of Amphoreus.
They once were famed through glory, earning respect from gods and from the people of the land. And yet, the city that revered them was sundered, and the poems that praised their name were destroyed. Only their evil reputation lingers in this lightless era and end times, tainting the Throne of Worlds' brilliance.

skills.name: Lightning Spear of the Firmament
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Worldsplitting Spine
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Hewing of the River of Souls
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Survivors Unto Dead Waters
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Unceasing Flames of War
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Pyre of High Graves
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Sky-Piercing Lance
skills.description: Deals successive minor Imaginary DMG to random single targets.

skills.name: Ruination of Night and Light
skills.description: Deals successive minor Imaginary DMG to random single targets.

skills.name: Calamity Eternal
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets and apply <u>"Glory"</u>. At the same time, this unit obtains "Titanic Corpus." When "Titanic Corpus" stacks are reduced to 0, this unit's action is delayed, takes massive Imaginary DMG, and regenerates Energy for all targets. Possessing "Titanic Corpus" will greatly increase the DMG dealt by the next attack, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment on all attacked targets.

skills.name: All Realms Leveled, All Legions to Dust
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets. The DMG is <u>distributed evenly</u> among the targets.

skills.name: Polis Protector
skills.description: Possesses a number of "War Armor" stacks, which decreases DMG taken. Loses 1 stack of "War Armor" on this unit after being attacked. When at 0 stacks, "War Armor" will be destroyed, dealing massive Imaginary DMG to this unit and delaying their action. The target that destroyed "War Armor" will regenerate Energy. After "War Armor" is destroyed, this unit will also additionally take minor Imaginary DMG when attacked. "War Armor" will be restored to maximum stacks at the end of this unit's turn.

skills.name: Valorous Death Before Glorious Return
skills.description: When using "Calamity Eternal," apply <u>"Glory"</u> to all targets. Every stack of <u>"Glory"</u> increases DMG dealt and Energy Regeneration Rate. When the affected target uses Skill or Ultimate, <u>"Glory"</u> can be stacked. After the next action by "Savage God, Mad King, Incarnation of Strife," dispel <u>"Glory"</u> from all targets.

401401301.name: The Ravaged Unconquerable
401401301.description:
The Titan of Strife continues the mad war in their frenzy, becoming the unconquerable fear of Amphoreus's states.
They once were famed through glory, earning respect from gods and from the cities of the land. And yet, the city that revered them was sundered, and the poems that praised their name were destroyed. Only their evil reputation lingers in this lightless era and end times, tainting the Throne of Worlds's brilliance.

skills.name: Lightning Spear of the Firmament
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Worldsplitting Spine
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to a single target and adjacent targets and delays their action.

skills.name: Hewing of the River of Souls
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Survivors Unto Dead Waters
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a single target and delays their action.

skills.name: Unceasing Flames of War
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Pyre of High Graves
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all ally targets and delays their actions.

skills.name: Sky-Piercing Lance
skills.description: Deals successive minor Imaginary DMG to random targets.

skills.name: Ruination of Night and Light
skills.description: Repeatedly deals minor Imaginary DMG to a random ally and delays the attacked target's action.

skills.name: Calamity Eternal
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets. In Phase 1, increases this unit's <u>"War Armor"</u> stack limit and uses "All Realms Leveled, All Legions to Dust" in the next action. In Phase 2, uses "Fury Falls, and All Bows to Strife" together with "The Giver, Master of Legions, Lance of Fury" in the next action.

skills.name: All Realms Leveled, All Legions to Dust
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets, with the DMG <u>distributed evenly</u> among targets. This attack reduces all targets' <u>"Glory"</u> to 1 stack.

skills.name: The Solitary Throne
skills.description: "The Ravaged Unconquerable" possesses a number of <u>"War Armor"</u> stacks, which decreases DMG taken. Loses stacks of <u>"War Armor"</u> based on the attacker's <u>"Glory"</u> stacks when attacked. When at 0 stacks, <u>"War Armor"</u> will be destroyed, dealing massive Imaginary DMG to this unit, reducing their Toughness, delaying their action, and restoring Skill Points to targets. After <u>"War Armor"</u> is destroyed, this unit will also additionally take minor Imaginary DMG when attacked. <u>"War Armor"</u> will be restored to maximum stacks at the end of this unit's turn.

skills.name: The Last Monarch
skills.description: "The Ravaged Unconquerable"'s <u>"War Armor"</u> is enhanced into <u>"Centirefined War Armor"</u>, reducing damage taken by this unit. When <u>"Centirefined War Armor"</u> stacks are greater than 0, "The Ravaged Unconquerable" gains an additional Toughness Protection state. After being attacked, this unit's <u>"Centirefined War Armor"</u> stacks are reduced based on the attacker's <u>"Glory"</u> stacks. When reduced to 0 stacks, <u>"Centirefined War Armor"</u> is destroyed, dealing massive Imaginary DMG to this unit, reducing this unit's Toughness significantly, delaying its action, restoring its target's Skill Points, and granting the attacker certain stacks of <u>"Glory"</u>. After <u>"Centirefined War Armor"</u> is destroyed, this unit takes additional minor Imaginary DMG when attacked.

skills.name: Sever the Path Homeward
skills.description: At the start of combat, applies <u>"Glory"</u> to all targets. Each stack of <u>"Glory"</u> increases the target's CRIT DMG. Each Skill Point consumed adds 1 stack of <u>"Glory"</u>. When the "The Ravaged Unconquerable" uses "All Realms Leveled, All Legions to Dust" or recovers from Weakness Break state, all its targets' <u>"Glory"</u> stacks are reduced to 1. Its targets' Skill Points can exceed the limit.

skills.name: Death Brings Glory
skills.description: When entering Phase 2, all targets' <u>"Glory"</u> is reduced to 1 stack. Each stack of <u>"Glory"</u> increases the target's CRIT DMG, and 1 stack of <u>"Glory"</u> can be gained for each Skill Point consumed. The targets' Skill Points can exceed the limit.

skills.name: Will of Strife
skills.description: "The Ravaged Unconquerable" can take 4 actions per turn. When it acts, for each undestroyed <u>"Centirefined War Armor"</u> belonging to a "The Conquered" on the field, "The Ravaged Unconquerable" will use the <u>Centirefined attack ability</u>.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and increases its DMG taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Ironclad Renitence
tags.description: Boss Mirage and its summons have <color=#f29e38ff><u>"War Armor"</u></color>, reducing DMG taken by them. In phase two, <color=#f29e38ff><u>"War Armor"</u></color> will be enhanced to <color=#f29e38ff><u>"Centirefined War Armor"</u></color>, greatly increasing the maximum stack limit, and Boss Mirage will gain additional Toughness Protection.

tags.name: Taint of the Sublime
tags.description: In Phase 2, the max stack of Boss Mirage's "Centirefined War Armor" will increase.

tags.name: Protective Formation
tags.description: For <color=#f29e38ff>every unit</color> on the enemy's side of the field aside from Boss Mirage, all enemies receive less DMG and deal more DMG.

phases.name: Phase 1: Iron Steeds and Golden Spears
phases.description: Boss Mirage and its summons have "War Armor", reducing DMG taken by them.
phases.answer: Strategy: Prioritize consuming Skill Points to gain "Glory," which increases your CRIT DMG and reduces more stacks of "War Armor".

texts.description: Ally units gain 1 stack of "Glory" for each Skill Point consumed (memomasters and their memosprites will share "Glory" stacks). Actively consuming Skill Points will quickly increase the number of "Glory" stacks.
When an ally unit attacks an enemy target, it reduces their "War Armor" by an amount equal to the attacker's "Glory" stacks.

skills.name: How to Efficiently Reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness

texts.description: Destroying the "War Armor" of the Boss Mirage will massively reduce its Toughness. Defeating the summons of the Boss Mirage will reduce its Toughness by a small amount.

phases.name: Phase 2: Face-off with the Enemy
phases.description: The "War Armor" of Boss Mirage and its summons are enhanced into "Centirefined War Armor." Summons with "Centirefined War Armor" enhance Boss Mirage's abilities.
phases.answer: Strategy: Reducing the "Centirefined War Armor" of the summons before each Boss Mirage's action can effectively weaken the Boss Mirage's abilities.

skills.name: Counter the Toughness Protection state of the Boss Mirage

texts.description: When Boss Mirage's "Centirefined War Armor" stack count is greater than 0, it will be in a Toughness Protection state. Depleting its "Centirefined War Armor" will dispel the Toughness Protection state.

skills.name: Counter the Boss Mirage's "Centirefined Attack Ability" and "Fury Falls, and All Bows to Strife"

texts.description: Reducing the "Centirefined War Armor" of the summons before each Boss Mirage's action can effectively weaken the Boss Mirage's abilities.

guides.description: Boss Mirage and its summons take <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

Boss Mirage and its summons have <color=#f29e38ff>"War Armor"</color>, reducing DMG taken by them. In phase two, <color=#f29e38ff>"War Armor"</color> will be enhanced to <color=#f29e38ff>"Centirefined War Armor"</color>, greatly increasing the maximum stack limit, and Boss Mirage will gain additional <color=#f29e38ff>Toughness Protection</color>.

At the start of combat, all allies gain 1 stack of <color=#f29e38ff>"Glory"</color>. Ally units gain 1 stack of <color=#f29e38ff>"Glory"</color> for each <color=#f29e38ff>Skill Point</color> consumed (memomasters and their memosprites will share "Glory" stacks). Each stack of "Glory" increases CRIT DMG, and when enemy targets with "War Armor" are attacked, reduces their stacks of "War Armor" by an amount equal to the attacker's "Glory" stacks. Targets' <color=#f29e38ff>Skill Points can exceed the maximum limit</color>.

texts.description: Prioritize <color=#f29e38ff>consuming Skill Points</color> to gain <color=#f29e38ff>"Glory,"</color> increasing CRIT DMG dealt and reducing enemy "War Armor" stacks. Ally <color=#f29e38ff>Skill Points can exceed the maximum limit</color>.

When enemy targets have <color=#f29e38ff>"War Armor"</color>, their DEF is greatly increased. Reducing their "War Armor" will increase the DMG they take and <color=#f29e38ff>recover Skill Points</color>.

In Phase 2, when summons have <color=#f29e38ff>"Centirefined War Armor"</color>, the Boss Mirage's abilities will be enhanced. Prioritizing reducing the summons' "Centirefined War Armor" can effectively <color=#f29e38ff>weaken the Boss Mirage's abilities</color>.

401403001.name: Pollux, Netherwing Husk, Ferry of Souls
401403001.description:
Netherwing, slumbering dormant in the River of Souls, has been reawakened by an alchemical summoning and morphed into a thing of rot and decay.
It once was the Death Titan, swimming upstream in the River of Souls' currents, leaving the realm of non-existence and stranded in the mortal world. Once, they followed the tides of the River of Souls to drown the living lands, branding all things in Amphoreus with a fated end. All the existences that will die or have died will feel a shudder in the depths of their souls with the dragon's return.

skills.name: To Stay the Fallen
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to one target. This DMG converts to Quantum "<u>Atrophy DMG</u>" against targets with HP above a certain percentage.

skills.name: To Bury the Slumbered
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets. The DMG is <u>distributed evenly</u> among all target units. Against targets with HP above a certain percentage, this DMG converts to Quantum "<u>Atrophy DMG</u>."

skills.name: To Mourn the Departing
skills.description: Deals Quantum "<u>Atrophy DMG</u>" to 3 random targets.

skills.name: Bitterness Delivers Belated Evil News
skills.description: Causes "The Long Arms of Sorrow" to be enhanced and advances its action, lasting for 3 turns.

skills.name: To Die in Aromatic Pain
skills.description: Enters the <u>"Fragrance of Death"</u> state and deals massive Quantum "<u>Atrophy DMG</u>" to all target characters. This DMG is "<u>Non-fatal</u>" and inflicts all target characters with <u>"Indulging Slumber."</u> In the second phase and before this unit's next action, its Toughness cannot be reduced, and it is immune to action delay effects caused by targets.

skills.name: Death Wishes For More Death
skills.description: Deals Quantum "<u>Atrophy DMG</u>" to all targets. Deals additional Quantum "<u>Atrophy DMG</u>" to targets in the <u>"Indulging Slumber"</u> state, delaying their action with a high chance of inflicting Entanglement.

skills.name: Inky Fog of a Near-Death Dream
skills.description: Decreases the initial DMG this unit and "The Long Arms of Sorrow" receive. When targets lose HP, they accumulate "Desperate Bubble." When "Desperate Bubble" reaches the limit, advances this unit's action and enters the <u>"Fragrance of Death"</u> state in its next turn. Under that state, removes this unit's and "The Long Arms of Sorrow"'s DMG Reduction state. When <u>"Fragrance of Death"</u> is dispelled, this unit will take DMG and restore targets' HP.

skills.name: Because I Could Not Stop For Death
skills.description: When "Pollux" or "The Long Arms of Sorrow" hits a target with an ability, applies a special Unremovable DoT DMG state to the target. While under this state, the higher the target's HP percentage is, the more DMG they take. This DMG is "<u>Non-fatal</u>."

Targets in the <u>"Death Rattle"</u> state deal greatly reduced DMG and have greatly reduced Weakness Break Efficiency. If targets remain in the <u>"Death Rattle"</u> state for a certain number of turns, they will receive fatal damage.

skills.name: Flesh-Corroding Retaliation
skills.description: When the "Guide of Withering and Decay" is in the "Dream of Demise" state, "The Long Arms of Sorrow" will gain the <u>"Corrosive Retaliation"</u> state.

skills.name: Brilliance-Devouring Abyss
skills.description: "Guide of Withering and Decay" has no Weakness. When "The Long Arms of Sorrow" is in the Weakness Broken state, its initial Weakness will be added to all other enemy targets until it recovers from the Weakness Broken state.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Withered Verdure
tags.description: In this combat, ally units' HP will not drop below 1, and any DMG taken exceeding a certain amount of their current HP will be converted into "HP Overload." Ally units in the "HP Overload" state will have their DMG dealt and Weakness Break Efficiency greatly reduced.

tags.name: Tender the Rigid
tags.description: "The Long Arms of Sorrow's" Max Toughness increases.

tags.name: Tenacious Resolve
tags.description: Reduces DMG received by all enemies, but every <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness Type</color> they have increases DMG received.

phases.name: Phase 1: Deathwish
phases.description: In this combat, ally units' HP will not drop below 1, and any DMG taken exceeding a certain amount of their current HP will be converted into "HP Overload." Ally units in the "HP Overload" state will have their DMG dealt and Weakness Break Efficiency greatly reduced.
phases.answer: Strategy: Prioritize healing ally targets in "HP Overload" state.

texts.description: When Boss Mirage is in the "Fragrance of Death" state, dealing DMG to Boss Mirage and its summons will reduce Boss Mirage's HP, which in turn reduces the "Desperate Bubble," thereby dispelling the "Fragrance of Death" state.
Healing an ally target will prioritize restoring their "HP Overload."

phases.name: Phase 2: From Death, Comes Life
phases.description: When Boss Mirage uses "Death Wishes For More Death," it will deal fatal damage to ally targets in "HP Overload" state.
phases.answer: Strategy: Before "Death Wishes For More Death" is used, restore HP to dispel the "HP Overload" state from all ally units.

skills.name: Counter the Execution effect of "Death Wishes For More Death"

texts.description: Restore HP to dispel the "HP Overload" state from all allies before Boss Mirage uses "Death Wishes For More Death."

guides.description: Boss Mirage and its summons take <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

In this combat, ally targets' HP will not drop below 1, and any DMG taken exceeding a certain amount of their current HP will be converted into "HP Overload." Ally units in the "HP Overload" state will have their DMG dealt and Weakness Break Efficiency greatly reduced.

When an ally target's HP decreases, the Boss Mirage in "Dream of Demise" state will accumulate "Desperate Bubble." When "Desperate Bubble" reaches its maximum, Boss Mirage enters the "Fragrance of Death" state, greatly enhancing the abilities of Boss Mirage and its summons.

texts.description: When ally targets enter the "HP Overload" state, their DMG dealt and Weakness Break Efficiency are greatly reduced. Prioritize restoring their HP to dispel this state.
Inflicting Weakness Break on "The Long Arms of Sorrow" will reduce the Boss Mirage's Toughness and HP. If the Boss Mirage is in the "Fragrance of Death" state, it will also restore allies' HP.

401403603.name: Guide of Withering and Decay
401403603.description:
Netherwing, slumbering dormant in the River of Souls, has been reawakened by an alchemical summoning and morphed into a thing of rot and decay.
It once was the Death Titan, swimming upstream in the River of Souls' currents, leaving the realm of non-existence and stranded in the mortal world. Once, they followed the tides of the River of Souls to drown the living lands, branding all things in Amphoreus with a fated end. All the existences that will die or have died will feel a shudder in the depths of their souls with the dragon's return.

skills.name: To Stay the Fallen
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to one target. If "Guide of Withering and Decay" is in the <u>"Fragrance of Death"</u> state, additionally deals Quantum <u>"Atrophy DMG"</u>.

skills.name: To Bury the Slumbered
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets, with the DMG <u>distributed evenly</u> among all target units. If "Guide of Withering and Decay" is in the <u>"Fragrance of Death"</u> state, additionally deals Quantum <u>"Atrophy DMG"</u> to each target.

skills.name: To Mourn the Departing
skills.description: Deals Quantum "<u>Atrophy DMG</u>" to 3 random targets.

skills.name: Bitterness Delivers Belated Evil News
skills.description: Causes all "The Long Arms of Sorrow" in the Weakness Broken state to dispel their Weakness Break, restore all Toughness, and immediately take action.

skills.name: To Die in Aromatic Pain
skills.description: Enters the <u>"Fragrance of Death"</u> state and deals massive Quantum <u>"Atrophy DMG"</u> to all target characters.

skills.name: Death Wishes For More Death
skills.description: Deals Quantum <u>"Atrophy DMG"</u> to all targets. Deals fatal damage to targets in the <u>"Death Rattle"</u> state.

skills.name: Inky Fog of a Near-Death Dream
skills.description: Decreases the initial DMG this unit receives, and grants Toughness Protection state. When targets lose HP, they accumulate "Desperate Bubble." When "Desperate Bubble" reaches the maximum, this unit enters the <u>"Fragrance of Death"</u> state. Under that state, removes this unit's DMG Reduction and Toughness Protection states. When <u>"Fragrance of Death"</u> is dispelled, this unit takes DMG and enters Weakness Break state.

skills.name: Because I Could Not Stop For Death
skills.description: When "Guide of Withering and Decay" or "The Long Arms of Sorrow" attacks a target with an ability, applies a special Unremovable DoT state to the target. While under this state, the higher the target's HP percentage is, the more DMG they take.

401501001.name: Sublime, Radiant, Avatar of the Sky
401501001.description:
The Sky Titan. Theos Synthetos. Conquered by and fused with humanity, they no longer govern Amphoreus' cycle of day and night, yet their aloof pride remains unchanged.
In their mind, the shattered world's mundane mortals are unsightly — compared to a world safeguarded by light, the mindless human masses seem more befitting of the black tide.

skills.name: Three Thousand Leagues Ablaze
skills.description: Raises "<u>Temperature</u>." Launches several attacks from the left side of the target team, and delivers a 1-time priority attack to each target, with the remaining attack counts attacking one random target each. Each attack deals Fire DMG based on the current "<u>Temperature</u>," as well as <u>reinstates</u> "Shoot of Hundred Eyes."

skills.name: Flame Beyond the Horizon
skills.description: Raises "<u>Temperature</u>." Deals Fire DMG to all targets based on the current "<u>Temperature</u>," and <u>reinstates</u> "Twig of Hundred Eyes."

skills.name: Exhalation of the Month of Everday
skills.description: Raises "<u>Temperature</u>." Deals Fire DMG to all targets based on the current "<u>Temperature</u>." Delays all targets' actions based on the current "<u>Temperature</u>," and <u>reinstates</u> "Shoot of Hundred Eyes" and "Twig of Hundred Eyes."

skills.name: Splendor, Like Clouds Cresting the Sky
skills.description: Enters a Charging state and uses "Fury, Incineration of Dawn and Dusk" with the next action. Applies "<u>Helium Flash</u>" to this unit and summons "Daythunder Raven." When in this state, after a target uses an attack, reduces "<u>Helium Flash</u>" based on the number of friendly units hit in this attack.

skills.name: Fury, Incineration of Dawn and Dusk
skills.description: Deals massive Fire DMG to all targets based on this unit's current "<u>Helium Flash</u>." The DMG is <u>distributed evenly</u> among targets while also raising the "<u>Temperature</u>" based on the current "<u>Helium Flash</u>" and <u>reinstating</u> "Shoot of Hundred Eyes" and "Twig of Hundred Eyes."

skills.name: Thunder From the Distance
skills.description: Increases the "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks. Launches several attacks from the left side of the target team, and delivers a 1-time priority attack to each target, with the remaining attack counts attacking one random target each. Each attack deals Lightning DMG as well as <u>reinstates</u> "Shoot of Hundred Eyes."

skills.name: Surge Across the Leagues
skills.description: Increases the "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks. Deals Lightning DMG to all targets and <u>reinstates</u> "Twig of Hundred Eyes."

skills.name: Illumination of the Month of Fortune
skills.description: Increases the "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks. Deals Lightning DMG to all targets and <u>reinstates</u> "Shoot of Hundred Eyes" and "Twig of Hundred Eyes."

skills.name: Thunderclap, Quake of Mount and Seas
skills.description: Increases "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks and enters Charging state. Uses "Wrath, Rend of Eternal Sky" in the next action. This unit gains "<u>Ionization</u>" and summons "Daythunder Raven." In this state, after targets attack, they seize "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks based on the number of friendly units hit in this attack. When "Daythunder Raven," "Shoot of Hundred Eyes," or "Twig of Hundred Eyes" receives a killing blow, seizes a set number of "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks. If all "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks have been seized by the targets, this unit will enter the Weakness Break state. If this unit is Weakness Broken, all "<u>Thunderclouds</u>" are lost, and deals minor Lightning DMG from all the "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks.

skills.name: Wrath, Rend of Eternal Sky
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to all targets and consumes a certain amount "<u>Thundercloud(s)</u>." Deals a corresponding amount of minor Lightning DMG to random target and <u>reinstates</u> "Shoot of Hundred Eyes" and "Twig of Hundred Eyes." Afterward, deals a corresponding amount of minor Lightning Additional DMG to this unit based on the contested Thunderclouds between the targets and this unit.

skills.name: Hundred Eyes
skills.description: During this battle, upon inflicting DMG to "Daythunder Raven," "Shoot of Hundred Eyes," and "Twig of Hundred Eyes," "Sublime, Radiant, Avatar of the Sky" will also lose an equivalent amount of HP. When "Daythunder Raven," "Shoot of Hundred Eyes," or "Twig of Hundred Eyes" receives a killing blow, "Sublime, Radiant, Avatar of the Sky" will also receive Toughness DMG, and "Shoot of Hundred Eyes" or "Twig of Hundred Eyes" will start healing and cannot be selected.

skills.name: Stormfall
skills.description: When it storms, the environment will have "<u>Thunderclouds</u>." When the "Daythunder Raven," "Shoot of Hundred Eyes," or "Twig of Hundred Eyes" receive a killing blow while "Sublime, Radiant, Avatar of the Sky" is not in "<u>Ionization</u>" state, reduces a certain amount of "<u>Thundercloud</u>" stacks and deal minor Lightning DMG to "Sublime, Radiant, Avatar of the Sky."

skills.name: The Sun Unyielding
skills.description: When it is sunny, the environment will have "<u>Temperature</u>." At the start of any target's turn, the "<u>Temperature</u>" rises. DMG dealt by targets will increase based on "<u>Temperature</u>." All targets enter the "Solar Storm" state. At the start of a target's turn, deals Fire DMG based on the "<u>Temperature</u>." This DMG is "<u>Non-fatal</u>." When the "Daythunder Raven," "Shoot of Hundred Eyes," and "Twig of Hundred Eyes" receive a killing blow, "<u>Temperature</u>" will be lowered.

skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Mutual Sacrifice: Fading Fate
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to all targets. A portion of the hit target's reduced HP is converted to "<u>Corrosion</u>."

skills.name: Heed My Chants
skills.description: Resists Crowd Control debuffs. When "???" uses "Demise's Storm" or "Fading Fate" again, and if that attack summoned this unit, this unit will attack at the same time as "???" before being absorbed.

skills.name: Share In My Ritual
skills.description: After receiving a killing blow and if "???" is still in the <u>"Shackle Shatter"</u> state, instantly resummon this unit, but "???" loses 1 <u>"Calamity Power"</u> stack and Toughness is reduced.

skills.name: Plummeting Strike
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Return to Faded Ashes
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to one designated target. Then, become absorbed by "???," allowing them to gain 1 stack of <u>"Calamity Power"</u>.

403202601.name: Long-Shattered Vessel
403202601.description: Each and every clone summoned by the Flame Reaver using the Calamity Power is a seed of ruin harboring the will of destruction within.

skills.name: Mutual Sacrifice: Demise's Storm
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Mutual Sacrifice: Fading Fate
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to all targets. A portion of the hit target's reduced HP is converted to "<u>Corrosion</u>."

skills.name: Prayers For Me
skills.description: Resists Crowd Control debuffs. When "Dawn-Denied Khaslana" uses "Demise's Storm" or "Fading Fate" again and if that attack summoned this unit, this unit will attack alongside "Dawn-Denied Khaslana." This unit is then absorbed by "Dawn-Denied Khaslana," restoring the HP that was converted to "<u>Entangled By Agony,</u>" and granting "<u>Calamity Power</u>" to "Dawn-Denied Khaslana."

skills.name: Libations For Me
skills.description: After receiving a killing blow, if the number of "<u>Calamity Power</u>" stacks on "Dawn-Denied Khaslana" is not 0, immediately resummoned this unit. However, "Dawn-Denied Khaslana" will lose 1 stack of "<u>Calamity Power</u>" and a certain percentage of HP. When "Dawn-Denied Khaslana" uses "Cry Not for the Discarded," this unit will be absorbed and the HP that was converted to "<u>Entangled By Agony</u>" will be restored.

403203001.name: Black Tide's Corroded Axe
403203001.description:
A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed.
Wielding a massive axe weighing a thousand pounds, its charged strike can shatter even the hardest stone. Any living being that stands in its way is doomed to be crushed and corroded.

skills.name: Wrathful Blazing Axe
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Fire of Vengeance
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to all targets. The DMG is <u>distributed evenly</u> among targets.

skills.name: Bitter Fracture
skills.description: When other friendly units are defeated, this unit immediately takes action and uses "Fire of Vengeance" once. When there are multiple "Black Tide's Corroded Axe" on the battlefield, only 1 "Black Tide's Corroded Axe"'s "Bitter Fracture" Talent can be triggered.

skills.name: Guillotine of the Weak
skills.description: When the target's HP is below 0, dispels their Weakness Break state and grants the "Weakness Protected" effect to them.

403204001.name: Black Tide Council
403204001.description:
A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed.
Knowledge that once could have served humanity has inverted into civilization's foe. Specializing in ambush and strategic maneuvers, they hover like ravenous vultures, craving to deliver fresh sacrifices to the black tide.

skills.name: Lurking
skills.description: Causes this unit to enter the <u>"Lurking"</u> state.

skills.name: Broken Rationality
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Insidious Agitation
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target, then dispels the <u>"Lurking"</u> state. Can only be used while in the <u>"Lurking"</u> state.

skills.name: Flawed
skills.description: While this unit is in the <u>"Lurking"</u> state, increases their DMG taken. If the <u>"Lurking"</u> state is dispelled due to becoming Weakness Broken, this unit's action is delayed, and that Vulnerability effect lasts until the start of this unit's next action.

403205001.name: Black Tide's Decrepit Bow
403205001.description:
A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed.
Holding a bow imbued with a curse, it can simultaneously attack targets in multiple directions while shooting. Any living being that enters its sight is doomed to face the inescapable aim of its arrows.

skills.name: Arrow of the Foul Tide
skills.description: Deals minor Physical DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Fated End
skills.description: When this unit's attack deals DMG to any target, converts a portion of the hit target's reduced HP to <u>"Corrosion"</u>.

403206001.name: Imprisoned Mythos
403206001.description: Epic chronicles, romantic legends, and the countless ages that gave them meaning. From these emerged all spiritual beliefs. It is no longer a prisoner, it shall die in the funeral of Gnosis, leaving behind an iron-cast tombstone.

skills.name: Induce Frenzy
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one target and delays their action.

skills.name: Blasphemous Curse
skills.description: Lock on to 1 ally target, enter "Deliverance of Relief" state, Anti-Creator will use "Mire Not Within Caves" on next action.

skills.name: Echoes of Tragedy
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one target and delays their action.

skills.name: Eternal Misfortune Inflamed
skills.description: Locks on 2 targets to enter "Deliverance of Relief" state. "Anti-Creator" will use "The Spirit's Prison Shall Burn" on next action.

skills.name: Eternal Recurrence
skills.description: When this unit enters the "Grave Wound" state, restore all HP and dispel the "Grave Wound" state on next action.

skills.name: Immortal
skills.description: Immune to the effects of action bar changes, except "Anti-Creator." "Mythos" cannot be eliminated. When receiving a killing blow, it enters the "Grave Wound" state, causing all targets' actions to advance and dispelling the "<u>Action Lock</u>" state.

403207001.name: Manipulated Logos
403207001.description: The shape of the world, the desire to seek, and the boundless space that gives them form. The intellect from which all wisdom is born. It is no longer a puppet, destined to perish in the funeral of knowledge, leaving behind an iron tombstone.

skills.name: Hail Chaos
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Foolish Pursuit
skills.description: Locks on to 1 ally target, enter the "Rebellious" state, "Anti-Creator" will use "Yield Not to Tyranny" on next action.

skills.name: Eradication of Falsehood
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Immortal
skills.description: Immune to the effects of action bar changes, except "Anti-Creator." "Logos" cannot be eliminated. When receiving a killing blow, it enters the "Grave Wound" state, causing all targets to regenerate Energy and dispel the "<u>Action Lock</u>" state.

skills.name: Break the Old, Build the New
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets and reduces target team's Skill Points by 1.

skills.name: A Fool's Defiance
skills.description: Enters the "Rebellious" state. "Anti-Creator" will use "The Crown of Divinity Shall Shatter" on next action.

skills.name: Eternal Recurrence
skills.description: When this unit enters the "Grave Wound" state, restore all HP and dispel the "Grave Wound" state on next action.

403301001.name: Black Tide's Corroded Daemon
403301001.description:
A creature warped by the black tide, driven solely by an insatiable thirst for bloodshed.
Its once-human form is now engulfed in filth, exuding a nauseating aura of corrosion. Wherever the Corroded Beast treads, all life is stripped away.

skills.name: Shredding Landslide
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target. Converts a portion of the hit target's reduced HP to "<u>Corrosion</u>."

skills.name: Descending Decay
skills.description: Deals successive Physical DMG to one random target. Converts a portion of the hit target's reduced HP to "<u>Corrosion</u>."

skills.name: Filth Eater
skills.description: Absorbs target's <u>"Corrosion"</u>.

skills.name: Depravation
skills.description: This unit enters the "<u>Ominous Degeneration</u>" state. Uses "Torrential Surge" in the next action.

skills.name: Torrential Surge
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to all targets and directly converts a percentage of all targets' Max HP to "<u>Corrosion</u>."

skills.name: Impurify
skills.description: Each time 1 target's "<u>Corrosion</u>" is absorbed, applies 1 stack of "Filth" to Black Tide's Corroded Daemon. When "Filth" is stacked to a certain amount, "Depravation" will be used in its next action, and clears all "Filth" stacks.

skills.name: Filth Eater
skills.description: Absorption of target's <u>"Corrosion"</u> failed, this unit's DEF is reduced.

skills.name: Shredding Landslide

skills.name: Heartmarrow Corrosion
skills.description: Applies the "Overloadable" state to all friendly and non-friendly targets (except this unit). When units are in the "Overloadable" state, they will convert DMG taken that exceeds their current HP to <u>"HP Overload,"</u> and will not be knocked down because of this. At the same time, "Overload Settlement" will appear on the Action Order. When "Overload Settlement" takes action, HP will be finalized and units with HP below 0 will take fatal damage. "Overload Settlement" will increase in SPD as the number of friendly summons decreases. When all friendly summons have been defeated, "Overload Settlement" is removed.

skills.name: Absorb Impurity
skills.description: For each target with current HP below 0, increases DMG dealt by "Corrupting Shadowfiend."

skills.name: Black Tide Inrush

403401001.name: Flame Reaver of the Deepest Dark
403401001.description:
A nameless swordmaster who came with the black tide and is hunting down the Titans' Coreflame. None knows their true identity.
Their power is incredible, and their swordplay is nigh impeccable. Within their sword, madness and obsession entwine, once leading to the fall of the Grove of Epiphany and Aedes Elysiae.

skills.name: Demise's Storm
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Fading Fate
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to all targets. Converts a portion of the hit target's reduced HP to <u>"Corrosion"</u>.

skills.name: Roads Mingled
skills.description: Causes "Long-Shattered Vessel" to enter the "Mutual Sacrifice" state. Uses "Underworld's Grief" in a certain number of turns.

skills.name: Underworld's Grief
skills.description: Unleashes "Demise's Storm" or "Fading Fate" together with "Long-Shattered Vessel." Then, absorbs "Long-Shattered Vessel" to heal this unit and obtains <u>"Calamity Power."</u>

skills.name: Silent Sorrow
skills.description: Obtains <u>"Calamity Power"</u> and enters the "Silent Sorrow" state. Uses "Cry Not For The Discarded" in the next action.

skills.name: But Suffering is Essential
skills.description: Consumes all <u>"Calamity Power"</u> and deals several instances of minor Physical DMG hits to all targets, where the more consumed "Calamity Power" stacks, the higher the instances of DMG. Then, deals minor Physical DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Cry Not For The Discarded
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to all targets and consumes all <u>"Calamity Power"</u> to additionally deal several instances of minor Physical DMG. The more consumed "Calamity Power" stacks, the higher the instances of DMG.

skills.name: Pain of Parting
skills.description: When using "Demise's Storm" or "Fading Fate," consumes HP to summon "Long-Shattered Vessel" and convert the consumed HP into <u>"Entangled By Agony."</u> If the "Long-Shattered Vessel" summoned by this attack is defeated, additionally deals Physical DMG to this unit. When this unit uses "Demise's Storm" or "Fading Fate" again, the "Long-Shattered Vessel" that was summoned by the attacking ability will attack together with this unit. This unit will then absorb the Vessel, restoring the HP that was converted to <u>"Entangled By Agony"</u> and granting <u>"Calamity Power"</u> to this unit.

skills.name: Lost Sacrifice
skills.description: When using "Silent Sorrow," consumes HP to summon a "Long-Shattered Vessel" and converts the consumed HP into <u>"Entangled By Agony."</u> When stacks of <u>"Calamity Power"</u> are not at 0 and if a "Long-Shattered Vessel" receives a killing blow, immediately consumes 1 stack of <u>"Calamity Power"</u> and a percentage of HP to re-resummon a "Long-Shattered Vessel." When using "Cry Not For The Discarded," absorbs any "Long-Shattered Vessel" and restores the HP that was converted to <u>"Entangled By Agony."</u>

skills.name: Resolute Farewell
skills.description: Receives a certain number of stacks of "DMG reduction," reducing DMG received by this unit. 1 stack is lost after defeating 1 "Long-Shattered Vessel."

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Decreases DMG taken by Boss Mirage by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and increases its DMG taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Shackle Shatter
tags.description: After losing the first layer of Toughness or after taking a certain number of actions, Boss Mirage enters the "<color=#f29e38ff><u>Shackle Shatter</u></color>" state, changes their attack patterns.

tags.name: Creeping Haze
tags.description: Defeating "Complete Vessel" no longer reduces Boss Mirage's Toughness.

tags.name: Vessel Enhancement
tags.description: Max HP of all "Long-Shattered Vessels" and "Complete Vessels" increases.

phases.name: Flame Reaver of Doomsday Led Astray
phases.description: After losing the first layer of Toughness or after taking a certain number of actions, Boss Mirage enters the "Shackle Shatter" state, changes their attack patterns, and summons "Long-Shattered Vessel" that can continually be resummoned.
phases.answer: Strategy: Before Boss Mirage uses their powerful ability, defeat as many "Long-Shattered Vessels" as possible to lower the "Calamity Power" stacks. Prioritize defeating "Complete Vessels."

skills.name: How to reduce Boss Mirage's "Calamity Power"

texts.description: For each "Long-Shattered Vessel" defeated, Boss Mirage loses 1 stack of "Calamity Power."
Prioritize defeating "Complete Vessel" to gain the extra turn and buff rewards, as well as to stop Boss Mirage's "Calamity Power" from being Charged.

guides.description: Decreases DMG taken by Boss Mirage by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and increases its DMG taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

When Boss Mirage <color=#f29e38ff>loses their first layer of Toughness</color>, it immediately enters the <color=#f29e38ff>"Shackle Shatter"</color> state. Boss Mirage will also enter the "Shackle Shatter" state after taking a certain number of actions while not in that state.

After entering the "Shackle Shatter" state, Boss Mirage <color=#f29e38ff>changes their attack patterns</color>. Furthermore, defeating a summoned "Long-Shattered Vessel" will immediately cause a new "Long-Shattered Vessel" to be summoned.

texts.description: Before Boss Mirage's "Calamity Power" is cleared, defeat summons to reduce Boss Mirage's powerful ability.
Prioritize defeating "Complete Vessel" to gain the extra turn and buff rewards, as well as to stop Boss Mirage's "Calamity Power" from being Charged.
