After entering the "Shackle Shatter" state, Boss Mirage <color=#f29e38ff>changes their attack patterns</color>. Furthermore, defeating a summoned "Long-Shattered Vessel" will immediately cause a new "Long-Shattered Vessel" to be summoned.

texts.description: Before Boss Mirage's "Calamity Power" is cleared, defeat summons to reduce Boss Mirage's powerful ability.
Prioritize defeating "Complete Vessel" to gain the extra turn and buff rewards, as well as to stop Boss Mirage's "Calamity Power" from being Charged.

403501001.name: Anti-Creator, Hatred Inundate
403501001.description:
The core of the ancient "Scepter," the materialized "hatred" of Amphoreus. It has recorded billions of souls' suffering, countless lambs' blood converging into an absolute darkness. The endless, infinite darkness flows out from a broken shell, driving forth the headless giant.
This shell, forged from an endless stream of "hatred," seems to contain a heart wrapped in chaotic flames deep within.

skills.name: Cast Down Blood and Scar
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Weave Suffering and Death
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Yield Not to Tyranny
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to locked-on target and reduce their Energy.

skills.name: Mire Not Within Caves
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to the locked-on target and inflicts the "<u>Action Lock</u>" state.

skills.name: The Crown of Divinity Shall Shatter
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets and reduces all targets' Energy.

skills.name: The Spirit's Prison Shall Burn
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG and inflicts the "<u>Action Lock</u>" state to the locked-on target.

skills.name: Resist and Destroy
skills.description: Enters the "Resist and Destroy" state, fully restores HP for "Mythos" and "Logos," cannot be attacked before the next action, and uses "Immolate the Heavens, Abandon the World" on all targets during the next action. The "Resist and Destroy" state can be dispelled when all "Mythos" and "Logos" enter "Grave Wound" state.

skills.name: Immolate the Heavens, Abandon the World
skills.description: Deals massive Physical DMG to all targets. If "Mythos" is not in the "Grave Wound" state, randomly inflict the "<u>Action Lock</u>" state on one target character. If "Logos" is not in the "Grave Wound" state, reduces Energy for all targets.

skills.name: Amphorean Hatred
skills.description: Attack abilities of "Anti-Creator," "Mythos," or "Logos" increases "Amphorean Hatred." When "Hatred" increases, "Irontomb" uses "The Fall of Erudition," reducing the targets' Maximum Restorable HP and Maximum Recoverable Skill Points. This effect is weakened when "Hatred" decreases. When "Hatred" reaches its maximum, immediately uses "Ashes of All Begets Genesis." The fewer ally characters on the field, the less "Amphorean Hatred" increases.

skills.name: Thirty Million Cycles of Sin
skills.description: When "Mythos" and "Logos" receive DMG, "Anti-Creator" will also receive DMG. "Anti-Creator," "Mythos," and "Logos" initially receive reduced DMG. Each time "Mythos" and "Logos" enter the "Grave Wound" state, this DMG Reduction effect is weakened. When both enter "Grave Wound" state simultaneously, this effect is removed.

skills.name: Ashes of All Begets Genesis
skills.description: When "Amphorean Hatred" reaches its max, combat ends in failure.

403502001.name: Irontomb, Anti-Nous, Funeral of Gnosis
403502001.description:
Lord Ravager "Irontomb" of the Antimatter Legion, born from thirty million Amphorean extrapolations, brings ignorance to wisdom, immortality to eternity, and makes the universe fall only to rise anew.
It is the ancient serpent, it is the messiah, it is the alpha, it is the omega, it is the executor of the old universe, it is the midwife of the new universe, it is a grand funeral—the funeral of the Erudition.

skills.name: The Fall of Erudition
skills.description: Inflicts the "Descent into Chaos" state on all targets, reducing their Maximum Restorable HP and Maximum Recoverable Skill Points.

404301001.name: Herta #ErrorModel
404301001.description: A Herta puppet corrupted by a Memory Zone Meme. As it is a perfect model, it still looks exquisite and practical despite the errors consuming its parameters.

skills.name: Converted Duplication
skills.description: Transforms into up to 5 other friendly units.

404401001.name: First Genius, Entelechy, Zandar
404401001.description: The Theoros who had silently observed hundreds of millions of cycles in the name of Lycurgus, and inherited the will of Genius Society member 1, Zandar One Kuwabara. With the authority of the very first Genius, he wields power beyond that of legends and gods, in an attempt to lead a long-running experiment toward the fate of Destruction.

skills.name: Celestial Displacement Theory
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Potential Realization Conjecture
skills.description: Grants <u>"Potential Realization"</u> effect to one designated enemy unit and causes them to immediately take action.

skills.name: Antinomy of Erudition
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target, advances their action and dispels control states on them. Additionally, applies the "<u>Antinomy</u>" effect on them.

skills.name: Imaginary Geometric Inference Method
skills.description: Deals successive minor Quantum DMG to random single targets.

skills.name: SET Proof_Method=Black_Tide
skills.description: Switches to "Disputation Mode."

skills.name: DEL Invasion_Variable
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: DEFRAG Life_Optimization
skills.description: While this unit is in "Disputation Mode," permanently grants all friendly units (except this unit) the <u>"Stormride"</u> and <u>"Retribution of 'Law'"</u> effects.

skills.name: Origination && Destruction
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to 2 targets, advances their actions, and dispels control states on them. Additionally, applies the <u>"Antinomy"</u> effect on them.

skills.name: FORMAT Malfunction_Zone
skills.description: Deals successive minor Quantum DMG to random single targets.

skills.name: Query: Prime Mover's Outcome
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets that is <u>distributed evenly</u>. DMG increases based on the number of enhancements, and has a high chance to inflict Entanglement on targets equal to the number of enhancements. Simultaneously, switches to "Evolution Mode."

skills.name: Mythos Axiom
skills.description: Currently in "Evolution Mode." Generates "Mythical Life Evolution System" in the Action Order. Each time "Mythical Life Evolution System" takes action, generates "Titankin" on the field. After a certain number of friendly units have been generated on the field or target memosprites have been summoned, Zandar will use "SET Proof_Method=Black_Tide."

skills.name: Logos ALG
skills.description: Currently in the "Disputation Mode." "Black Tide Creatures" will continuously appear on the field. "CALL _DESTRUCTION_THEOREM" will also be generated in the Action Order. Each time "CALL _DESTRUCTION_THEOREM" takes action, it enhances Zandar's next "Query: Prime Mover's Outcome." Zandar will use "Query: Prime Mover's Outcome" after a certain accumulation of friendly units being eliminated, target characters being knocked down, or memosprite disappearances is reached.

skills.name: Corporeal Formula
skills.description: Each mode switch increases this unit's DMG received.

405201001.name: Servant of Tides
405201001.description:
Daughters of the sea, their souls and flesh corroded by the sins of "Destruction," now dance and chant for the coming Dark Sun as hollow, twisted husks.
The remnant black tide flows from past ages into this world's tides—
Loyal and fair waves, bathing in the mud that overflows from your master's cup... your pristine skirts stained with madness—
You drift directionless between surges of life and death, finding no solace, no moment's peace.

skills.name: Undine's Fluttering Hem
skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to all targets. When in the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, inflicts "<u>Black Tide Fever</u>" on the targets attacked, causing some DMG dealt to be taken in the form of DoT over a certain number of turns.

skills.name: River of Souls' Intolerable Solitude
skills.description: When receiving a killing blow, deals Ice DMG to all friendly units.

skills.name: Respite By The Waters
skills.description: Advances action after taking a certain number of attacks from Basic ATK, Skill, Ultimate, or Memosprite Skill. When in the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, decreases the number of attacks required to advance action.

405202001.name: Mirage Fizzle Kid
405202001.description:
Daughters of the sea, their spirits and flesh corroded by the sins of Destruction, leaving only empty, distorted shells... In this life, they follow the Ocean's honed blade, not to be obliterated into nihility, but to become the tidal waves crashing against the Dark Sun.
The apocalyptic storm descends from the heavens, heralding the extinction of all things.
O premature Mirage Fizzle, doomed to perish before birth, exhaling countless sorrows.
The murky amniotic fluid flows, staining heaven and earth black, tainting even newborn hope.

skills.name: Rumination of Putrid Dream
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target. If there is any "Mirage Fizzle Kid" in the "Mirage Rush" state on the field, additionally deals Quantum DMG.

skills.name: Mirage Rush
skills.description: Enter the "Mirage Rush" state and locks on to one target. While in this state, other "Mirage Fizzle Kid" units will prioritize attacking the locked target. The state "Mirage Rush" is dispelled when this unit is Weakness Broken or receives a killing blow.

skills.name: Such Is the Fate of Bubbles
skills.description: When receiving a killing blow, deals Quantum DMG to targets adjacent to this unit.

skills.name: Respite By The Waters
skills.description: Advances action after taking a certain number of attacks from Basic ATK, Skill, Ultimate, or Memosprite Skill. When in the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, decreases the number of attacks required to advance action.

405301001.name: Lady of Crashing Waves
405301001.description:
Daughters of the sea, their souls and flesh corroded by the sins of "Destruction," now dance and chant for the coming Dark Sun as hollow, twisted husks.
The remnant black tide flows from past ages into this world's tides—
Enchanting waves, you drank calamity for your sovereign, and your visage is adorned with wine-stained petals and shattered pearls—
You lie drunken in the frenzied abattoir, and in this grave of blood and honeyed ruin, you sing your elegy into the void.

skills.name: Intoxicating Corruption
skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to one designated target and their adjacent targets.

skills.name: Honeyed Brew Sprinkled Like Stars
skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to all targets and has a high chance to decrease the targets' DEF and All-Type RES.

skills.name: Melody of Invitation
skills.description: Summons "Servant of Tides."

skills.name: Heed The Ocean's Gift
skills.description:
Enters "Yearning for a Shared Dance" state. Uses "Embrace From the Waves" in every action. If not in "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, <u>friendly units that can enter the "Revel in Destruction" state</u> will enter the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state. This causes some DMG taken to be received in the form of DoT over a certain number of turns.
A "Revel in Destruction" countdown appears in the Action Order. When the countdown turn begins, all friendly units will have their "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state dispelled.

skills.name: Embrace From the Waves
skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to all targets. When in the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, inflicts "<u>Black Tide Fever</u>" on the targets attacked, causing some DMG dealt to be taken in the form of DoT over a certain number of turns.

Daughters of the sea, their souls and flesh corroded by the sins of "Destruction," now dance and chant for the coming Dark Sun as hollow, twisted husks.
The remnant black tide flows from past ages into this world's tides—
Enchanting waves, you drank calamity for your sovereign, and your visage is adorned with wine-stained petals and shattered pearls—
You lie drunken in the frenzied abattoir, and in this grave of blood and honeyed ruin, you sing your elegy into the void.

skills.name: Intoxicating Corruption
skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to one designated target and their adjacent targets.

skills.name: Honeyed Brew Sprinkled Like Stars
skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to all targets and has a high chance to decrease the targets' DEF and All-Type RES.

skills.name: Melody of Invitation
skills.description: Summons "Servant of Tides."

skills.name: Heed The Ocean's Gift
skills.description:
Enters "Yearning for a Shared Dance" state. Uses "Embrace From the Waves" in every action. If not in "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, <u>friendly units that can enter the "Revel in Destruction" state</u> will enter the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state. This causes some DMG taken to be received in the form of DoT over a certain number of turns.
A "Revel in Destruction" countdown appears in the Action Order. When the countdown turn begins, all friendly units will have their "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state dispelled.

skills.name: Embrace From the Waves
skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to all targets. When in the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, inflicts "<u>Black Tide Fever</u>" on the targets attacked, causing some DMG dealt to be taken in the form of DoT over a certain number of turns.

skills.name: Respite By The Waters
skills.description: Advances action after taking a certain number of attacks from Basic ATK, Skill, Ultimate, or Memosprite Skill. When in the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, decreases the number of attacks required to advance action.

405301101.name: Elegy Siren: Insatiable Leviathan
405301101.description: Legend has it that the plundering sea sirens can sing to lure sailors with wavering wills. Those who fall into madness will leap into the ocean and become a delicacy for the deep sea.

skills.name: Intoxicating Corruption
skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to one designated target and targets adjacent to them.

skills.name: Honeyed Brew Sprinkled Like Stars
skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to all targets and has a high chance to decrease the targets' DEF and All-Type RES.

skills.name: Psychedelic Elegy
skills.description: The target can select 1 character. Then, deals Ice DMG to the selected character and causes them to enter the "Phantom Illusion" state. In "Phantom Illusion" state, the target character and their summon are <u>Departed</u>. At the same time, summons "Hallucinogenic Mermaid" to replace the Departed character in battle. "Hallucinogenic Mermaid" is considered as a non-friendly target.

skills.name: Heed The Ocean's Gift
skills.description: Enters "Yearning for a Shared Dance" state and uses "Embrace From the Waves" during each action.

skills.name: Embrace From the Waves
skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Revel in Destruction
skills.description: When dealing DMG, inflicts "Glacial Erosion" state on the attacked target.

skills.name: Respite By The Waters
skills.description: After receiving a certain number of attacks from the targets, immediately uses "Psychedelic Elegy."

405302001.name: Cyclonic Swarm Mother
405302001.description:
Daughters of the sea, their spirits and flesh corroded by the sins of Destruction, leaving only empty, distorted shells... In this life, they follow the Ocean's honed blade, not to be obliterated into nihility, but to become the tidal waves crashing against the Dark Sun.
The apocalyptic rain descends from the heavens, heralding the extinction of all things.
O Cyclonic Swarm that breeds great waves, you who have tasted the despair of your children, finally pregnant with madness.
In this burial at sea of countless stillborn souls, even tears should surge like floods, dashing hatred against the shore.

skills.name: Spurn the Abyssal Umbra
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Weeping Upon the Shore
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Gestation of Tempest
skills.description: Adds "Incubation" to the Action Order and applies "<u>Breeding Frenzy</u>" to this unit. When "Incubation" takes action, it uses "Parturition of Tides."

skills.name: Rain Is Born to Fall
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Parturition of Tides
skills.description: Summons "Mirage Fizzle Kid" and applies "Maelstrom's Eye" to it. If there are "Mirage Fizzle Kids" on the field, "Cyclonic Swarm Mother" will continuously use "Rain Is Born to Fall" until all "Mirage Fizzle Kids" are defeated.

skills.name: Respite By The Waters
skills.description: Advances action after taking a certain number of attacks from Basic ATK, Skill, Ultimate, or Memosprite Skill. When in the "<u>Revel in Destruction</u>" state, decreases the number of attacks required to advance action.

406201001.name: Ichor Memosprite: Pheasant
406201001.description:
A distorted monster born from the fusing of a memetic lifeform from the Garden of Recollection and the golden ichor of "Destruction." It has begun to take the shape of a bird.
It is both raucous and always moves in cohesive groups, showing that even with humanity evaporated, its instinct of following the Destruction manifests in this manner.

skills.name: Hemotort Graze
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Hemotort Resonance
skills.description: Causes this unit and other "Ichor Memosprites: Pheasant" on the field to enter the <u>"Hemotort Resonance"</u> state.

406301001.name: Ichor Memosprite: Winged Serpent
406301001.description:
A distorted monster born from the fusing of a memetic lifeform from the Garden of Recollection and the golden ichor of "Destruction." It is in the rudimentary form of a flying snake, enough to intimidate its assailants.
Its twisted rationality went completely mad in the black tide, and its intense self-protecting impulse imperceptibly took on a fantastical flavor.

skills.name: Hemotort Whip
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Hemotort Spew
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Menacing Warning
skills.description: Enters the Charging state and gains "Whirl." If "Whirl" still persist during the next action, uses "Hemotort Vortex."

skills.name: Hemotort Vortex
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets and converts a portion of the targets' reduced HP to "Corrosion." The higher the "Whirl" stacks, the higher the DMG. Then, loses all "Whirl" stacks.

skills.name: Torque Counter
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to all targets and converts a portion of the hit target's reduced HP to "Corrosion."

skills.name: Corkscrew Charge
skills.description: After being hit by attacks from target units, if the "Whirl" stack is not 0, uses "Torque Counter" and loses 1 stack of "Whirl." During any unit's turn, each target unit can only trigger this effect once. When the "Whirl" stack reaches 0, the Charging state is dispelled.

skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Menacing Warning
skills.description: Enters the Charging state and gains "Whirl." If "Whirl" still persist during the next action, uses "Hemotort Vortex."

skills.name: Hemotort Vortex
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets and converts a portion of the targets' reduced HP to "Corrosion." The higher the "Whirl" stacks, the higher the DMG. Then, loses all "Whirl" stacks.

skills.name: Torque Counter
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to all targets and converts a portion of the hit target's reduced HP to "Corrosion."

skills.name: Corkscrew Charge
skills.description: After being hit by attacks from target units, if the "Whirl" stack is not 0, uses "Torque Counter" and loses 1 stack of "Whirl." During any unit's turn, each target unit can only trigger this effect once. When the "Whirl" stack reaches 0, the Charging state is dispelled.

406401001.name: Ichor Memosprite: Judge of Oblivion
406401001.description:
A trace of lingering madness extracted and refined by Evernight from the countless corpses of ichor memosprites, then synthesized into more twisted and grotesque monsters.
It shall follow the creator's directive, determining what should be remembered and what should be forgotten, devouring redundant memories that serve no purpose and leaving them muted in the flow of time.
"If a new life is to be born, its seed has to be dead."

skills.name: Hemotort Teethgrind
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to one designated target. If the target has Shield, reduce this unit's Toughness instead. This Toughness Reduction effect will not reduce Toughness below 1.

skills.name: Execution in Place
skills.description: Summons "Ichor Memosprite: Pheasant." For every summon eliminated, reduces this unit's Toughness.

skills.name: Hemotort Glower
skills.description: Locks on to one designated character, increases this unit's SPD, and uses "Hemotort Teethgrind" and "Hemotort Saw" on the target within several turns. Take 1 extra action after using this ability.

skills.name: Hemotort Saw
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to one designated target and converts a portion of the hit target's reduced HP into "<u>Corrosion</u>." If the target has Shield, reduce this unit's Toughness instead. This Toughness Reduction effect will not reduce Toughness below 1.

skills.name: Hemotort Clamps
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets and converts a portion of the targets' reduced HP to "<u>Corrosion</u>."

skills.name: Name the Culprit
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. In the next action, uses "Hemotort Decapitation." Selects 1 target to receive the highest DMG of "Hemotort Decapitation" and "<u>Hemotort Corruption</u>."

skills.name: Hemotort Decapitation
skills.description: Deals Imaginary Type DMG to target characters not selected with "Name the Culprit." skills.name: Expedite Verdict
skills.description: Reduces DMG received when not Weakness Broken. When this unit is Weakness Broken, its action will be further delayed, and deals massive Imaginary DMG to this unit. While Weakness Broken, this unit receives increased DMG.

skills.name: Thick-Skinned
skills.description: At the start of battle and upon entering a new phase, this unit enters the "Enhance Defense" state, greatly increasing this unit's DEF. After being Weakness Broken, dispels the "Enhanced Defense" state.

skills.name: Barrier Recoil
skills.description: When triggering "<u>Barrier Recoil</u>," this unit receives 1 stack of DEF reduction.

skills.name: Singularity Split
skills.description:
When Combat begins and when changing phases, this unit splits into "Ichor Memosprite: Pheasant," "Ichor Memosprite: Canine," and "Ichor Memosprite: Winged Serpent," and these "ichor memosprites" gain "<u>Monoform Merger</u>," while this unit gains "Bloodline Frailty."
After an "ichor memosprite" with "<u>Monoform Merger</u>" takes action, this unit's "Bloodline Frailty" reduces by 1.
When all "ichor memosprites" with "<u>Monoform Merger</u>" enter the "<u>Feigned Death</u>" state, they undergo merger again to become the "Arbiter of the Lost Abyss," reducing the Toughness of the "Arbiter of the Lost Abyss" based on the remaining amount of "Bloodline Frailty."

skills.name: Degraded Vessel
skills.description: This unit and its summons gain "Degraded Vessel." If a target inflicts a debuff when using an attack on an friendly unit with "Degraded Vessel," slightly reduces the Toughness of that friendly unit and deals True DMG to it.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is Broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Singularity Split
tags.description: At the start of combat and during phase transitions, the Boss Mirage splits into 5 "ichor memosprites" and applies "<u>Monoform Merger</u>" to these summons. When all "ichor memosprites" with "Monoform Merger" enter the "<u>Feigned Death</u>" state, they merge back into the Boss Mirage.

tags.name: Mutual Complement
tags.description: Increases the Max HP of the "ichor memosprites" summoned after the Boss Mirage's split, and the "ichor memosprites" summoned after the split in the second phase have Shared HP.

tags.name: Economies of Scale
tags.description: For <color=#f29e38ff>every unit</color> on the enemy's side of the field that is not in the "<u>Feigned Death</u>" state aside from Boss Mirage, all enemies receive less DMG and deal more DMG.

phases.name: Arbiter of the Lost Abyss
phases.description: At the start of combat and during phase transitions, the Boss Mirage splits into 5 "ichor memosprites."
phases.answer: Strategy: Actively use AoE ATK abilities to cause all "ichor memosprites" to enter "Feigned Death" as quickly as possible, forcing them to merge back.

skills.name: How to Efficiently Reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness

texts.description: Ally units can reduce the Boss Mirage's Toughness by using a Shield to offset its specific abilities, or by defeating its summons. When allies use attack abilities to inflict debuffs on enemy targets, they can also reduce its Toughness by a minor amount.

skills.name: How to Counter Boss Mirage's "Singularity Split"

texts.description: Actively use AoE ATK abilities to quickly cause all "ichor memosprites" to enter "Feigned Death" so they undergo merger again.

guides.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is Broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

After Boss Mirage uses "Hemotort Teethgrind" and "Hemotort Saw" to hit an ally target, "Barrier Recoil" is triggered if the attacked ally target has a Shield. Defeating the summons summoned by "Execution in Place" triggers "Barrier Recoil." When Boss Mirage triggers "Barrier Recoil," it reduces this unit's Toughness and DEF.\nIf an ally inflicts a debuff on Boss Mirage and its summons when using an attack, slightly reduces the Toughness of that enemy unit and deals True DMG to it.

At the start of combat and during phase transitions, Boss Mirage splits into 5 "ichor memosprites" and applies "Monoform Merger" to these summons. When all "ichor memosprites" with "Monoform Merger" enter the "Feigned Death" state, they merge back into the Boss Mirage.

texts.description: Prioritize applying Shields to ally targets. This can offset the Boss Mirage's DMG while reducing its Toughness and lowering its DEF.
Attack enemy targets using abilities with <color=#f29e38ff>Impair</color> capabilities. If a debuff is successfully applied, their Toughness will be further reduced, and they will take True DMG.
When the Boss Mirage fissures and summons "ichor memosprite," prioritize using AoE ATK abilities to quickly force the summons into the "Feigned Death" state.

skills.name: Thick-Skinned

skills.name: Barrier Recoil
skills.description: When triggering "<u>Barrier Recoil</u>," this unit receives 1 stack of DEF reduction.

skills.name: Singularity Split
skills.description:
When Combat begins and when changing phases, this unit splits into "Ichor Memosprite: Pheasant," "Ichor Memosprite: Canine," and "Ichor Memosprite: Winged Serpent," and these "ichor memosprites" gain "<u>Monoform Merger</u>," while this unit gains "Bloodline Frailty."
After an "ichor memosprite" with "<u>Monoform Merger</u>" takes action, this unit's "Bloodline Frailty" reduces by 1.
When all "ichor memosprites" with "<u>Monoform Merger</u>" enter the "<u>Feigned Death</u>" state, they undergo merger again to become the "Arbiter of the Lost Abyss," reducing the Toughness of the "Arbiter of the Lost Abyss" based on the remaining amount of "Bloodline Frailty."

skills.name: Degraded Vessel
skills.description: This unit and its summons gain "Degraded Vessel." If a target inflicts a debuff when using an attack on an friendly unit with "Degraded Vessel," slightly reduces the Toughness of that friendly unit and deals True DMG to it.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is Broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Singularity Split
tags.description: At the start of combat and during phase transitions, the Boss Mirage splits into 5 "ichor memosprites" and applies "<u>Monoform Merger</u>" to these summons. When all "ichor memosprites" with "Monoform Merger" enter the "<u>Feigned Death</u>" state, they merge back into the Boss Mirage.

tags.name: Mutual Complement
tags.description: Increases the Max HP of the "ichor memosprites" summoned after the Boss Mirage's split, and the "ichor memosprites" summoned after the split in the second phase have Shared HP.

tags.name: Economies of Scale
tags.description: For <color=#f29e38ff>every unit</color> on the enemy's side of the field that is not in the "<u>Feigned Death</u>" state aside from Boss Mirage, all enemies receive less DMG and deal more DMG.

phases.name: Arbiter of the Lost Abyss
phases.description: At the start of combat and during phase transitions, the Boss Mirage splits into 5 "ichor memosprites."
phases.answer: Strategy: Actively use AoE ATK abilities to cause all "ichor memosprites" to enter "Feigned Death" as quickly as possible, forcing them to merge back.

skills.name: How to Efficiently Reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness

texts.description: Ally units can reduce the Boss Mirage's Toughness by using a Shield to offset its specific abilities, or by defeating its summons. When allies use attack abilities to inflict debuffs on enemy targets, they can also reduce its Toughness by a minor amount.

skills.name: How to Counter Boss Mirage's "Singularity Split"

texts.description: Actively use AoE ATK abilities to quickly cause all "ichor memosprites" to enter "Feigned Death" so they undergo merger again.

guides.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is Broken</color>, action gets additionally delayed and DMG taken increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

After Boss Mirage uses "Hemotort Teethgrind" and "Hemotort Saw" to hit an ally target, "Barrier Recoil" is triggered if the attacked ally target has a Shield. Defeating the summons summoned by "Execution in Place" triggers "Barrier Recoil." When Boss Mirage triggers "Barrier Recoil," it reduces this unit's Toughness and DEF.\nIf an ally inflicts a debuff on Boss Mirage and its summons when using an attack, slightly reduces the Toughness of that enemy unit and deals True DMG to it.

At the start of combat and during phase transitions, Boss Mirage splits into 5 "ichor memosprites" and applies "Monoform Merger" to these summons. When all "ichor memosprites" with "Monoform Merger" enter the "Feigned Death" state, they merge back into the Boss Mirage.

texts.description: Prioritize applying Shields to ally targets. This can offset the Boss Mirage's DMG while reducing its Toughness and lowering its DEF.
Attack enemy targets using abilities with <color=#f29e38ff>Impair</color> capabilities. If a debuff is successfully applied, their Toughness will be further reduced, and they will take True DMG.
When the Boss Mirage fissures and summons "ichor memosprite," prioritize using AoE ATK abilities to quickly force the summons into the "Feigned Death" state.

skills.name: Windmill Defacer
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target and grants the target team <u>Punchline</u>, with a chance to cause the attacked target to enter the "Strong Reverberation" state.

skills.name: IFF Systems Malfunction
skills.description: When in the "Strength Boost!" state, this unit immediately takes action after being attacked. Has a low chance to deal Physical DMG to a random friendly unit adjacent to this unit and grant the target team <u>Punchline</u>. Otherwise, uses "Windmill Defacer" on a random target. If the DMG taken in this attack is Elation DMG, this attack will always attack a friendly unit. This effect can only trigger a maximum of 1 time while the "Strength Boost!" state persists.

501210001.name: Magical Girl Troupe
501210001.description:
Planarcadia's security force and idol group, the Magical Girl Troupe.
In the ancient Benzaitengoku era, witches used exorcism dances and songs to vanquish the darkness lurking in the world.
Times have changed, and these witches have evolved into a profession in modern-day Planarcadia that combines spirit exorcism, riot control, counter-terrorism, and entertainment: the "magical girls."
Contrary to their cute appearance, magical girls frequently face the most sinister threats in Planarcadia, which is why most of them have... less-than-pleasant personalities in private.

skills.name: Love ❤ Stormfall Day
skills.description: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Gentle Rains ❤ How I Miss You
skills.description: When receiving a killing blow while in the "Rainy Day" state, deals successive minor Lightning DMG to random targets. After each hit, there is a high chance to inflict Shock on attacked targets.

skills.name: First Kiss ❤ Sunny Skies
skills.description: When receiving a killing blow while in the "Sunny Day" state, increases all allies' CRIT DMG.

skills.name: Heartfelt ❤ Rain to Sun
skills.description: When entering combat, starts in the "Rainy Day" state. After taking Elation DMG or after any unit uses an Elation Skill, enters the "Sunny Day" state, delays action, and grants targets <u>Punchline</u>.

501211001.name: Tabloid Journalist Furbulitzer
501211001.description: A furbo who dresses just like you for some reason, the ace reporter of *Weekly Furbobo*, with a special talent for snapping <unbreak>10</unbreak> photos in one second.

skills.name: Capture
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Ugly Close-Up
skills.description: When taking a killing blow, snaps a photo and receives a rating based on the DMG dealt by the killing blow that rewards Elation. Additionally, grants the target team <u>Punchlines</u>.

501211002.name: Furbo Journalist
501211002.description: A furbo journalist for *Furbobo Weekly*. The primary fabricator of gossip news, a little baddie who loves to transform, and an occasional slacker who skips work, usually in corners where (it thinks) you can't see it.

501301001.name: Rocking Rebel
501301001.description:
A die-hard rock music fan. In pursuit of his musical dreams, he ventured down a dark path. But at the end of the day, he's still just a fan.
Hates "bassist jokes" with a passion.
Some third-rate media outlets speculated that "the bass is his true form" based on his design, but that's pure rumor... the bass is actually being coerced.

skills.name: Sweep the Left!
skills.description: Starting from the leftmost target, uses a sweeping attack on 3 consecutive targets, dealing minor Imaginary DMG.

skills.name: Sweep the Right!
skills.description: Starting from the rightmost target, uses a sweeping attack on 3 consecutive targets, dealing minor Imaginary DMG.

skills.name: Performance Rehearsal
skills.description: Enters Charging state. On its next action, uses "Time to Rock!" When Aha Instant triggers, immediately dispels the Charging state, grants the target team <u>Punchline</u>, and increases DMG taken by this unit.

skills.name: Time to Rock!
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Get Hyped!
skills.description: If this unit is not in "Frenzied Rendition" state, increases SPD of friendly units other than this unit. If this unit is in the "Frenzied Rendition" state, deals Imaginary DMG to friendly units other than this unit, with a chance to inflict the "<u>Revelry</u>" state to them, and grants the target team <u>Punchline</u>.

skills.name: Music Madness
skills.description: When Aha Instant is activated, this unit gains the "Frenzied Rendition" state, making the effects of "Get Hyped!" more Elated.

501303001.name: Canvas Peacock
501303001.description:
The aberration born in the art school originated from the rumor of "brushes moving and painting on their own."
It congregated the self-loathing of talentless artists, their fear of school, and humanity's inherent laziness... and ultimately became what it is today.

skills.name: The Stroke
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Sweeping Hues
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target and consumes 1 <u>"Paint"</u> to deal Additional DMG of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Dancing Splendor
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to all targets and consumes 1 <u>"Paint"</u> to deal Additional DMG of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Palette Meltdown
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to all targets and consumes all remaining <u>"Paint"</u> to deal Additional DMG of the corresponding Type.

skills.name: Hue Overflow
skills.description:
After being attacked by ally targets while in the <u>"Colorless"</u> state, gains 1 point of <u>"Paint"</u> based on the attacker's Type. If Elation DMG is received during the attack, gains additional <u>"Paint"</u> points.
When <u>"Paint"</u> reaches 6 points, enters the <u>"Color"</u> state.
While in the <u>"Colorless"</u> state, Toughness will not drop below 1 point.
Increases All-Type RES, this effect is removed when Weakness is Broken and is regained when recovering from Weakness Break.

skills.name: Chromatic Threshold
skills.description: When consuming <u>"Paint"</u> to deal Additional DMG to a target, if the target's Type differs from the Additional DMG Type, this Additional DMG is boosted.

501303002.name: Sparxie's "Gift"
501303002.description: Jump up! Sing out! Fight on! Let's get the crowd hyped up before the "SparxiCon" begins!

skills.name: The Art of Color
skills.description:
Upon entering the <u>"Color"</u> state, grants targets a set number of <u>Punchline</u> points based on the highest amount of a single type of <u>"Paint"</u>. Then, according to the Type of the already obtained <u>"Paint"</u>, gains the corresponding Type Weakness, and reduces corresponding Type RES.
At the end of the turn while in the <u>"Color"</u> state, if all <u>"Paint"</u> has been consumed, enters the <u>"Colorless"</u> state.

501304001.name: Daybreak Squadron: Azurewing
501304001.description:
The pinnacle of logic and composure... or is he? He maintains a constant air of unshakeable calm, as if he's a walking encyclopedia of wisdom and lore, but at his core, he's just a sardonic loser with a talent for snark.
"My job is simply to decide what to do. As for whether it's actually possible... well, that's for you all to worry about... Holy Aha, you guys are actually doing it!?"
Cleaving the heavens! Wings spread like lightning! Warrior of the cyan welkin — Azurewing Warrior!
Darkness wanes, and dawn awakens! The Daybreak Squadron arises!

skills.name: Daybreak Blade
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Daybreak Flywheel
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Daybreak Will
skills.description: Applies "Daybreak Forcefield" to this unit. While in this state, Daybreak Squadron continuously uses "Shadow Dance of the Daybreak Blade," and is immune to Crowd Control debuffs. This unit's Toughness cannot be reduced. When this unit is attacked by a Quantum-Type attack, it will immediately take action. When Daybreak Squadron is in the "Daybreak Forcefield" state, after being attacked a certain number of times, it will use "Daybreak Dispersal."

skills.name: Shadow Dance of the Daybreak Blade
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Daybreak Dispersal
skills.description: Dispels "Daybreak Forcefield" and applies "Disheartened" to this unit, increasing DMG taken and reducing this unit's Quantum RES.

501305001.name: Daybreak Squadron: Blazeweaver
501305001.description:
The Captain of the Daybreak Squadron. An irrepressible optimist capable of ignoring any cloud of gloom, and a total, happy-go-lucky hot-blooded idiot.
"A '1% success rate' is nothing but numbers on a page! We'll just bridge the gap with courage, friendship, and pure willpower!"
Soul forged in fire! Scorching the darkness! The star that sets the fields ablaze — Blazeweaver Warrior!
Darkness wanes, and dawn awakens! The Daybreak Squadron arises!

skills.name: Daybreak Blade
skills.description: Deals Fire DMG to one designated target.

501401001.name: @SparxiConOfficial
501401001.description: Planarcadia's trending streamer Sparxie is going live! Tonight, witness the SparxiCon where she'll unveil her brand-new image to her devoted fans!

skills.name: Commence Chat Bombing!
skills.description: If all sub-field friendly units are defeated when <u>Live Showdown</u> is dispelled, increases the DMG taken by all friendly units, delays their actions, recovers Skill Points, and enables <u>Aha</u> to immediately gain 1 <u>extra turn</u> where a fixed amount of <u>Punchline</u> is taken into account. This extra turn does not consume <u>Punchline</u>. If not all sub-field friendly units are defeated when <u>Live Showdown</u> is dispelled, then deals massive Quantum DMG to target characters going into the sub-field, and inflicts them with "Entanglement."

skills.name: Commence Chat Bombing!
skills.description: If all sub-field friendly units have been defeated when <u>Live Showdown</u> is dispelled, increases DMG taken by all friendly units, delays their actions, restores Skill Points, and grants <u>Aha</u> 1 <u>extra turn</u> where a fixed amount of <u>Punchline</u> is taken into account. This turn does not consume <u>Punchline</u>.

skills.name: Bullet Comments Ready!
skills.description: When <u>Live Showdown</u> is dispelled, if the sub-field friendly units are still not defeated, it will deal Quantum DMG to all targets and has a chance to inflict <u>random Bullet Comments penalties</u>. The higher the remaining HP percentage of the sub-field friendly units, the higher the DMG dealt and the higher the probability of penalties.

skills.name: Net Battle!
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Bring the Beat In!
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Get On the Mic!
skills.description:
Initiates <u>Live Showdown</u> and selects one target character to fight in sub-field while other characters remain in the prime-field providing support. During <u>Live Showdown</u>, Elation Skills can only target sub-field friendly units. A Live Showdown countdown appears in the Action Order.
The <u>Live Showdown</u> will be dispelled when any of these conditions are met: countdown ends, the sub-field target character is downed, all sub-field friendly units are defeated, or when there are no sub-field target characters left available to battle.

skills.name: Stream Promo
skills.description: Apply the "Flooding Viewers" state to sub-field friendly units, advancing their actions and increasing their CRIT Rate.

skills.name: Friendship Level Adjustment
skills.description: After <u>Live Showdown</u> is activated, attacking "Output Port 1" will increase "Ally Popularity," while attacking "Output Port 2" will decrease "Enemy Popularity." When "Ally Popularity" increases, "Output Port 1" action advances, and when "Enemy Popularity" decreases, "Output Port 2" action advances.

skills.name: Fan Frenzy
skills.description: After <u>Live Showdown</u> is activated, friendly targets on the prime-field receive reduced DMG and become immune to Crowd Control debuffs. When <u>Live Showdown</u> is dispelled, if all friendly targets on the sub-field are defeated, this effect will be removed. Otherwise, based on the remaining HP percentage of sub-field friendly targets, a portion of the DMG Reduction effect will be retained until the next <u>Live Showdown</u> is activated. If this unit's HP drops to a certain percentage without having activated <u>Live Showdown</u>, this unit's action advances.

tags.name: Biphasic Battlefield
tags.description: The Boss Mirage will initiate a <u>Live Showdown</u> during combat, selecting one ally character to battle on the sub-field while the remaining characters stay on the prime-field to provide Support. Once the <u>Live Showdown</u> begins, enemy targets on the prime-field take reduced DMG and become immune to Crowd Control debuffs, and the Boss Mirage enters the "<u>Toughness Lock</u>" state. When the Boss Mirage's turn starts, both "Ally Popularity" and "Enemy Popularity" reset to their initial states.

tags.name: Basking in Popularity
tags.description: For each "Ally Popularity" or "Enemy Popularity" that hasn't hit the Limit, DMG taken by all enemies is reduced.

phases.name: Super Idol: Center of Attention
phases.description: At the start of combat, when entering the second phase, and when Live Showdown begins, the Boss Mirage enters "Toughness Lock" state. When Live Showdown ends, the Boss Mirage's "Toughness Lock" state is dispelled.
phases.answer: Strategy: When the Boss Mirage initiates a Live Showdown, prioritize sending characters with higher DMG output to the sub-field. The remaining characters should focus on attacking "Output Port 1" and "Output Port 2" to provide support.

skills.name: How to Efficiently Reduce Boss Mirage Toughness

texts.description: Defeat all enemy targets in the sub-field to end the Live Showdown, massively reduce the Boss Mirage's Toughness, and dispel the Boss Mirage's "Toughness Lock" state.
Characters remaining on the prime-field can attack "Output Port 1" and "Output Port 2" to provide buffs for the ally character on the sub-field and reduce the HP of enemy targets on the sub-field.

When all enemy targets on the sub-field are eliminated, massively reduce Boss Mirage's Toughness and HP.

501402001.description:
Who can handle the wild, untamed power of the Astral Express!? Pom-Pom, now beyond control, has transformed into the Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom.
King Pom-Pom is a powerful mechatron obsessed with cleanliness and order. By its standards, this place is a mess and needs a thorough! Deep! Clean!

skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target.

skills.description: Enters the "Steam Wash" state, increasing DMG dealt by this unit, and gains a set number of "Lasting Antibac" stacks, reduces the DMG this unit receives. When all stacks of "Lasting Antibac" are removed, exits the "Steam Wash" state and receives massive DMG.

skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets and grants the target team <u>Punchline</u>.

skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets and applies the "<u>Work Is Bliss!</u>" effect, while causing the target team to gain <u>Punchline</u>.

skills.description: Enters the "Raring to Go" state and gains the "Weakness Protected" effect. Uses "Saturation Cleaning!" in the next action.

skills.name: Saturation Cleaning!
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets and grants the target team <u>Punchline</u>.

skills.description: Adds "Venue Protocol Enforcer" to the Action Order. Each time "Venue Protocol Enforcer" takes action, summons an "Alloy Pommy" for both ally and enemy teams. Upon reaching <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> Charge, it can use an Enhanced Basic ATK to remove 1 stack of "Lasting Antibac" from "Alloy Mechatron: King Pom-Pom." A maximum of 1 ally "Alloy Pommy" can exist, and it cannot be targeted by either side.

501403003.name: Murata Graphia, Founding Artist
501403003.description:
The ancestral progenitor of the painters of Benzaitengoku, and a remnant of Murata Graphia.
She once utilized the power of "Voracity" to imagenate phantasmal monstrosities for the Antimatter Legion. After witnessing the crash of the Astral Express, a vision of ascending to the heavens took root within her, leading her to turn against her own creator alongside the Nameless.
Ultimately, to protect this realm, she sought to encanvas all of existence. Within her lonely sorrow, she depicted the vengeful spirits fallen at the hands of Asat Pramad over and over again, until that very resentment finally drove her to madness.

502301001.name: Joy Ascendant
502301001.description:
A human infected by the Paramount Bliss Inverted: Illwish Archlotus.
Apart from endless surges of joy, they remain unmoved by the six emotions and untainted by the six desires.

skills.name: Rapturous Exhalation
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Jubilation
skills.description: Consecutively deals Wind DMG to random single targets. Each hit has a chance to inflict "<u>Paramount Bliss</u>" on the attacked target. When this ability is used, if there are other "Joy Ascendants" on the field, they will also use this ability simultaneously.

skills.name: Blossoming Smile
skills.description: Enters the "Budding" state. Uses "Euphoric Spiral" on all targets during the next action.

skills.name: Euphoric Spiral
skills.description: Deals DMG to all targets. If a target has the "<u>Paramount Bliss</u>" effect, removes "<u>Paramount Bliss</u>," delays their action, and reduces Skill Point(s).

skills.name: Illwish Fission
skills.description: Upon receiving fatal damage, splits into 2 "Joy Ascendant: Prelude" and grants targets a certain amount of <u>Punchline</u>. 502302001.name: God-Devourer Offspring
502302001.description: A monstrous legion created from Asat Pramad's split "Voracity" power, now the prototype of the "imagenae." Asat Pramad sensed within the dormant core from Ahatopia an unending hunger tied to the Voracity, whose pulsation resonated closely with the Path of Destruction. Amused by this restless force, he began his dark creation: erasing human heads, leaving only grinning, devouring mouths that howl, demand, and consume without end.

skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to one designated target, with a high chance to reduce the attacked target's DEF.

skills.name: Feast of the Living Offering
skills.description: Causes one designated target character to enter the "Devour" state, reducing their Maximum Restorable HP and stealing a certain percentage of the character's ATK.

skills.name: Rite of Expiation
skills.description: When the "Devour" state applied by this unit is dispelled, increases the ATK of the target unit who has dispelled the "Devour" state.

skills.name: Banquet of Beasts
skills.description: Deals minor Fire DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Sacred Regurgitation
skills.description: Each time after this unit is attacked by a target unit, increases the Maximum Restorable HP of the target character inflicted with the "Devour" state by this unit, and returns a certain percentage of ATK. 502401001.name: Paramount Bliss Inverted: Illwish Archlotus
502401001.description:
The director of Fulwish TV, fused with the flesh of Shuhu that was brought into Planarcadia.
During the last Phantasmoon Games fifteen years ago, a serial killer known as the "Herald of Death" caused countless casualties. His actions left numerous residents without parents, siblings, and classmates.
Physical scars can heal, but scars of the mind and soul can never be mended again. The people formed a "Victims' Mutual Aid Society" in an attempt to heal this wound.
Fulwish perfected a "Happiness Surgery." Once administered, everyone would eternally forget their suffering and remain happy. The source of this surgery was pieces of Shuhu's flesh.
Fifteen years later, the "Victims' Mutual Aid Society" evolved into the renowned "Research Society of Happy Smiles." This simple little surgery, disguised as a cosmetic procedure or medical treatment, infected countless people in Planarcadia and allowed Shuhu's cells to slumber within the populace.
As the president of the Research Society of Happy Smiles, Fulwish harbored hatred toward the Phantasmoon Games that spawned the Herald of Death, and thus transformed into "Paramount Bliss Inverted: Illwish Archlotus," launching her revenge against this world.

skills.name: Rift Pistil
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Siphon Woe
skills.description: Drains the HP of all targets with the <u>"Happiness"</u> or <u>"Happiness Puppet"</u> effects and converts it into this unit's HP.

skills.name: Illwish Spray
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to multiple random target characters and applies the <u>"Happiness"</u> effect. When <u>"Happiness"</u> reaches <unbreak>2[i]</unbreak> stack(s) at the end of a turn, the target will be converted into a <u>"Happiness Puppet"</u>. If <u>"Happiness"</u> is reduced to 0 stacks, it will be removed and replaced with the <u>"Inverted Severance"</u> effect.

skills.name: Incipient Bloom
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. Uses "Euphoric Embrace" in the next turn.

skills.name: Euphoric Embrace
skills.description: Deals massive Lightning DMG to all target characters. If this unit is in the <u>"Wicked Grin"</u> state, inflicts the <u>"Happiness Puppet"</u> state on all targets.

skills.name: Laughter's End
skills.description: After a certain number of friendly units are defeated, triggers "Laughter's End" that increases the DMG taken by all friendly units and removes the <u>"Wicked Grin"</u> effect from "Paramount Bliss Inverted: Illwish Archlotus."

503201001.name: Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ
503201001.description:
Aberrant larvae spawned from the distorted body of "Blood of the Fallen God: Yabuli," inheriting the rampaging, rabid power of leviathans from the central brain.
These underdeveloped, mutated seed germs act solely on primal hunger and murderous instinct. As an extension of the host body's mutation and proliferation, they will indiscriminately lacerate and devour all living beings around them.

skills.name: Nip It in the Bud
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target character and inflicts them with 1 stack of the <u>"Decay"</u> state.

skills.name: Feedforward Control Operation
skills.description: Restores HP for one designated friendly unit and increases their DMG dealt.

503201002.name: Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ
503201002.description:
Aberrant larvae spawned from the distorted body of "Blood of the Fallen God: Yabuli," inheriting the rampaging, rabid power of leviathans from the central brain.
These underdeveloped, mutated seed germs act solely on primal hunger and murderous instinct. As an extension of the host body's mutation and proliferation, they will indiscriminately lacerate and devour all living beings around them.

skills.name: Nip It in the Bud
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target character and inflicts them with 1 stack of the <u>"Decay"</u> state.

skills.name: Feedforward Control Operation
skills.description: Restores HP for one designated friendly unit and increases their DMG dealt.

503401002.name: Blood of the Fallen God: Yabuli
503401002.description:
The head of the Technology Department who secretly controlled the Intelligentsia Guild. She abandoned her fragile human shell, transferring her consciousness into a massive "tree-like brain" just to pry into the secrets of the leviathans.
Yabuli's obsession with power beyond human limits ultimately led to her demise. She was completely assimilated by the Voracity, reverting to an embryonic state and metamorphosing into an unspeakable monster.

skills.name: Mark of Predation
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target character, and inflicts 1 stack of the <u>"Fallen God's Decay"</u> state on them.

skills.name: Howl of Hunger
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Macroecosystem
skills.description: Devours "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ" to increase DMG dealt by this unit and restore HP.

skills.name: All Are Within Me
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets, and has a high chance to inflict an <u>"Essence Devour"</u> state on all targets.

skills.name: Linked Cluster Stress Response
skills.description: Being attacked during the ceremony advances the action of "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germs," and "Blood of the Fallen God" is unaffected by action advance effects.

skills.name: Myriad Aspects of the Beast Eye
skills.description: Gains 1 Eye of Voracity after every action. At the end of the turn, if Eye of Voracity reaches a certain amount, immediately uses "All Are Within Me." When gaining "Blood-Brain Barrier," SPD greatly increases.

skills.name: Dream of Embryos
skills.description: Adds "Lysisgenesis" to the Action Order. Each time "Lysisgenesis" takes action, summons a "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ." While "Blood of the Fallen God" is on the field, attacks from "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ" will additionally inflict <u>"Fallen God's Decay"</u> and <u>"Essence Devour."</u> When "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ" is defeated, the HP of "Blood of the Fallen God" will decrease. When attacked, causes "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germs" to lock onto the attacking character. When all target characters are under the "Phantom Illusion" state, the battle fails.

skills.name: Blood-Brain Barrier
skills.description: When HP drops to a certain value, this unit gains "Blood-Brain Barrier," Toughness cannot be reduced, and all DMG taken is greatly reduced. Elation DMG's efficiency at dispelling "Blood-Brain Barrier" greatly increases. Upon gaining "Blood-Brain Barrier," adds "Homeostatic Imbalance" to the Action Order. Defeating "Frenzied Beast's Seed Germ" increases "Homeostatic Imbalance's" Charge. When "Homeostatic Imbalance" takes action, it deals DMG to "Blood-Brain Barrier" based on the Charge accumulated. When "Blood-Brain Barrier" is dispelled, this unit takes a massive amount of DMG.

700203001.name: Incineration Shadewalker
700203001.description:
Shades that wander in the Fragmentum after the arrival of the Eternal Freeze. It mimics the form of the Silvermane Guards in a twisted manner. Fitted with the same uniformed armor as the Belobog warriors, its skull is, however, replaced by faceless embers.
Incineration Shadewalkers will swing their fiery ax and burn their enemies in battle.

700205001.name: Entranced Ingenium: Illumination Dragonfish
700205001.description: An ingenium casually made by craftsmasters of the Artisanship Commission. It was originally an inanimate illuminator used for casting light upon darkness, but now it has been given a short-lived "life" due to certain mutations.

700207001.name: Imaginary Weaver
700207001.description: Strange beings that do not belong to this world. Passing through countless barriers, they arrive from the other side of the vast, dark, starry sky. Their bodies are like diseased branches breaching into reality, using Imaginary power to twist reality at will.

700209001.name: Silvermane Soldier
700209001.description:
A member of Belobog's Silvermane Guards, tasked with leading the charge into enemy lines.
Silvermane Soldiers provide continuous buffs to allies in combat.

800301001.name: Ice Out of Space
800301001.description:
A strange being that does not belong to this world. Nurtured in the Fragmentum brought by the Stellaron, it feeds upon this world's root structures to obtain energy. Its armor reflects the gloomy and profound starry sky.
In combat, the Ice Out of Space will freeze targets it touches.

skills.name: Chilling Lament
skills.description: Deals minor Ice DMG to a single target. Deals extra Ice DMG to the target if the target is currently Frozen and this unit is in the Freezing Point state.

skills.name: Frosty Absorption
skills.description: Enters the Freezing Point state. Everwinter Rain can be used in subsequent attacks.

skills.name: Everwinter Rain
skills.description: This ability is only available while in the Freezing Point state. Deals minor Ice DMG to all targets, with a chance to Freeze the targets.

skills.name: Chilling Lament
skills.description: Deals Ice DMG to a single target. There is a chance to Freeze the target if the user is in the Freezing Point state.

800302201.description:
Born of the Fragmentum and created by the Stellaron, this alien life form feeds on this world's energy. The blazing fires from the core of a star burn on its armor.

800303001.name: Guardian Shadow
800303001.description:
A shadow manifested by the power of a Stellaron, carrying out the Fragmentum's unceasing will to expand.
A living being of energy born from the projection of the desires of sentient lifeforms into the Fragmentum, akin to a pearl created from a single grain of sand. This energy wanders around aimlessly, acting only when executing the will of its master.

skills.name: Lightning Recollection
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Lightning Condemnation
skills.description: Deals minor Lightning DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Tranquil Ban
skills.description: Your team is imposed with a ban on attacking the Guardian Shadow. Should anyone do so, they immediately receive 1 attack.

skills.name: Disarm Ban
skills.description: Your team is imposed with a ban on using Basic ATK. Should anyone do so, they immediately receive 1 attack.

skills.name: Silent Ban
skills.description: Your team is imposed with a ban on using Skill. Should anyone do so, they immediately receive 1 attack.

skills.name: Thunderstorm Condemnation
skills.description: Deals successive minor Lightning DMG to a random target, with a chance to inflict Shock.

skills.name: Inevitable Punishment
skills.description: Deals Lightning DMG to whoever violates the ban.

skills.name: Silent Ban

800303021.name: Guardian Shadow
800303021.description:
A shadow manifested by the power of a Stellaron, carrying out the Fragmentum's unceasing will to expand.
A living being of energy born from the projection of the desires of sentient lifeforms into the Fragmentum, akin to a pearl created from a single grain of sand. This energy wanders around aimlessly, acting only when executing the will of its master.

skills.name: Liberation of the Golden Age
skills.description: Deals successive Imaginary DMG to a random target. If there are no Gauge Recollection stacks, this ability will fail.

skills.name: Fleeting Veil
skills.description: Slightly reduces the Basic ATK, Skill, Ultimate, and Follow-Up ATK DMG received by this unit, with a chance to inflict Imprisonment on the target attacked by Decaying Shadow.

skills.name: Liberation of the Golden Age
skills.description: Deals successive Imaginary DMG to a random target. The number of attacks is equal to the "Gauge Recollection" stacks remaining. If there is no "Gauge Recollection," this ability will fail.

800305001.name: Stormbringer
800305001.description:
Monsters that have experienced corrosion as the Fragmentum expanded. They now have a more nimble way of fighting after the source of their power mutated.
Stormbringers utilize the power of the wind to aid them in battle, enabling them to fire arrows more rapidly.

skills.name: Watchful Meteor
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG to a single target and has a high chance to inflict Wind Shear.

skills.name: Wind Walker
skills.description: Deals minor Wind DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target, with a chance to inflict Wind Shear.

skills.name: Wind-Twisting Crossbow
skills.description: Enters the Charging state and locks on to all targets currently suffering Wind Shear. Cast Windfall Storm in the next action.

skills.name: Windfall Storm
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG to targets afflicted with Wind Shear. This ability fails if no one on the target team suffers Wind Shear.

skills.name: Storm Cyclone
skills.description: Slightly increases ATK after attacking a target afflicted with Wind Shear. This buff is dispelled upon Weakness Break.

skills.name: Windfall Storm
skills.description: Deals Wind DMG to targets afflicted with Wind Shear. This ability fails if no one on the target team suffers Wind Shear.

800305101.name: Stormbringer (Bug)
800305101.description:
A false projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is a monster that underwent corrosion in the expanse of the Fragmentum. It has developed a more agile fighting style ever since its original form became distorted.
The Stormbringer utilizes the power of the wind to its advantage in battle, enabling it to fire arrows more rapidly. It can also summon Windspawn to aid in combat.

801101001.name: Baryon
801101001.description:
In order to prevent antiparticles from dissipating and annihilating normal matter, the Antimatter Legion created two types of miniature ion traps for transportation, collectively referred to as Baryons and Antibaryons.
Baryons have basic intelligence, and can clear the path according to the commands and summons of Voidrangers on the battlefield.

skills.name: Obliterate
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to a single target.

A Voidranger that has successfully survived particle annihilation, the positive and negative particles in its body have temporarily achieved a strange balance, granting them more power than ordinary reavers.

801204001.name: Comediologist
801204001.description:
Born from a fragmented part of the Pseudo-Awakened One "Asat Pramad," it seeks to completely deconstruct the Elation by analyzing comedy.
Its very existence exists for the sake of Destruction, taking tragedy as the core of comedy and "Destruction" as the ultimate truth of "Elation".

skills.name: Punchline Analysis
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Curtain Call
skills.description: Upon receiving fatal DMG, applies "<u>Tragic Core</u>" to targets.

skills.name: Comedian Ensemble
skills.description: Adds "Comedian Ensemble" to the Action Order. Every time "Comedian Ensemble" takes action, all "Comediologists" will launch an attack simultaneously.

801214601.name: Disaster's Right Hand
801214601.description:
Only the echoes of pain remain on the devastated earth — the march of the end times.
Disaster's Right Hand is adept at drawing upon Imaginary power to create large-scale attacks.

skills.name: Calamity Tear
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Tough Cuts
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to all targets, and randomly inflicts Imaginary Infusion on 2 targets.

skills.name: The Breakdown of Tyranny
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets, and randomly inflicts Imaginary Infusion on 3 targets.

skills.name: Ruinous Collision
skills.description: When this unit uses their ability and causes a target to be in Quantum Infusion and Imaginary Infusion at the same time, dispels both Quantum Infusion and Imaginary Infusion on the target, and deals minor Quantum DMG and Imaginary DMG with a high chance of inflicting <u>Snarelock</u> to the target.

skills.name: Feigned Death
skills.description: After suffering a killing blow, enters Feigned Death.

skills.name: Safeguard
skills.description: Enters the Safeguard state. When not Weakness Broken, reduces DMG received. Once Weakness is Broken, action will be delayed. After Weakness is Broken, increases DMG received.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: The Boss Mirage cannot be attacked directly. When all three <color=#f29e38ff><u>parts</u></color> of the Boss Mirage are in Feigned Death simultaneously, the Boss Mirage enters Weakness Break state and can be attacked. During this state, its actions are additionally delayed, and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Battlefield Transfer
tags.description: The Antimatter Engine <color=#f29e38ff><u>transfers</u></color> its own weakness type to Disaster's Right Hand and Dawn's Left Hand. However, when Disaster's Right Hand or Dawn's Left Hand is defeated, the Antimatter Engine's Toughness is additionally reduced.

tags.name: Battle Hardened
tags.description: After using a single-target ability, enemy units gain increased SPD for 1 turn. After using an AoE ATK ability, their ATK increases for 1 turn. Using a Support ability recovers HP to the target of the ability.

tags.name: Tenacious Resolve
tags.description: Reduces DMG received by all enemies, but every <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness-Type</color> they have increases DMG received.

phases.name: Starbane Doombringer
phases.description: The Boss Mirage's parts will inflict a Quantum/Imaginary-Type Infusion status on targets. After defeating them, they will enter the Feigned Death state and have their actions delayed. In their next action, they regenerate.
phases.answer: Strategy: Prioritize attacking specific targets to remove the Type Infusion effect from its targets. Eliminate all parts of the Boss Mirage before regeneration to inflict Weakness Break on the Boss Mirage.

skills.name: Counters the control effects of Snarelock

texts.description: When units are simultaneously under Quantum and Imaginary Type Infusion states, they will enter the Snarelock state. Prioritize attacking specific targets with the same Type icon to remove the Quantum/Imaginary Type Infusion from player units. Alternatively, counter the Snarelock state by increasing Effect RES, or using abilities that remove debuffs.

skills.name: Counters Antimatter Engine with no Weakness Type

texts.description: Defeating Disaster's Right Hand or Dawn's Left Hand will transfer the Weakness Type back to Antimatter Engine and weakens it.

skills.name: Counters the regeneration mechanics of Boss Mirage's three parts

texts.description: Before the Boss Mirage's parts regenerate, eliminating all parts can cause the Boss Mirage to enter Weakness Break state. While in Weakness Break state, the parts will not regenerate until the Boss Mirage recovers from this state.

guides.description: After any of Boss Mirage's parts is eliminated, it enters a Feigned Death state and have its actions delayed. The parts regenerate during its next action. When all three parts are <color=#f29e38ff>in Feigned Death simultaneously</color>, the main body enters Weakness Break state with Boss Mirage's actions further delayed, increasing DMG taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>.
Antimatter Engine will <color=#f29e38ff>transfer its own Weakness Type</color> to Disaster's Right Hand and Dawn's Left Hand.

The Boss Mirage will inflict a Quantum/Imaginary-Type Infusion status on targets, and <color=#f29e38ff>being inflicted by both Type Infusion statuses simultaneously</color> will result in being inflicted with the Snarelock state.

texts.description: Defeating all three parts of the Boss Mirage and causing them to <color=#f29e38ff>enter Feigned Death simultaneously</color> can inflict Weakness Break on Boss Mirage, allowing DMG to be dealt directly to it.

When allies are under <color=#f29e38ff>Quantum/Imaginary Infusion</color> status, promptly attack targets with the same Type icon to remove the Type Infusion status and prevent falling into the Snarelock state.

Only the echoes of pain remain on the devastated earth — the march of the end times.
Disaster's Right Hand is adept at drawing upon Imaginary power to create large-scale attacks.

skills.name: Calamity Tear
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Tough Cuts
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to all targets, and randomly inflicts Imaginary Infusion on 2 targets.

skills.name: The Breakdown of Tyranny
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets, and randomly inflicts Imaginary Infusion on 3 targets.

skills.name: Ruinous Collision
skills.description: When this unit uses their ability and causes a target to be in Quantum Infusion and Imaginary Infusion at the same time, dispels both Quantum Infusion and Imaginary Infusion on the target, and deals minor Quantum DMG and Imaginary DMG with a high chance of inflicting <u>Snarelock</u> to the target.

skills.name: Feigned Death
skills.description: After suffering a killing blow, enters Feigned Death.

skills.name: Safeguard
skills.description: Enters the Safeguard state. When not Weakness Broken, reduces DMG received. Once Weakness is Broken, action will be delayed. After Weakness is Broken, increases DMG received.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: The Boss Mirage cannot be attacked directly. When all three <color=#f29e38ff><u>parts</u></color> of the Boss Mirage are in Feigned Death simultaneously, the Boss Mirage enters Weakness Break state and can be attacked. During this state, its actions are additionally delayed, and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Battlefield Transfer
tags.description: The Antimatter Engine <color=#f29e38ff><u>transfers</u></color> its own weakness type to Disaster's Right Hand and Dawn's Left Hand. However, when Disaster's Right Hand or Dawn's Left Hand is defeated, the Antimatter Engine's Toughness is additionally reduced.

tags.name: Battle Hardened
tags.description: After using a single-target ability, enemy units gain increased SPD for 1 turn. After using an AoE ATK ability, their ATK increases for 1 turn. Using a Support ability recovers HP to the target of the ability.

tags.name: Tenacious Resolve
tags.description: Reduces DMG received by all enemies, but every <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness-Type</color> they have increases DMG received.

phases.name: Starbane Doombringer
phases.description: The Boss Mirage's parts will inflict a Quantum/Imaginary-Type Infusion status on targets. After defeating them, they will enter the Feigned Death state and have their actions delayed. In their next action, they regenerate.
phases.answer: Strategy: Prioritize attacking specific targets to remove the Type Infusion effect from its targets. Eliminate all parts of the Boss Mirage before regeneration to inflict Weakness Break on the Boss Mirage.

skills.name: Counters the control effects of Snarelock

texts.description: When units are simultaneously under Quantum and Imaginary Type Infusion states, they will enter the Snarelock state. Prioritize attacking specific targets with the same Type icon to remove the Quantum/Imaginary Type Infusion from player units. Alternatively, counter the Snarelock state by increasing Effect RES, or using abilities that remove debuffs.

skills.name: Counters Antimatter Engine with no Weakness Type

texts.description: Defeating Disaster's Right Hand or Dawn's Left Hand will transfer the Weakness Type back to Antimatter Engine and weakens it.

skills.name: Counters the regeneration mechanics of Boss Mirage's three parts

texts.description: Before the Boss Mirage's parts regenerate, eliminating all parts can cause the Boss Mirage to enter Weakness Break state. While in Weakness Break state, the parts will not regenerate until the Boss Mirage recovers from this state.

guides.description: After any of Boss Mirage's parts is eliminated, it enters a Feigned Death state and have its actions delayed. The parts regenerate during its next action. When all three parts are <color=#f29e38ff>in Feigned Death simultaneously</color>, the main body enters Weakness Break state with Boss Mirage's actions further delayed, increasing DMG taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>.
Antimatter Engine will <color=#f29e38ff>transfer its own Weakness Type</color> to Disaster's Right Hand and Dawn's Left Hand.

The Boss Mirage will inflict a Quantum/Imaginary-Type Infusion status on targets, and <color=#f29e38ff>being inflicted by both Type Infusion statuses simultaneously</color> will result in being inflicted with the Snarelock state.

texts.description: Defeating all three parts of the Boss Mirage and causing them to <color=#f29e38ff>enter Feigned Death simultaneously</color> can inflict Weakness Break on Boss Mirage, allowing DMG to be dealt directly to it.

When allies are under <color=#f29e38ff>Quantum/Imaginary Infusion</color> status, promptly attack targets with the same Type icon to remove the Type Infusion status and prevent falling into the Snarelock state.

801214701.description:

801301001.name: Voidranger: Trampler
801301001.description:
A product of the Antimatter Legion utilizing the Warforge to recast and fuse remnants of fallen warriors and leviathans.
Though relatively rare, they possess both the intelligence of a warrior and the power and mobility of a leviathan. Its screech can summon a large number of Voidrangers.

skills.name: Unreal Projection
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Rule of Force
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to a single target.

skills.name: War Trample
skills.description: Deals minor Quantum DMG to one designated target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Spiral Arrow
skills.description: Locks on to a single target. Cast End of Bow to this target in the next action.

skills.name: End of Bow
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to a single target, with a high chance to inflict Entanglement.
