801314501.name: Antimatter Engine
801314501.description:
The ultimate embodiment of power. The form of the energy that accumulates behind it remains unknown.
The Antimatter Engine will grant energy to other enemies and enhance their abilities.

skills.name: Void Fission
skills.description: Applies "Amplification" to Disaster's Right Hand, increasing its Enhancement Level by 1.

skills.name: Calamity Strike
skills.description: Applies "Amplification" to Dawn's Left Hand, increasing its Enhancement Level by 1.

skills.name: Engine Boost
skills.description: Applies "Amplification" to all friendly units except this unit, increasing their Enhancement Level by 1.

skills.name: Total Annihilation
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG and Imaginary DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Cataclysm Precursor
skills.description: Enters the Charging state. The next action uses "Impending Doom" on all targets.

skills.name: Impending Doom
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG and Imaginary DMG to all targets. After attacking, randomly inflicts Quantum Infusion or Imaginary Infusion on all targets.

skills.name: Doomsday Curse
skills.description: Randomly inflicts Quantum Infusion or Imaginary Infusion on all targets.

skills.name: Mass Infection
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG and Imaginary DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Ruinous Collision
skills.description: When this unit uses their ability and causes a target to be in Quantum Infusion and Imaginary Infusion at the same time, dispels both Quantum Infusion and Imaginary Infusion on the target, and deals minor Quantum DMG and Imaginary DMG with a high chance of inflicting <u>Snarelock</u> to the target.

skills.name: Feigned Death
skills.description: After suffering a killing blow, enters Feigned Death.

tags.name: Steadfast Safeguard
tags.description: The Boss Mirage cannot be attacked directly. When all three <color=#f29e38ff><u>parts</u></color> of the Boss Mirage are in Feigned Death simultaneously, the Boss Mirage enters Weakness Break state and can be attacked. During this state, its actions are additionally delayed, and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>.

tags.name: Battlefield Transfer
tags.description: The Antimatter Engine <color=#f29e38ff><u>transfers</u></color> its own weakness type to Disaster's Right Hand and Dawn's Left Hand. However, when Disaster's Right Hand or Dawn's Left Hand is defeated, the Antimatter Engine's Toughness is additionally reduced.

tags.name: Battle Hardened
tags.description: After using a single-target ability, enemy units gain increased SPD for 1 turn. After using an AoE ATK ability, their ATK increases for 1 turn. Using a Support ability recovers HP to the target of the ability.

tags.name: Tenacious Resolve
tags.description: Reduces DMG received by all enemies, but every <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness-Type</color> they have increases DMG received.

phases.name: Starbane Doombringer
phases.description: The Boss Mirage's parts will inflict a Quantum/Imaginary-Type Infusion status on targets. After defeating them, they will enter the Feigned Death state and have their actions delayed. In their next action, they regenerate.
phases.answer: Strategy: Prioritize attacking specific targets to remove the Type Infusion effect from its targets. Eliminate all parts of the Boss Mirage before regeneration to inflict Weakness Break on the Boss Mirage.

skills.name: Counters the control effects of Snarelock

texts.description: When units are simultaneously under Quantum and Imaginary Type Infusion states, they will enter the Snarelock state. Prioritize attacking specific targets with the same Type icon to remove the Quantum/Imaginary Type Infusion from player units. Alternatively, counter the Snarelock state by increasing Effect RES, or using abilities that remove debuffs.

skills.name: Counters Antimatter Engine with no Weakness Type

texts.description: Defeating Disaster's Right Hand or Dawn's Left Hand will transfer the Weakness Type back to Antimatter Engine and weakens it.

skills.name: Counters the regeneration mechanics of Boss Mirage's three parts

texts.description: Before the Boss Mirage's parts regenerate, eliminating all parts can cause the Boss Mirage to enter Weakness Break state. While in Weakness Break state, the parts will not regenerate until the Boss Mirage recovers from this state.

guides.description: After any of Boss Mirage's parts is eliminated, it enters a Feigned Death state and have its actions delayed. The parts regenerate during its next action. When all three parts are <color=#f29e38ff>in Feigned Death simultaneously</color>, the main body enters Weakness Break state with Boss Mirage's actions further delayed, increasing DMG taken by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>.
Antimatter Engine will <color=#f29e38ff>transfer its own Weakness Type</color> to Disaster's Right Hand and Dawn's Left Hand.

The Boss Mirage will inflict a Quantum/Imaginary-Type Infusion status on targets, and <color=#f29e38ff>being inflicted by both Type Infusion statuses simultaneously</color> will result in being inflicted with the Snarelock state.

texts.description: Defeating all three parts of the Boss Mirage and causing them to <color=#f29e38ff>enter Feigned Death simultaneously</color> can inflict Weakness Break on Boss Mirage, allowing DMG to be dealt directly to it.

When allies are under <color=#f29e38ff>Quantum/Imaginary Infusion</color> status, promptly attack targets with the same Type icon to remove the Type Infusion status and prevent falling into the Snarelock state.

texts.description: Defeating all three parts of the Boss Mirage and causing them to <color=#f29e38ff>enter Feigned Death simultaneously</color> can inflict Weakness Break on Boss Mirage, allowing DMG to be dealt directly to it.

When allies are under <color=#f29e38ff>Quantum/Imaginary Infusion</color> status, promptly attack targets with the same Type icon to remove the Type Infusion status and prevent falling into the Snarelock state.

phases.description: Boss Mirage will switch between the Abundance Form and the Destruction Form, and will summon a Lotus while switching.
phases.answer: Strategy: Defeat as many Abundance Lotus or Destruction Lotus (choose one or the other) to gain more buffs.

skills.name: Counters target's Max HP reduction effect

texts.description: Increase Effect RES or use abilities to dispel Prana-Siphon. Defeat summons to reduce the debuffs.

skills.name: Counters the Toughness Protection state of the Boss Mirage

texts.description: Defeating any summon will dispel the Boss Mirage's Toughness Protection and deal additional Toughness Reduction to the Boss Mirage.

phases.name: Phase II: Greed Breeds Danger
phases.description: Entities summoned by Boss Mirage will lock onto a target and use Eternal Condemnation against them, dealing massive DMG.
phases.answer: Strategy: Try to defeat the summoned entities before they use Eternal Condemnation to gain buffs and Weaken the power of Eternal Condemnation.

skills.name: Counters the massive DMG from the "Eternal Condemnation" ability unleashed by the summons

texts.description: Defeat as many Lotus as possible before Eternal Condemnation is released to reduce its damage.

guides.description: Boss Mirage takes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> less DMG. After its <color=#f29e38ff>Weakness is broken</color>, its action is additionally delayed and the DMG it receives increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>.

texts.description: After <color=#f29e38ff>Breaking</color> Boss Mirage, the DMG it receives is greatly increased, Skill Points are recovered for the team, and the team's action is Advanced Forward.

801503001.name: Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad
801503001.description:
The three faces of Paranirmitavaśavartin, and the true appearance of the Lord Ravager that wields authority over all possibilities.
All things in myriad forms pass through "Formation," "Existence," and "Decay," until they turn to "Annihilation." Elation and time are mortal enemies. Beneath the endless erosion of the ages, all things shall fade into silence.
To execute the Sky's decree of the Destruction, fulfilling the ambition of extinguishing all minds who bear emotions in the world.

skills.name: Existential Farce
skills.description: Deals DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Mocked Gaze
skills.description: Deals DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Nihility's Joy
skills.description: Deals DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Triple Contempt
skills.description: Deals DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Meme Setup
skills.description: Enters Charging state. Applies a total of 4 stacks of "<u>Meme'd</u>" to target characters.

skills.name: Meme Carnival
skills.description: Detonate all "<u>Meme'd</u>."

skills.name: Gambit of Converging Fates
skills.description: Roll several dice. Select one to take effect on targets, while the remaining effects take effect on friendly units.

skills.name: Board-Clearing Ball Game
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets, and has a high chance to inflict "Strong Reverberation" on a random target.

skills.name: May This Journey Lead You to Destruction
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Let Elation Hang in Silence
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Three-Faced Incarnation
skills.description: In this battle, "Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad" has three faces: "Formation," "Existence," and "Decay." Each face has its own unique ability.

skills.name: Jokes From Hell
skills.description: Adds "The Game Is On" to the Action Order. Every time "The Game Is On" takes action, dispels Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad's <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> and Weakness Broken state, and uses "May This Journey Lead You to Destruction."

skills.name: Three Faces as One
skills.description: During this phase, "Formation," "Existence," and "Decay" share HP, and the "Formation" and "Existence" faces cannot be targeted. Every time "The Game Is On" takes action, dispels Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad's <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> and Weakness Broken state, and uses "Let Elation Hang in Silence."

skills.name: Warm-Up Act
skills.description: Adds "Take the Stage" to the Action Order. Every time "Take the Stage" takes action, summons "Comediologist."

801503003.name: Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad
801503003.description:
The three faces of Paranirmitavaśavartin, and the true appearance of the Lord Ravager that wields authority over all possibilities.
All things in myriad forms pass through "Formation," "Existence," and "Decay," until they turn to "Annihilation." Elation and time are mortal enemies. Beneath the endless erosion of the ages, all things shall fade into silence.
To execute the Sky's decree of the Destruction, fulfilling the ambition of extinguishing all minds who bear emotions in the world.

801503005.name: Lord of Saṃvartasthāyi, Asat Pramad: "Formation"
801503005.description:
A Fool known as "Enroute," who wields magic to create Elation.
He conjured gold for the poor to bring them prosperity, and weapons for the oppressed to topple tyranny. All for the sake of making his audience laugh.
Yet desire knows no bounds, and the cost of this laughter grew ever steeper, until he could no longer satisfy the growing thirst.
And so, the masses condemned him as a fraud and put out a bounty on his head, yet the very bounty and weapons used to hunt him down were gifts from this charlatan.
In the end, the Fool declared that Elation was dead, and boarded the Astral Express in search of a way to save it.

802501001.name: Starcrusher Swarm King: Skaracabaz (Synthetic)
802501001.description: The replica of the Emanator of Propagation cultivated by Ruan Mei, briefly manifesting in the world in an incomplete form. Its original form is a giant lepisma that inherited the mandibles of the Imperator Insectorum. It can collect in its mouthparts the death ray that fragmented celestial bodies, and make shattered stars incubators for procreating offspring. It was once one of the nightmares across multiple worlds during the Swarm Disaster.

skills.name: Swarm King Cannon
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to a single target

skills.name: Radiating Venom
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to a single target, with a high chance to inflict Entanglement. Also summons 1 Gnaw Sting.

skills.name: Pyrolysis Death Beam
skills.description: Deals Quantum DMG to a single target and units adjacent to the target.

skills.name: Carapace of Begotten Spawn
skills.description: Enters the Multiply state until the next action. During this time, DMG taken is greatly reduced, and each attack taken summons a Gnaw Sting. If this unit is Weakness Broken while in the Multiply state, it will reduce all friendly units' Toughness by an amount equal to this unit's Max Toughness and increase the DMG taken by all other friendly units besides the target themselves.

skills.name: Ovum of Collapsed Star
skills.description: Deals massive Quantum DMG to all targets.

skills.name: Carapace of Nurtured Disaster
skills.description: Starts Charging and enters the Multiply state until the next action, whereupon Ovum of Collapsed Star will be used on all targets. During the Multiply state, DMG received is greatly reduced, and each attack taken will cause a Gnaw Sting and/or Lesser Sting to be summoned. If this unit is Weakness Broken while in the Multiply state, it will reduce all friendly units' Toughness by an amount equal to this unit's Max Toughness and increase the DMG taken by all other friendly units besides the target themselves.

skills.name: What Happens After "Gnaw Stings" are Enhanced

803302001.name: Lighthouse
803302001.description:
The superhero of Astropolis, armed with the Intelligentsia Guild's most advanced technological achievements, spares no effort to vanquish evil and maintain the city's peace. Over the past five years, he has repeatedly saved the people of Astropolis from disasters big and small.
Some point out that these feats could never be accomplished by one person alone, and that the so-called "Lighthouse" is nothing more than a false idol manufactured by the entertainment-industrial complex. But the public has already poured their hearts into hoping someone will shoulder the burden when they face a crisis. Little do they know, far darker secrets lie hidden beneath the armor of "Lighthouse"...

skills.name: Radiant Sweep
skills.description: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Unyielding Justice
skills.description: Enters the "Smite Evil" state, causing this unit to gain a set number of "All Wishes" stacks and applying the "Weakness Protected" effect to all friendly units, then uses "Smite All Evil" during the next action.

skills.name: Smite All Evil
skills.description: Deals massive Physical DMG to all targets and delays the action of the attacked targets. When using this ability, for every stack of "All Wishes" this unit has, DMG multiplier of "Smite All Evil" increases by a certain percentage. Afterward, clears the "All Wishes" stacks, and removes "Weakness Protected" from all friendly units and the "Inspire" effect.

skills.name: Navigation Guide
skills.description: While in the "Smite Evil" state, all friendly units gain the "Inspire" effect equal to the number of "All Wishes" stacks on Lighthouse. Each stack reduces DMG taken by the holder. After Lighthouse is attacked by a target, decreases "All Wishes" stacks by 1. After any targets uses an attack on a friendly unit, increases "All Wishes" stacks by 1. When Lighthouse's "All Wishes" stack count reaches 0, they dispel all Crowd Control debuffs affecting this unit and exit the "Smite Evil" state, have their action delayed, and apply "Ruined" to all friendly units, while removing the "Inspire" effect from all friendly units on the field.

skills.name: Righteous Frontline
skills.description: Summons "Astropolis Sentinel."

803401001.name: Ten Stonehearts: Aventurine of Stratagems
803401001.description: A senior manager in the IPC Strategic Investment Department and one of the Ten Stonehearts. Using his Cornerstone, he obtained a share of the authority of an Emanator of Preservation. He throws his own body into the game as a die, ready to face death in order to walk away alive.

skills.name: Heavy Stakes
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Distributed Investment
skills.description: Deals successive minor Imaginary DMG to random targets.

skills.name: Points Fountain
skills.description: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to all targets and reduce all targets' Energy.

skills.name: Time For A Bet
skills.description: Summons "All or Nothing" and makes a single target enter the Gamble. Every time an "All or Nothing" is attacked by a target that is in the Gamble, the target will receive a random number between 1 and 6. After a target that is in the Gamble has finished their turn, targets with numbers lower than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have lost the Gamble and will be attacked, while those with a number higher than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have won the Gamble and will have their Ultimate activated. At the same time, targets that have not entered the Gamble are afflicted with the "Look, Don't Speak" status, which is dispelled when the Gamble ends.

skills.name: Big Spenders' Mad Party
skills.description: Summons "All or Nothing" and makes all targets enter the gamble. Every time an "All or Nothing" is attacked, the target that launched the attack will receive a random number between 1 and 6. The next time "Aventurine of Stratagems" takes a turn, targets with numbers lower than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have lost the bet and will be attacked, while targets with numbers higher than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have won the bet and will have their Ultimates activated.

skills.name: The Loser's Time Is Over
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a target that lost the Gamble, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment on the attacked target.

skills.name: The Winner Takes It All
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets that lost the Gamble, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment on the attacked targets.

skills.name: Stratagems' Wagering
skills.description: Every time a target wins the Gamble, they receive the "Favored by Fortune" effect that increases their DMG dealt. Every time a target loses the Gamble, they receive the "Down on Your Luck" effect that increases DMG taken.

At the same time, targets that have not entered the Gamble are afflicted with the "Look, Don't Speak" status, which is dispelled when the Gamble ends.

skills.name: Big Spenders' Mad Party
skills.description: Summons "All or Nothing" and makes all targets enter the gamble. Every time an "All or Nothing" is attacked, the target that launched the attack will receive a random number between 1 and 6. The next time "Aventurine of Stratagems" takes a turn, targets with numbers lower than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have lost the bet and will be attacked, while targets with numbers higher than "Aventurine of Stratagems" are considered to have won the bet and will have their Ultimates activated.

skills.name: The Loser's Time Is Over
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a target that lost the Gamble, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment on the attacked target.

skills.name: The Winner Takes It All
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets that lost the Gamble, with a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment on the attacked targets.

skills.name: Stratagems' Wagering
skills.description: Every time a target wins the Gamble, they receive the "Favored by Fortune" effect that increases their DMG dealt. Every time a target loses the Gamble, they receive the "Down on Your Luck" effect that increases DMG taken.3

skills.name: Betting the Flop
skills.description: Activate two "All or Nothing," locks on to a single target, and uses Daring Wager on the locked-on target in the next turn. Defeat all activated "All or Nothing" monsters to prevent the use of Daring Wager and to activate a single target's Ultimate.

skills.name: Go All In
skills.description: Activates all "All or Nothing" and uses Doomed to Lose in the next action. Defeat all activated "All or Nothing" to prevent the use of Doomed to Lose and to activate all targets' Ultimate.

skills.name: Daring Wager
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to a single locked-on target and has a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment.

skills.name: Doomed to Lose
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to all targets and has a high chance of inflicting Imprisonment.

skills.name: Points
skills.description: In the battle, all units gain a set number of Points that resets between Phases. When targets' Points are lower than friendly units', DMG received by friendly units is greatly reduced, and gains Toughness Protection. When targets' Points are equal to friendly units or more, DMG received by friendly units is increased.

skills.name: Call
skills.description: At the start of the Phase or when summons are defeated, summons up to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> "All or Nothing."

skills.name: Blind Bet
skills.description: At the start of the Phase or when summons are defeated, summons up to <unbreak>1[i]</unbreak> "All or Nothing" or "All or Nothing: Double Fortune."

tags.name: Points Competition

tags.name: House Advantage

tags.name: Preemptive Advantage
tags.description: The higher the summons' Points, the higher their Max HP.

phases.description: Enemies have Points. When their Points are more than allies' Points, the enemies' DMG taken greatly decreases, and they gain Toughness Protection.

texts.description: Prioritize defeating dice with Points that are equal to or less than allies' Points, and its Points will be added to the allies, thus accumulating more Points for allies.
